He verbally abuses the father of a man, who in turn, verbally abuses his father, and he (retaliates and) curses his mother , so he curses his mother."
hadiths.arabic:
حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ، حَدَّثَنَا اللَّيْثُ بْنُ سَعْدٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ الْهَادِ، عَنْ سَعْدِ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنْ حُمَيْدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَمْرٍو، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ " مِنَ الْكَبَائِرِ أَنْ يَشْتُمَ الرَّجُلُ وَالِدَيْهِ " . قَالُوا يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ وَهَلْ يَشْتُمُ الرَّجُلُ وَالِدَيْهِ قَالَ " نَعَمْ يَسُبُّ أَبَا الرَّجُلِ فَيَشْتُمُ أَبَاهُ وَيَشْتُمُ أُمَّهُ فَيَسُبُّ أُمَّهُ " . 

قَالَ أَبُو عِيسَى هَذَا حَدِيثٌ حَسَنٌ صَحِيحٌ .
references: Vol. 4, Book of Righteousness And Maintaining Good Relations With Relatives, Hadith 1902

hadiths.title: Jami` at-Tirmidhi 1903

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ فِي إِكْرَامِ صَدِيقِ الْوَالِدِ
chapter.englishTitle: What  Has Been Related About Honoring The Father's Friends

hadiths.englishRaw:
Ibn 'Umar narrated that :

the Prophet ﷺ said:  "Among the most dutiful of deeds is that a man nurture relations with the people his father was friends with."
hadiths.body: the Prophet ﷺ said:  "Among the most dutiful of deeds is that a man nurture relations with the people his father was friends with."
hadiths.arabic:
حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ الْمُبَارَكِ، أَخْبَرَنَا حَيْوَةُ بْنُ شُرَيْحٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي الْوَلِيدُ بْنُ أَبِي الْوَلِيدِ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ دِينَارٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ يَقُولُ  " إِنَّ أَبَرَّ الْبِرِّ أَنْ يَصِلَ الرَّجُلُ أَهْلَ وُدِّ أَبِيهِ " . قَالَ وَفِي الْبَابِ عَنْ أَبِي أَسِيدٍ . 

قَالَ أَبُو عِيسَى هَذَا إِسْنَادٌ صَحِيحٌ وَقَدْ رُوِيَ هَذَا الْحَدِيثُ عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ مِنْ غَيْرِ وَجْهٍ .
references: Vol. 4, Book of Righteousness And Maintaining Good Relations With Relatives, Hadith 1903

hadiths.title: Jami` at-Tirmidhi 1904

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ فِي بِرِّ الْخَالَةِ
chapter.englishTitle: About Being Dutiful To The Maternal Aunt

hadiths.englishRaw:
Al-Bara' bin Azib narrated that :

the Prophet ﷺ said: "The maternal aunt holds the same status as the mother."
hadiths.body: the Prophet ﷺ said: "The maternal aunt holds the same status as the mother."
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ وَكِيعٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، عَنْ إِسْرَائِيلَ، ح قَالَ وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَحْمَدَ، وَهُوَ ابْنُ مَدُّويَهْ حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُوسَى، عَنْ إِسْرَائِيلَ، وَاللَّفْظُ، لِحَدِيثِ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ الْهَمْدَانِيِّ، عَنِ الْبَرَاءِ بْنِ عَازِبٍ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ  " الْخَالَةُ بِمَنْزِلَةِ الأُمِّ " . وَفِي الْحَدِيثِ قِصَّةٌ طَوِيلَةٌ . وَهَذَا حَدِيثٌ صَحِيحٌ .
references: Vol. 4, Book of Righteousness And Maintaining Good Relations With Relatives, Hadith 1904

hadiths.title: Jami` at-Tirmidhi 1905

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ فِي دَعْوَةِ الْوَالِدَيْنِ
chapter.englishTitle: What Has Been Related About Supplicating For One's Parents

hadiths.englishRaw:
Abu Harairah narrated that the Messenger of Allah said:

"Three supplications are  accepted , there is no doubt in them (about them being accepted): The  supplication of the oppressed, the supplication of the traveler,  and the supplication of his father against his son."
hadiths.narrator: Abu Harairah narrated that the Messenger of Allah said:
hadiths.body: "Three supplications are  accepted , there is no doubt in them (about them being accepted): The  supplication of the oppressed, the supplication of the traveler,  and the supplication of his father against his son."
hadiths.arabic:
حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ حُجْرٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنْ هِشَامٍ الدَّسْتَوَائِيِّ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ أَبِي كَثِيرٍ، عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ  " ثَلاَثُ دَعَوَاتٍ مُسْتَجَابَاتٌ لاَ شَكَّ فِيهِنَّ دَعْوَةُ الْمَظْلُومِ وَدَعْوَةُ الْمُسَافِرِ وَدَعْوَةُ الْوَالِدِ عَلَى وَلَدِهِ " . 

قَالَ أَبُو عِيسَى وَقَدْ رَوَى الْحَجَّاجُ الصَّوَّافُ هَذَا الْحَدِيثَ عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ أَبِي كَثِيرٍ نَحْوَ حَدِيثِ هِشَامٍ . وَأَبُو جَعْفَرٍ الَّذِي رَوَى عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ يُقَالُ لَهُ أَبُو جَعْفَرٍ الْمُؤَذِّنُ وَلاَ نَعْرِفُ اسْمَهُ وَقَدْ رَوَى عَنْهُ يَحْيَى بْنُ أَبِي كَثِيرٍ غَيْرَ حَدِيثٍ .
references: Vol. 4, Book of Righteousness And Maintaining Good Relations With Relatives, Hadith 1905

hadiths.title: Jami` at-Tirmidhi 1906

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ فِي حَقِّ الْوَالِدَيْنِ
chapter.englishTitle: What Has Been Related About Parent's Rights

hadiths.englishRaw:
Abu Hurairah narrated that:

the Messenger of Allah said: "A son could not  do enough for his father, unless he found him as a slave and purchased him to set him free."
hadiths.body: the Messenger of Allah said: "A son could not  do enough for his father, unless he found him as a slave and purchased him to set him free."
hadiths.arabic:
حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ مُوسَى، أَخْبَرَنَا جَرِيرٌ، عَنْ سُهَيْلِ بْنِ أَبِي صَالِحٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ  " لاَ يَجْزِي وَلَدٌ وَالِدًا إِلاَّ أَنْ يَجِدَهُ مَمْلُوكًا فَيَشْتَرِيَهُ فَيُعْتِقَهُ " . 

قَالَ أَبُو عِيسَى هَذَا حَدِيثٌ حَسَنٌ صَحِيحٌ لاَ نَعْرِفُهُ إِلاَّ مِنْ حَدِيثِ سُهَيْلِ بْنِ أَبِي صَالِحٍ . وَقَدْ رَوَى سُفْيَانُ الثَّوْرِيُّ وَغَيْرُ وَاحِدٍ عَنْ سُهَيْلِ بْنِ أَبِي صَالِحٍ هَذَا الْحَدِيثَ .
references: Vol. 4, Book of Righteousness And Maintaining Good Relations With Relatives, Hadith 1906

hadiths.title: Jami` at-Tirmidhi 1907

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ فِي قَطِيعَةِ الرَّحِمِ
chapter.englishTitle: What Has Been Related About Severing the Ties Of Kinship

hadiths.englishRaw:
Abu Salamah said:

" Abu[Ar-Raddad] Al-Laithi complained(of an illness). So 'Abdur-Rahman bin 'Awf  visited him. He said: 'The best of you, and the most apt to maintain good relations, as far as I know, is Abu Muhammad('Abdur-Rahman bin 'Awf). So 'Abdur-Rahman bin 'Awf' said: 'I heard the Messenger of Allah saying : "Allah, Most Blessed and Most High, said: 'I am Allah, and I am Ar-Rahman. I created the Rahim(womb), and named it after My Name. So whoever keeps good relations with it, I keep good relation with him, and whoever severs it, I am finished with him.'"
hadiths.body: " Abu[Ar-Raddad] Al-Laithi complained(of an illness). So 'Abdur-Rahman bin 'Awf  visited him. He said: 'The best of you, and the most apt to maintain good relations, as far as I know, is Abu Muhammad('Abdur-Rahman bin 'Awf). So 'Abdur-Rahman bin 'Awf' said: 'I heard the Messenger of Allah saying : "Allah, Most Blessed and Most High, said: 'I am Allah, and I am Ar-Rahman. I created the Rahim(womb), and named it after My Name. So whoever keeps good relations with it, I keep good relation with him, and whoever severs it, I am finished with him.'"
hadiths.arabic:
حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي عُمَرَ، وَسَعِيدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ الْمَخْزُومِيُّ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ، قَالَ اشْتَكَى أَبُو الرَّدَّادِ اللَّيْثِيُّ فَعَادَهُ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ عَوْفٍ فَقَالَ خَيْرُهُمْ وَأَوْصَلُهُمْ مَا عَلِمْتُ أَبَا مُحَمَّدٍ . فَقَالَ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ يَقُولُ  " قَالَ اللَّهُ أَنَا اللَّهُ وَأَنَا الرَّحْمَنُ خَلَقْتُ الرَّحِمَ وَشَقَقْتُ لَهَا مِنَ اسْمِي فَمَنْ وَصَلَهَا وَصَلْتُهُ وَمَنْ قَطَعَهَا بَتَتُّهُ " . وَفِي الْبَابِ عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ وَابْنِ أَبِي أَوْفَى وَعَامِرِ بْنِ رَبِيعَةَ وَأَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ وَجُبَيْرِ بْنِ مُطْعِمٍ . 

قَالَ أَبُو عِيسَى حَدِيثُ سُفْيَانَ عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ حَدِيثٌ صَحِيحٌ . وَرَوَى مَعْمَرٌ هَذَا الْحَدِيثَ عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ عَنْ رَدَّادٍ اللَّيْثِيِّ عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ عَوْفٍ وَمَعْمَرٌ كَذَا يَقُولُ قَالَ مُحَمَّدٌ وَحَدِيثُ مَعْمَرٍ خَطَأٌ .
references: Vol. 4, Book of Righteousness And Maintaining Good Relations With Relatives, Hadith 1907

hadiths.title: Jami` at-Tirmidhi 1908

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ فِي صِلَةِ الرَّحِمِ
chapter.englishTitle: What Has Been Related About Connecting The Ties Of Kinship

hadiths.englishRaw:
'Abdullah bin Amr narrated that:

the Prophet ﷺ said: "Merely maintaining the ties of kinship is not adequate. But connecting the ties of kinship is when his ties to the womb are severed and he connects it."
hadiths.body: the Prophet ﷺ said: "Merely maintaining the ties of kinship is not adequate. But connecting the ties of kinship is when his ties to the womb are severed and he connects it."
hadiths.arabic:
حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي عُمَرَ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، حَدَّثَنَا بَشِيرٌ أَبُو إِسْمَاعِيلَ، وَفِطْرُ بْنُ خَلِيفَةَ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَمْرٍو، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ  " لَيْسَ الْوَاصِلُ بِالْمُكَافِئِ وَلَكِنَّ الْوَاصِلَ الَّذِي إِذَا انْقَطَعَتْ رَحِمُهُ وَصَلَهَا " . 

قَالَ أَبُو عِيسَى هَذَا حَدِيثٌ حَسَنٌ صَحِيحٌ . وَفِي الْبَابِ عَنْ سَلْمَانَ وَعَائِشَةَ وَعَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ .
references: Vol. 4, Book of Righteousness And Maintaining Good Relations With Relatives, Hadith 1908

hadiths.title: Jami` at-Tirmidhi 1909

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ فِي صِلَةِ الرَّحِمِ
chapter.englishTitle: What Has Been Related About Connecting The Ties Of Kinship

hadiths.englishRaw:
Muhammad bin Jubair bin Mut'im narrated from his father, that:

the Messenger of Allah said: "The one who severs ties will not enter Paradise." Ibn Abi 'Umar said: "Sufyan said: 'Meaning: Ties of the womb."
hadiths.narrator: Muhammad bin Jubair bin Mut'im narrated from his father, that:
hadiths.body: the Messenger of Allah said: "The one who severs ties will not enter Paradise." Ibn Abi 'Umar said: "Sufyan said: 'Meaning: Ties of the womb."
hadiths.arabic:
حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي عُمَرَ، وَنَصْرُ بْنُ عَلِيٍّ، وَسَعِيدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ الْمَخْزُومِيُّ، قَالُوا حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرِ بْنِ مُطْعِمٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ  " لاَ يَدْخُلُ الْجَنَّةَ قَاطِعٌ " . قَالَ ابْنُ أَبِي عُمَرَ قَالَ سُفْيَانُ يَعْنِي قَاطِعَ رَحِمٍ . 

قَالَ أَبُو عِيسَى هَذَا حَدِيثٌ حَسَنٌ صَحِيحٌ .
references: Vol. 4, Book of Righteousness And Maintaining Good Relations With Relatives, Hadith 1909

hadiths.title: Jami` at-Tirmidhi 1910

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ فِي حُبِّ الْوَلَدِ
chapter.englishTitle: What Has Been Related About The Love Of A Parent For His Child

hadiths.englishRaw:
'Umar bin 'Abdul-'Aziz said:

'a righteous woman, Khawlah bint Hakim said: "The Messenger of Allah came out during the middle of the day, while holding one of the sons of his daughter in his arms. He was saying: 'You are what makes them stingy, cowardly and ignorant. And you are but Raihanillah
hadiths.body: 'a righteous woman, Khawlah bint Hakim said: "The Messenger of Allah came out during the middle of the day, while holding one of the sons of his daughter in his arms. He was saying: 'You are what makes them stingy, cowardly and ignorant. And you are but Raihanillah
hadiths.arabic:
حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي عُمَرَ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ مَيْسَرَةَ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ ابْنَ أَبِي سُوَيْدٍ، يَقُولُ سَمِعْتُ عُمَرَ بْنَ عَبْدِ الْعَزِيزِ، يَقُولُ زَعَمَتِ الْمَرْأَةُ الصَّالِحَةُ خَوْلَةُ بِنْتُ حَكِيمٍ قَالَتْ خَرَجَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ ذَاتَ يَوْمٍ وَهُوَ مُحْتَضِنٌ أَحَدَ ابْنَىِ ابْنَتِهِ وَهُوَ يَقُولُ  " إِنَّكُمْ لَتُبَخِّلُونَ وَتُجَبِّنُونَ وَتُجَهِّلُونَ وَإِنَّكُمْ لَمِنْ رَيْحَانِ اللَّهِ " . قَالَ وَفِي الْبَابِ عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ وَالأَشْعَثِ بْنِ قَيْسٍ . 

قَالَ أَبُو عِيسَى حَدِيثُ ابْنِ عُيَيْنَةَ عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ مَيْسَرَةَ لاَ نَعْرِفُهُ إِلاَّ مِنْ حَدِيثِهِ . وَلاَ نَعْرِفُ لِعُمَرَ بْنِ عَبْدِ الْعَزِيزِ سَمَاعًا مِنْ خَوْلَةَ .
references: Vol. 4, Book of Righteousness And Maintaining Good Relations With Relatives, Hadith 1910

hadiths.title: Jami` at-Tirmidhi 1911

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ فِي رَحْمَةِ الْوَلَدِ
chapter.englishTitle: What Has Been Related About Being Merciful With The Children

hadiths.englishRaw:
Abu Hurairah narrated:

"Al-Aqra' bin Habis saw the prophet kissing Al-Hasan"- Ibn Abi 'Umar (one of the narrators) said:"Al-Hasan and Al-Husain." So he said: 'I have ten children and I do not kiss any one of them.' So the Messenger of Allah said: 'Whoever shows no mercy, he will be shown no mercy."
hadiths.body: "Al-Aqra' bin Habis saw the prophet kissing Al-Hasan"- Ibn Abi 'Umar (one of the narrators) said:"Al-Hasan and Al-Husain." So he said: 'I have ten children and I do not kiss any one of them.' So the Messenger of Allah said: 'Whoever shows no mercy, he will be shown no mercy."
hadiths.arabic:
حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي عُمَرَ، وَسَعِيدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ أَبْصَرَ الأَقْرَعُ بْنُ حَابِسٍ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ وَهُوَ يُقَبِّلُ الْحَسَنَ قَالَ ابْنُ أَبِي عُمَرَ الْحُسَيْنَ أَوِ الْحَسَنَ فَقَالَ إِنَّ لِي مِنَ الْوَلَدِ عَشَرَةً مَا قَبَّلْتُ أَحَدًا مِنْهُمْ . فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ  " إِنَّهُ مَنْ لاَ يَرْحَمْ لاَ يُرْحَمْ " . قَالَ وَفِي الْبَابِ عَنْ أَنَسٍ وَعَائِشَةَ . 

قَالَ أَبُو عِيسَى وَأَبُو سَلَمَةَ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ اسْمُهُ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ عَوْفٍ . وَهَذَا حَدِيثٌ حَسَنٌ صَحِيحٌ .
references: Vol. 4, Book of Righteousness And Maintaining Good Relations With Relatives, Hadith 1911

hadiths.title: Jami` at-Tirmidhi 1912

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ فِي النَّفَقَةِ عَلَى الْبَنَاتِ وَالأَخَوَاتِ
chapter.englishTitle: What Has Been Related About Spending on Daughters And Sisters

hadiths.englishRaw:
Abu Sa'eed Al-Khudri narrated that :

the Messenger of Allah said: "There is no one who has three daughters, or three sisters, and he treats them well, except that he enters paradise."
hadiths.body: the Messenger of Allah said: "There is no one who has three daughters, or three sisters, and he treats them well, except that he enters paradise."
hadiths.arabic:
حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، عَنْ سُهَيْلِ بْنِ أَبِي صَالِحٍ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيِّ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ قَالَ  " لاَ يَكُونُ لأَحَدِكُمْ ثَلاَثُ بَنَاتٍ أَوْ ثَلاَثُ أَخَوَاتٍ فَيُحْسِنُ إِلَيْهِنَّ إِلاَّ دَخَلَ الْجَنَّةَ " . قَالَ وَفِي الْبَابِ عَنْ عَائِشَةَ وَعُقْبَةَ بْنِ عَامِرٍ وَأَنَسٍ وَجَابِرٍ وَابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ . 

قَالَ أَبُو عِيسَى وَأَبُو سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيُّ اسْمُهُ سَعْدُ بْنُ مَالِكِ بْنِ سِنَانٍ وَسَعْدُ بْنُ أَبِي وَقَّاصٍ هُوَ سَعْدُ بْنُ مَالِكِ بْنِ وُهَيْبٍ . وَقَدْ زَادُوا فِي هَذَا الإِسْنَادِ رَجُلاً .
references: Vol. 4, Book of Righteousness And Maintaining Good Relations With Relatives, Hadith 1912

hadiths.title: Jami` at-Tirmidhi 1913

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ فِي النَّفَقَةِ عَلَى الْبَنَاتِ وَالأَخَوَاتِ
chapter.englishTitle: What Has Been Related About Spending on Daughters And Sisters

hadiths.englishRaw:
Aishah narrated that the:

Messenger of Allah said:"Whoever is tried with something from daughters, and he is patient with them, they will be a barrier from the Fire for him."
hadiths.body: Messenger of Allah said:"Whoever is tried with something from daughters, and he is patient with them, they will be a barrier from the Fire for him."
hadiths.arabic:
حَدَّثَنَا الْعَلاَءُ بْنُ مَسْلَمَةَ الْبَغْدَادِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْمَجِيدِ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْعَزِيزِ، عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ عُرْوَةَ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، قَالَتْ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ  " مَنِ ابْتُلِيَ بِشَيْءٍ مِنَ الْبَنَاتِ فَصَبَرَ عَلَيْهِنَّ كُنَّ لَهُ حِجَابًا مِنَ النَّارِ " . 

قَالَ أَبُو عِيسَى هَذَا حَدِيثٌ حَسَنٌ .
references: Vol. 4, Book of Righteousness And Maintaining Good Relations With Relatives, Hadith 1913

hadiths.title: Jami` at-Tirmidhi 1914

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ فِي النَّفَقَةِ عَلَى الْبَنَاتِ وَالأَخَوَاتِ
chapter.englishTitle: What Has Been Related About Spending on Daughters And Sisters

hadiths.englishRaw:
Abu Bakr bin 'Ubaidullah bin Anas bin Malik narrated [from Anas] that:

the Messenger of Allah said: "Whoever raises two girls then I and he will enter Paradise like these two." And he indicated with his two fingers.
hadiths.narrator: Abu Bakr bin 'Ubaidullah bin Anas bin Malik narrated [from Anas] that:
hadiths.body: the Messenger of Allah said: "Whoever raises two girls then I and he will enter Paradise like these two." And he indicated with his two fingers.
hadiths.arabic:
حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ وَزِيرٍ الْوَاسِطِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عُبَيْدٍ، هُوَ الطَّنَافِسِيُّ حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْعَزِيزِ الرَّاسِبِيُّ، عَنْ أَبِي بَكْرِ بْنِ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ  " مَنْ عَالَ جَارِيَتَيْنِ دَخَلْتُ أَنَا وَهُوَ الْجَنَّةَ كَهَاتَيْنِ " . وَأَشَارَ بِأَصْبُعَيْهِ . 

قَالَ أَبُو عِيسَى هَذَا حَدِيثٌ حَسَنٌ غَرِيبٌ مِنْ هَذَا الْوَجْهِ . وَقَدْ رَوَى مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عُبَيْدٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الْعَزِيزِ غَيْرَ حَدِيثٍ بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ وَقَالَ عَنْ أَبِي بَكْرِ بْنِ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَنَسٍ وَالصَّحِيحُ هُوَ عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ أَبِي بَكْرِ بْنِ أَنَسٍ .
references: Vol. 4, Book of Righteousness And Maintaining Good Relations With Relatives, Hadith 1914

hadiths.title: Jami` at-Tirmidhi 1915

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ فِي النَّفَقَةِ عَلَى الْبَنَاتِ وَالأَخَوَاتِ
chapter.englishTitle: What Has Been Related About Spending on Daughters And Sisters

hadiths.englishRaw:
Aishah said:

"A woman came to me with two daughters. She was asking (for food) but I did not have anything with me except a date. So I gave it to her and she divided it between  her two daughters without eating any of it herself. Then she got up to leave, and the Prophet entered, and I informed him about her. So the Prophet ﷺ said: " Whoever is tested something from these daughters (and he/she passes the test), they will be a screen for them from the Fire."
hadiths.body: "A woman came to me with two daughters. She was asking (for food) but I did not have anything with me except a date. So I gave it to her and she divided it between  her two daughters without eating any of it herself. Then she got up to leave, and the Prophet entered, and I informed him about her. So the Prophet ﷺ said: " Whoever is tested something from these daughters (and he/she passes the test), they will be a screen for them from the Fire."
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ الْمُبَارَكِ، أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ أَبِي بَكْرِ بْنِ حَزْمٍ، عَنْ عُرْوَةَ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، قَالَتْ دَخَلَتِ امْرَأَةٌ مَعَهَا ابْنَتَانِ لَهَا فَسَأَلَتْ فَلَمْ تَجِدْ عِنْدِي شَيْئًا غَيْرَ تَمْرَةٍ فَأَعْطَيْتُهَا إِيَّاهَا فَقَسَمَتْهَا بَيْنَ ابْنَتَيْهَا وَلَمْ تَأْكُلْ مِنْهَا ثُمَّ قَامَتْ فَخَرَجَتْ فَدَخَلَ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ فَأَخْبَرْتُهُ فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ  " مَنِ ابْتُلِيَ بِشَيْءٍ مِنْ هَذِهِ الْبَنَاتِ كُنَّ لَهُ سِتْرًا مِنَ النَّارِ " . هَذَا حَدِيثٌ حَسَنٌ صَحِيحٌ .
references: Vol. 4, Book of Righteousness And Maintaining Good Relations With Relatives, Hadith 1915

hadiths.title: Jami` at-Tirmidhi 1916

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ فِي النَّفَقَةِ عَلَى الْبَنَاتِ وَالأَخَوَاتِ
chapter.englishTitle: What Has Been Related About Spending on Daughters And Sisters

hadiths.englishRaw:
Abu Sa'eed Al-Khudri narrated that :

the Messenger of Allah said: "Whoever has three daughters, or three sisters, or two daughters, or two sisters and he keeps good company with them and fears Allah regarding them, then Paradise is for him.
hadiths.body: the Messenger of Allah said: "Whoever has three daughters, or three sisters, or two daughters, or two sisters and he keeps good company with them and fears Allah regarding them, then Paradise is for him.
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ الْمُبَارَكِ، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، عَنْ سُهَيْلِ بْنِ أَبِي صَالِحٍ، عَنْ أَيُّوبَ بْنِ بَشِيرٍ، عَنْ سَعِيدٍ الأَعْشَى، عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيِّ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ  " مَنْ كَانَ لَهُ ثَلاَثُ بَنَاتٍ أَوْ ثَلاَثُ أَخَوَاتٍ أَوِ ابْنَتَانِ أَوْ أُخْتَانِ فَأَحْسَنَ صُحْبَتَهُنَّ وَاتَّقَى اللَّهَ فِيهِنَّ فَلَهُ الْجَنَّةُ " . قَالَ هَذَا حَدِيثٌ غَرِيبٌ .
references: Vol. 4, Book of Righteousness And Maintaining Good Relations With Relatives, Hadith 1916

hadiths.title: Jami` at-Tirmidhi 1917

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ فِي رَحْمَةِ الْيَتِيمِ وَكَفَالَتِهِ
chapter.englishTitle: What Has Been Related About Being Merciful With The Orphan And Raising Him

hadiths.englishRaw:
Ibn 'Abbas narrated that:

the Prophet ﷺ said: Whoever takes in an orphan among the Muslims to raise, to feed him and give him drink, Allah admits him into Paradise without a doubt, unless he has done a sin for which he is not forgiven."
hadiths.body: the Prophet ﷺ said: Whoever takes in an orphan among the Muslims to raise, to feed him and give him drink, Allah admits him into Paradise without a doubt, unless he has done a sin for which he is not forgiven."
hadiths.arabic:
حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ يَعْقُوبَ الطَّالْقَانِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا الْمُعْتَمِرُ بْنُ سُلَيْمَانَ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبِي يُحَدِّثُ، عَنْ حَنَشٍ، عَنْ عِكْرِمَةَ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ قَالَ  " مَنْ قَبَضَ يَتِيمًا بَيْنَ الْمُسْلِمِينَ إِلَى طَعَامِهِ وَشَرَابِهِ أَدْخَلَهُ اللَّهُ الْجَنَّةَ الْبَتَّةَ إِلاَّ أَنْ يَعْمَلَ ذَنْبًا لاَ يُغْفَرُ لَهُ " . قَالَ وَفِي الْبَابِ عَنْ مُرَّةَ الْفِهْرِيِّ وَأَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ وَأَبِي أُمَامَةَ وَسَهْلِ بْنِ سَعْدٍ . 

قَالَ أَبُو عِيسَى وَحَنَشٌ هُوَ حُسَيْنُ بْنُ قَيْسٍ وَهُوَ أَبُو عَلِيٍّ الرَّحَبِيُّ وَسُلَيْمَانُ التَّيْمِيُّ يَقُولُ حَنَشٌ وَهُوَ ضَعِيفٌ عِنْدَ أَهْلِ الْحَدِيثِ .
references: Vol. 4, Book of Righteousness And Maintaining Good Relations With Relatives, Hadith 1917

hadiths.title: Jami` at-Tirmidhi 1918

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ فِي رَحْمَةِ الْيَتِيمِ وَكَفَالَتِهِ
chapter.englishTitle: What Has Been Related About Being Merciful With The Orphan And Raising Him

hadiths.englishRaw:
Sahl bin Sa'd narrated that:

the Messenger of Allah said: " I and the sponsor of an orphan shall be in Paradise like these two."And he indicaed with his fingers, meaning his index and his middle finger
hadiths.body: the Messenger of Allah said: " I and the sponsor of an orphan shall be in Paradise like these two."And he indicaed with his fingers, meaning his index and his middle finger
hadiths.arabic:
حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عِمْرَانَ أَبُو الْقَاسِمِ الْمَكِّيُّ الْقُرَشِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ بْنُ أَبِي حَازِمٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ سَهْلِ بْنِ سَعْدٍ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ  " أَنَا وَكَافِلُ الْيَتِيمِ فِي الْجَنَّةِ كَهَاتَيْنِ " . وَأَشَارَ بِأُصْبُعَيْهِ يَعْنِي السَّبَّابَةَ وَالْوُسْطَى . 

قَالَ أَبُو عِيسَى هَذَا حَدِيثٌ حَسَنٌ صَحِيحٌ .
references: Vol. 4, Book of Righteousness And Maintaining Good Relations With Relatives, Hadith 1918

hadiths.title: Jami` at-Tirmidhi 1919

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ فِي رَحْمَةِ الصِّبْيَانِ
chapter.englishTitle: What Has Been Related About Being Merciful With Boys

hadiths.englishRaw:
Anas bin Malik  narrated that:

"An older man came to talk to the Prophet, and the people were hesitant to make room for him. The Prophet ﷺ said: ;He is not one of us who does not have mercy on our young and does not respect our elders."
hadiths.body: "An older man came to talk to the Prophet, and the people were hesitant to make room for him. The Prophet ﷺ said: ;He is not one of us who does not have mercy on our young and does not respect our elders."
hadiths.arabic:
حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ مَرْزُوقٍ الْبَصْرِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ بْنُ وَاقِدٍ، عَنْ زَرْبِيٍّ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَنَسَ بْنَ مَالِكٍ، يَقُولُ جَاءَ شَيْخٌ يُرِيدُ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ فَأَبْطَأَ الْقَوْمُ عَنْهُ أَنْ يُوَسِّعُوا لَهُ فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ  " لَيْسَ مِنَّا مَنْ لَمْ يَرْحَمْ صَغِيرَنَا وَيُوَقِّرْ كَبِيرَنَا " . قَالَ وَفِي الْبَابِ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَمْرٍو وَأَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ وَابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ وَأَبِي أُمَامَةَ . 

قَالَ أَبُو عِيسَى هَذَا حَدِيثٌ غَرِيبٌ . وَزَرْبِيٌّ لَهُ أَحَادِيثُ مَنَاكِيرُ عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ وَغَيْرِهِ .
references: Vol. 4, Book of Righteousness And Maintaining Good Relations With Relatives, Hadith 1919

hadiths.title: Jami` at-Tirmidhi 1920

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ فِي رَحْمَةِ الصِّبْيَانِ
chapter.englishTitle: What Has Been Related About Being Merciful With Boys

hadiths.englishRaw:
Amr bin Shu'aib  narrated that his father, from his grandfather, who said that the Messenger of Allah said:

'He is not one of us who does not have mercy upon our young, nor knows the honor of our elders."
hadiths.narrator: Amr bin Shu'aib  narrated that his father, from his grandfather, who said that the Messenger of Allah said:
hadiths.body: 'He is not one of us who does not have mercy upon our young, nor knows the honor of our elders."
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرٍ، مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَبَانَ حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ فُضَيْلٍ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ إِسْحَاقَ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ شُعَيْبٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ جَدِّهِ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ " لَيْسَ مِنَّا مَنْ لَمْ يَرْحَمْ صَغِيرَنَا وَيَعْرِفْ شَرَفَ كَبِيرِنَا " .  حَدَّثَنَا هَنَّادٌ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدَةُ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ إِسْحَاقَ، نَحْوَهُ إِلاَّ أَنَّهُ قَالَ " وَيَعْرِفْ حَقَّ كَبِيرِنَا " .
references: Vol. 4, Book of Righteousness And Maintaining Good Relations With Relatives, Hadith 1920

hadiths.title: Jami` at-Tirmidhi 1921

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ فِي رَحْمَةِ الصِّبْيَانِ
chapter.englishTitle: What Has Been Related About Being Merciful With Boys

hadiths.englishRaw:
Ibn Abbas narrated that the Messenger of Allah said:

" He is not one of us who does not have mercy upon our young, respect our elders, and command good and forbid evil."
hadiths.narrator: Ibn Abbas narrated that the Messenger of Allah said:
hadiths.body: " He is not one of us who does not have mercy upon our young, respect our elders, and command good and forbid evil."
hadiths.arabic:
حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرٍ، مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَبَانَ حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ، عَنْ شَرِيكٍ، عَنْ لَيْثٍ، عَنْ عِكْرِمَةَ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ " لَيْسَ مِنَّا مَنْ لَمْ يَرْحَمْ صَغِيرَنَا وَيُوَقِّرْ كَبِيرَنَا وَيَأْمُرْ بِالْمَعْرُوفِ وَيَنْهَ عَنِ الْمُنْكَرِ " . 

قَالَ أَبُو عِيسَى هَذَا حَدِيثٌ حَسَنٌ غَرِيبٌ . وَحَدِيثُ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ إِسْحَاقَ عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ شُعَيْبٍ حَدِيثٌ حَسَنٌ صَحِيحٌ وَقَدْ رُوِيَ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَمْرٍو مِنْ غَيْرِ هَذَا الْوَجْهِ أَيْضًا . - قَالَ بَعْضُ أَهْلِ الْعِلْمِ مَعْنَى قَوْلِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ " لَيْسَ مِنَّا " . يَقُولُ لَيْسَ مِنْ سُنَّتِنَا يَقُولُ لَيْسَ مِنْ أَدَبِنَا . وَقَالَ عَلِيُّ بْنُ الْمَدِينِيِّ قَالَ يَحْيَى بْنُ سَعِيدٍ كَانَ سُفْيَانُ الثَّوْرِيُّ يُنْكِرُ هَذَا التَّفْسِيرَ لَيْسَ مِنَّا يَقُولُ لَيْسَ مِثْلَنَا .
references: Vol. 4, Book of Righteousness And Maintaining Good Relations With Relatives, Hadith 1921

hadiths.title: Jami` at-Tirmidhi 1922

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ فِي رَحْمَةِ الْمُسْلِمِينَ
chapter.englishTitle: What Has Been Related About Being Merciful With People

hadiths.englishRaw:
Jarir bin Abdullah  narrated that the Messenger of Allah said:

"Whoever does not show mercy to the people, Allah will not show mercy to him."
hadiths.narrator: Jarir bin Abdullah  narrated that the Messenger of Allah said:
hadiths.body: "Whoever does not show mercy to the people, Allah will not show mercy to him."
hadiths.arabic:
حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ إِسْمَاعِيلَ بْنِ أَبِي خَالِدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا قَيْسُ بْنُ أَبِي حَازِمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ  " مَنْ لاَ يَرْحَمُ النَّاسَ لاَ يَرْحَمُهُ اللَّهُ " . 

قَالَ أَبُو عِيسَى هَذَا حَدِيثٌ حَسَنٌ صَحِيحٌ . قَالَ وَفِي الْبَابِ عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ عَوْفٍ وَأَبِي سَعِيدٍ وَابْنِ عُمَرَ وَأَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ وَعَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَمْرٍو .
references: Vol. 4, Book of Righteousness And Maintaining Good Relations With Relatives, Hadith 1922

hadiths.title: Jami` at-Tirmidhi 1923

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ فِي رَحْمَةِ الْمُسْلِمِينَ
chapter.englishTitle: What Has Been Related About Being Merciful With People

hadiths.englishRaw:
Abu Hurairah narrated that Abul- Qasim said:

"Mercy is  not removed  (from anyone) except from a wicked one."
hadiths.narrator: Abu Hurairah narrated that Abul- Qasim said:
hadiths.body: "Mercy is  not removed  (from anyone) except from a wicked one."
hadiths.arabic:
حَدَّثَنَا مَحْمُودُ بْنُ غَيْلاَنَ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ، أَخْبَرَنَا شُعْبَةُ، قَالَ كَتَبَ بِهِ إِلَىَّ مَنْصُورٌ وَقَرَأْتُهُ عَلَيْهِ سَمِعَ أَبَا عُثْمَانَ مَوْلَى الْمُغِيرَةِ بْنِ شُعْبَةَ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا الْقَاسِمِ ﷺ يَقُولُ  " لاَ تُنْزَعُ الرَّحْمَةُ إِلاَّ مِنْ شَقِيٍّ " . قَالَ وَأَبُو عُثْمَانَ الَّذِي رَوَى عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ لاَ يُعْرَفُ اسْمُهُ وَيُقَالُ هُوَ وَالِدُ مُوسَى بْنِ أَبِي عُثْمَانَ الَّذِي رَوَى عَنْهُ أَبُو الزِّنَادِ وَقَدْ رَوَى أَبُو الزِّنَادِ عَنْ مُوسَى بْنِ أَبِي عُثْمَانَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ غَيْرَ حَدِيثٍ . 

قَالَ أَبُو عِيسَى هَذَا حَدِيثٌ حَسَنٌ .
references: Vol. 4, Book of Righteousness And Maintaining Good Relations With Relatives, Hadith 1923

hadiths.title: Jami` at-Tirmidhi 1924

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ فِي رَحْمَةِ الْمُسْلِمِينَ
chapter.englishTitle: What Has Been Related About Being Merciful With People

hadiths.englishRaw:
Abdullah bin 'Amr narrated that the Messenger of Allah said:

" The merciful are shown mercy by Ar-Rahman. Be merciful on the earth, and you will be shown mercy from Who is above the heavens. The womb is named after  Ar-Rahman, so whoever connects it, Allah connects him, and whoever severs it, Allah severs him."
hadiths.narrator: Abdullah bin 'Amr narrated that the Messenger of Allah said:
hadiths.body: " The merciful are shown mercy by Ar-Rahman. Be merciful on the earth, and you will be shown mercy from Who is above the heavens. The womb is named after  Ar-Rahman, so whoever connects it, Allah connects him, and whoever severs it, Allah severs him."
hadiths.arabic:
حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي عُمَرَ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ دِينَارٍ، عَنْ أَبِي قَابُوسَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَمْرٍو، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ  " الرَّاحِمُونَ يَرْحَمُهُمُ الرَّحْمَنُ ارْحَمُوا مَنْ فِي الأَرْضِ يَرْحَمْكُمْ مَنْ فِي السَّمَاءِ الرَّحِمُ شُجْنَةٌ مِنَ الرَّحْمَنِ فَمَنْ وَصَلَهَا وَصَلَهُ اللَّهُ وَمَنْ قَطَعَهَا قَطَعَهُ اللَّهُ " . 

قَالَ أَبُو عِيسَى هَذَا حَدِيثٌ حَسَنٌ صَحِيحٌ .
references: Vol. 4, Book of Righteousness And Maintaining Good Relations With Relatives, Hadith 1924

hadiths.title: Jami` at-Tirmidhi 1925

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ فِي النَّصِيحَةِ
chapter.englishTitle: (What Has Been Related) About An-Nasihah

hadiths.englishRaw:
Jarir  bin 'Abdullah narrated :

" I pledged to the Prophet to establish the Salat, give the Zakat,  and to give sincere advice to every Muslim."
hadiths.body: " I pledged to the Prophet to establish the Salat, give the Zakat,  and to give sincere advice to every Muslim."
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ إِسْمَاعِيلَ بْنِ أَبِي خَالِدٍ، عَنْ قَيْسِ بْنِ أَبِي حَازِمٍ، عَنْ جَرِيرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ بَايَعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ عَلَى إِقَامِ الصَّلاَةِ وَإِيتَاءِ الزَّكَاةِ وَالنُّصْحِ لِكُلِّ مُسْلِمٍ . قَالَ هَذَا حَدِيثٌ حَسَنٌ صَحِيحٌ .
references: Vol. 4, Book of Righteousness And Maintaining Good Relations With Relatives, Hadith 1925

hadiths.title: Jami` at-Tirmidhi 1926

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ فِي النَّصِيحَةِ
chapter.englishTitle: (What Has Been Related) About An-Nasihah

hadiths.englishRaw:
Abu Hurairah narrated that:

the Messenger of Allah said: "The religion is An-Nasihah" three times. They said: "O Messenger of Allah! For Whom?" He said : "To Allah , His books, the A'immah of the Muslims, and their average people."
hadiths.body: the Messenger of Allah said: "The religion is An-Nasihah" three times. They said: "O Messenger of Allah! For Whom?" He said : "To Allah , His books, the A'immah of the Muslims, and their average people."
hadiths.arabic:
حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ، حَدَّثَنَا صَفْوَانُ بْنُ عِيسَى، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَجْلاَنَ، عَنِ الْقَعْقَاعِ بْنِ حَكِيمٍ، عَنْ أَبِي صَالِحٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ " الدِّينُ النَّصِيحَةُ " . ثَلاَثَ مِرَارٍ . قَالُوا يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ لِمَنْ قَالَ " لِلَّهِ وَلِكِتَابِهِ وَلأَئِمَّةِ الْمُسْلِمِينَ وَعَامَّتِهِمْ " . 

قَالَ أَبُو عِيسَى هَذَا حَدِيثٌ حَسَنٌ صَحِيحٌ . وَفِي الْبَابِ عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ وَتَمِيمٍ الدَّارِيِّ وَجَرِيرٍ وَحَكِيمِ بْنِ أَبِي يَزِيدَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ وَثَوْبَانَ .
references: Vol. 4, Book of Righteousness And Maintaining Good Relations With Relatives, Hadith 1926

hadiths.title: Jami` at-Tirmidhi 1927

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ فِي شَفَقَةِ الْمُسْلِمِ عَلَى الْمُسْلِمِ
chapter.englishTitle: What Has Been Related About The Muslim's Compassion For the Muslim

hadiths.englishRaw:
Abu Hurairah narrated that the Messenger of Allah said:

"The Muslim is the brother to the Muslim, he does not cheat him, lie to him, nor deceive him. All of the Muslim is unlawful to another Muslim: His Honor, his wealth, and his blood. At-taqwa is here (meaning in the heart). It is enough evil for a man that he belittle his brother Muslim."
hadiths.narrator: Abu Hurairah narrated that the Messenger of Allah said:
hadiths.body: "The Muslim is the brother to the Muslim, he does not cheat him, lie to him, nor deceive him. All of the Muslim is unlawful to another Muslim: His Honor, his wealth, and his blood. At-taqwa is here (meaning in the heart). It is enough evil for a man that he belittle his brother Muslim."
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ بْنُ أَسْبَاطِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ الْقُرَشِيُّ، حَدَّثَنِي أَبِي، عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ سَعْدٍ، عَنْ زَيْدِ بْنِ أَسْلَمَ، عَنْ أَبِي صَالِحٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ  " الْمُسْلِمُ أَخُو الْمُسْلِمِ لاَ يَخُونُهُ وَلاَ يَكْذِبُهُ وَلاَ يَخْذُلُهُ كُلُّ الْمُسْلِمِ عَلَى الْمُسْلِمِ حَرَامٌ عِرْضُهُ وَمَالُهُ وَدَمُهُ التَّقْوَى هَا هُنَا بِحَسْبِ امْرِئٍ مِنَ الشَّرِّ أَنْ يَحْتَقِرَ أَخَاهُ الْمُسْلِمَ " . قَالَ أَبُو عِيسَى هَذَا حَدِيثٌ حَسَنٌ غَرِيبٌ . وَفِي الْبَابِ عَنْ عَلِيٍّ وَأَبِي أَيُّوبَ .
references: Vol. 4, Book of Righteousness And Maintaining Good Relations With Relatives, Hadith 1927

hadiths.title: Jami` at-Tirmidhi 1928

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ فِي شَفَقَةِ الْمُسْلِمِ عَلَى الْمُسْلِمِ
chapter.englishTitle: What Has Been Related About The Muslim's Compassion For the Muslim

hadiths.englishRaw:
Abu Musa Al-Ash'arf narrated that the Messenger of Allah said:

:
The believer is to the believer like parts of a building, each one of them supporting the other."
hadiths.narrator: Abu Musa Al-Ash'arf narrated that the Messenger of Allah said:
hadiths.body:
:
The believer is to the believer like parts of a building, each one of them supporting the other."
hadiths.arabic:
حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ بْنُ عَلِيٍّ الْخَلاَّلُ، وَغَيْرُ، وَاحِدٍ، قَالُوا حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أُسَامَةَ، عَنْ بُرَيْدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي بُرْدَةَ، عَنْ جَدِّهِ أَبِي بُرْدَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي مُوسَى الأَشْعَرِيِّ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ  " الْمُؤْمِنُ لِلْمُؤْمِنِ كَالْبُنْيَانِ يَشُدُّ بَعْضُهُ بَعْضًا " . 

قَالَ أَبُو عِيسَى هَذَا حَدِيثٌ حَسَنٌ صَحِيحٌ .
references: Vol. 4, Book of Righteousness And Maintaining Good Relations With Relatives, Hadith 1928

hadiths.title: Jami` at-Tirmidhi 1929

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ فِي شَفَقَةِ الْمُسْلِمِ عَلَى الْمُسْلِمِ
chapter.englishTitle: What Has Been Related About The Muslim's Compassion For the Muslim

hadiths.englishRaw:
Abu Hurairah narrated that the Messenger of Allah said:

:
"Indeed (each) one of you is the reflection of his brother. So if he sees something harmful in him, then let him remove it from him."
hadiths.narrator: Abu Hurairah narrated that the Messenger of Allah said:
hadiths.body:
:
"Indeed (each) one of you is the reflection of his brother. So if he sees something harmful in him, then let him remove it from him."
hadiths.arabic:
حَدَّثَنِي أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ الْمُبَارَكِ، أَخْبَرَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ  " إِنَّ أَحَدَكُمْ مِرْآةُ أَخِيهِ فَإِنْ رَأَى بِهِ أَذًى فَلْيُمِطْهُ عَنْهُ " . 

قَالَ أَبُو عِيسَى وَيَحْيَى بْنُ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ ضَعَّفَهُ شُعْبَةُ . قَالَ وَفِي الْبَابِ عَنْ أَنَسٍ .
references: Vol. 4, Book of Righteousness And Maintaining Good Relations With Relatives, Hadith 1929

hadiths.title: Jami` at-Tirmidhi 1930

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ فِي السَّتْرِ عَلَى الْمُسْلِمِ
chapter.englishTitle: What Has Been Related About Covering(The Faults) Of The Muslims

hadiths.englishRaw:
Abu Hurairah narrated that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:

"Whoever relieves a Muslim of a burden from the burdens of the world, Allah will relieve him of a burden from the burdens on the Day of Judgement. And whoever helps ease a difficulty in the world, Allah will grant him ease from a difficulty in the world and in the Hereafter. And whoever covers (the faults of) a Muslim, Allah will cover (his faults) for him in the world and the Hereafter. And Allah is engaged in helping the worshipper as long as the worshipper is engaged in helping his brother."
hadiths.narrator: Abu Hurairah narrated that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
hadiths.body: "Whoever relieves a Muslim of a burden from the burdens of the world, Allah will relieve him of a burden from the burdens on the Day of Judgement. And whoever helps ease a difficulty in the world, Allah will grant him ease from a difficulty in the world and in the Hereafter. And whoever covers (the faults of) a Muslim, Allah will cover (his faults) for him in the world and the Hereafter. And Allah is engaged in helping the worshipper as long as the worshipper is engaged in helping his brother."
hadiths.arabic:
حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ بْنُ أَسْبَاطِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ الْقُرَشِيُّ، حَدَّثَنِي أَبِي، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، قَالَ حُدِّثْتُ عَنْ أَبِي صَالِحٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ  " مَنْ نَفَّسَ عَنْ مُسْلِمٍ كُرْبَةً مِنْ كُرَبِ الدُّنْيَا نَفَّسَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ كُرْبَةً مِنْ كُرَبِ يَوْمِ الْقِيَامَةِ وَمَنْ يَسَّرَ عَلَى مُعْسِرٍ فِي الدُّنْيَا يَسَّرَ اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ فِي الدُّنْيَا وَالآخِرَةِ وَمَنْ سَتَرَ عَلَى مُسْلِمٍ فِي الدُّنْيَا سَتَرَ اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ فِي الدُّنْيَا وَالآخِرَةِ وَاللَّهُ فِي عَوْنِ الْعَبْدِ مَا كَانَ الْعَبْدُ فِي عَوْنِ أَخِيهِ " . قَالَ وَفِي الْبَابِ عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ وَعُقْبَةَ بْنِ عَامِرٍ . 

قَالَ أَبُو عِيسَى هَذَا حَدِيثٌ حَسَنٌ . وَقَدْ رَوَى أَبُو عَوَانَةَ وَغَيْرُ وَاحِدٍ هَذَا الْحَدِيثَ عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ عَنْ أَبِي صَالِحٍ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ نَحْوَهُ وَلَمْ يَذْكُرُوا فِيهِ حُدِّثْتُ عَنْ أَبِي صَالِحٍ .
references: Vol. 4, Book of Righteousness And Maintaining Good Relations With Relatives, Hadith 1930

hadiths.title: Jami` at-Tirmidhi 1931

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ فِي الذَّبِّ عَنْ عِرْضِ الْمُسْلِمِ
chapter.englishTitle: What Has Been Related About Defending (The Honor Of) The Muslim

hadiths.englishRaw:
Abu Ad-Darda narrated that the Messenger of Allah said:

"Whoever protects his brother's honor, Allah protects his face from the Fire on the Day of Resurrection."
hadiths.narrator: Abu Ad-Darda narrated that the Messenger of Allah said:
hadiths.body: "Whoever protects his brother's honor, Allah protects his face from the Fire on the Day of Resurrection."
hadiths.arabic:
حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ الْمُبَارَكِ، عَنْ أَبِي بَكْرٍ النَّهْشَلِيِّ، عَنْ مَرْزُوقٍ أَبِي بَكْرٍ التَّيْمِيِّ، عَنْ أُمِّ الدَّرْدَاءِ، عَنْ أَبِي الدَّرْدَاءِ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ  " مَنْ رَدَّ عَنْ عِرْضِ أَخِيهِ رَدَّ اللَّهُ عَنْ وَجْهِهِ النَّارَ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ " . قَالَ وَفِي الْبَابِ عَنْ أَسْمَاءَ بِنْتِ يَزِيدَ . 

قَالَ أَبُو عِيسَى هَذَا حَدِيثٌ حَسَنٌ .
references: Vol. 4, Book of Righteousness And Maintaining Good Relations With Relatives, Hadith 1931

hadiths.title: Jami` at-Tirmidhi 1932

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ فِي كَرَاهِيَةِ الْهَجْرِ لِلْمُسْلِمِ
chapter.englishTitle: What Has Been Related About Shunning (The Muslim) Being Disliked

hadiths.englishRaw:
Abu Ayyub Al-Ansari narrated that the Messenger of Allah said:

:
It is not lawful for the Muslim to shun his brother for more than three (days); they come fare to fare and this one turns away, and that one turns away. The best of them is the one who initiates the Salam."
hadiths.narrator: Abu Ayyub Al-Ansari narrated that the Messenger of Allah said:
hadiths.body:
:
It is not lawful for the Muslim to shun his brother for more than three (days); they come fare to fare and this one turns away, and that one turns away. The best of them is the one who initiates the Salam."
hadiths.arabic:
حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي عُمَرَ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، حَدَّثَنَا الزُّهْرِيُّ، ح قَالَ وَحَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ عَطَاءِ بْنِ يَزِيدَ اللَّيْثِيِّ، عَنْ أَبِي أَيُّوبَ الأَنْصَارِيِّ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ قَالَ  " لاَ يَحِلُّ لِمُسْلِمٍ أَنْ يَهْجُرَ أَخَاهُ فَوْقَ ثَلاَثٍ يَلْتَقِيَانِ فَيَصُدُّ هَذَا وَيَصُدُّ هَذَا وَخَيْرُهُمَا الَّذِي يَبْدَأُ بِالسَّلاَمِ " . قَالَ وَفِي الْبَابِ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ مَسْعُودٍ وَأَنَسٍ وَأَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ وَهِشَامِ بْنِ عَامِرٍ وَأَبِي هِنْدٍ الدَّارِيِّ . 

قَالَ أَبُو عِيسَى هَذَا حَدِيثٌ حَسَنٌ صَحِيحٌ .
references: Vol. 4, Book of Righteousness And Maintaining Good Relations With Relatives, Hadith 1932

hadiths.title: Jami` at-Tirmidhi 1933

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ فِي مُوَاسَاةِ الأَخِ
chapter.englishTitle: What Has Been Related About Consoling The Brother

hadiths.englishRaw:
Anas said:

:
"When 'Abdur-Rahman bin 'Awf arrived in Al-Madinah, the Messenger of Allah established a bond of brotherhood between him and sa'd bin Ar-Rabi. So he said to him: "Come here, I will divide my wealth and give you half, and I have two wives, I will divorce one of them, and when she completes her waiting period you may marry her." He said: " May Allah bless you in your family and your wealth. Show me where the market is." So they showed him where the market was and he did not return that day except with some cottage cheese and cooking fat which he had earned as a profit. The Messenger of Allah saw him after that, and he had traces of yellow on him. So he said to him: "What is this?" He said: "I married a woman from the Ansar." He said : " What dowry did you give her?" He said: " A date-stone(of gold) - ( one of the narrators) Humaid said: "Or he said: - gold equal to the weight of a date-stone." So he said: 'Have a banquet, even if with only a sheep."
hadiths.body:
:
"When 'Abdur-Rahman bin 'Awf arrived in Al-Madinah, the Messenger of Allah established a bond of brotherhood between him and sa'd bin Ar-Rabi. So he said to him: "Come here, I will divide my wealth and give you half, and I have two wives, I will divorce one of them, and when she completes her waiting period you may marry her." He said: " May Allah bless you in your family and your wealth. Show me where the market is." So they showed him where the market was and he did not return that day except with some cottage cheese and cooking fat which he had earned as a profit. The Messenger of Allah saw him after that, and he had traces of yellow on him. So he said to him: "What is this?" He said: "I married a woman from the Ansar." He said : " What dowry did you give her?" He said: " A date-stone(of gold) - ( one of the narrators) Humaid said: "Or he said: - gold equal to the weight of a date-stone." So he said: 'Have a banquet, even if with only a sheep."
hadiths.arabic:
حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مَنِيعٍ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، حَدَّثَنَا حُمَيْدٌ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ، قَالَ لَمَّا قَدِمَ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ عَوْفٍ الْمَدِينَةَ آخَى النَّبِيُّ ﷺ بَيْنَهُ وَبَيْنَ سَعْدِ بْنِ الرَّبِيعِ فَقَالَ لَهُ هَلُمَّ أُقَاسِمْكَ مَالِي نِصْفَيْنِ وَلِي امْرَأَتَانِ فَأُطَلِّقُ إِحْدَاهُمَا فَإِذَا انْقَضَتْ عِدَّتُهَا فَتَزَوَّجْهَا . فَقَالَ بَارَكَ اللَّهُ لَكَ فِي أَهْلِكَ وَمَالِكَ دُلُّونِي عَلَى السُّوقِ . فَدَلُّوهُ عَلَى السُّوقِ فَمَا رَجَعَ يَوْمَئِذٍ إِلاَّ وَمَعَهُ شَيْءٌ مِنْ أَقِطٍ وَسَمْنٍ قَدِ اسْتَفْضَلَهُ فَرَآهُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ بَعْدَ ذَلِكَ وَعَلَيْهِ وَضَرٌ مِنْ صُفْرَةٍ فَقَالَ " مَهْيَمْ " . قَالَ تَزَوَّجْتُ امْرَأَةً مِنَ الأَنْصَارِ . قَالَ " فَمَا أَصْدَقْتَهَا " . قَالَ نَوَاةً . قَالَ حُمَيْدٌ أَوْ قَالَ وَزْنَ نَوَاةٍ مِنْ ذَهَبٍ . فَقَالَ " أَوْلِمْ وَلَوْ بِشَاةٍ " . 

قَالَ أَبُو عِيسَى هَذَا حَدِيثٌ حَسَنٌ صَحِيحٌ . قَالَ أَحْمَدُ بْنُ حَنْبَلٍ وَزْنُ نَوَاةٍ مِنْ ذَهَبٍ وَزْنُ ثَلاَثَةِ دَرَاهِمَ وَثُلُثٍ . وَقَالَ إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ وَزْنُ نَوَاةٍ مِنْ ذَهَبٍ وَزْنُ خَمْسَةِ دَرَاهِمَ . سَمِعْتُ إِسْحَاقَ بْنَ مَنْصُورٍ يَذْكُرُ عَنْهُمَا هَذَا .
references: Vol. 4, Book of Righteousness And Maintaining Good Relations With Relatives, Hadith 1933

hadiths.title: Jami` at-Tirmidhi 1934

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ فِي الْغِيبَةِ
chapter.englishTitle: What Has Been Related About Backbiting

hadiths.englishRaw:
Abu Hurairah narrated that it was said:

" O  Messenger of Allah! What is backbiting?" He said : " Mentioning your brother with that which he does not like." He said " What if what I said about him is so?" He said: "If what you said about him is so, then you have backbitten him, and if it is not as you said, then you have slandered him."
hadiths.narrator: Abu Hurairah narrated that it was said:
hadiths.body: " O  Messenger of Allah! What is backbiting?" He said : " Mentioning your brother with that which he does not like." He said " What if what I said about him is so?" He said: "If what you said about him is so, then you have backbitten him, and if it is not as you said, then you have slandered him."
hadiths.arabic:
حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، عَنِ الْعَلاَءِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ قِيلَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ مَا الْغِيبَةُ قَالَ " ذِكْرُكَ أَخَاكَ بِمَا يَكْرَهُ " . قَالَ أَرَأَيْتَ إِنْ كَانَ فِيهِ مَا أَقُولُ قَالَ " إِنْ كَانَ فِيهِ مَا تَقُولُ فَقَدِ اغْتَبْتَهُ وَإِنْ لَمْ يَكُنْ فِيهِ مَا تَقُولُ فَقَدْ بَهَتَّهُ " . قَالَ وَفِي الْبَابِ عَنْ أَبِي بَرْزَةَ وَابْنِ عُمَرَ وَعَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَمْرٍو . 

قَالَ أَبُو عِيسَى هَذَا حَدِيثٌ حَسَنٌ صَحِيحٌ .
references: Vol. 4, Book of Righteousness And Maintaining Good Relations With Relatives, Hadith 1934

hadiths.title: Jami` at-Tirmidhi 1935

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ فِي الْحَسَدِ
chapter.englishTitle: What Has Been Related About Envy

hadiths.englishRaw:
Anas narrated that the  Messenger of Allah said:

"Do not cut off one another, nor desert one another, nor hate one another, nor envy one another. Be you , O worshippers o Allah, brothers. It is not lawful for the Muslim to shun his brother for more than three(days)."
hadiths.narrator: Anas narrated that the  Messenger of Allah said:
hadiths.body: "Do not cut off one another, nor desert one another, nor hate one another, nor envy one another. Be you , O worshippers o Allah, brothers. It is not lawful for the Muslim to shun his brother for more than three(days)."
hadiths.arabic:
حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْجَبَّارِ بْنُ الْعَلاَءِ الْعَطَّارُ، وَسَعِيدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ  " لاَ تَقَاطَعُوا وَلاَ تَدَابَرُوا وَلاَ تَبَاغَضُوا وَلاَ تَحَاسَدُوا وَكُونُوا عِبَادَ اللَّهِ إِخْوَانًا وَلاَ يَحِلُّ لِمُسْلِمٍ أَنْ يَهْجُرَ أَخَاهُ فَوْقَ ثَلاَثٍ " . 

قَالَ أَبُو عِيسَى هَذَا حَدِيثٌ حَسَنٌ صَحِيحٌ . قَالَ وَفِي الْبَابِ عَنْ أَبِي بَكْرٍ الصِّدِّيقِ وَالزُّبَيْرِ بْنِ الْعَوَّامِ وَابْنِ مَسْعُودٍ وَأَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ .
references: Vol. 4, Book of Righteousness And Maintaining Good Relations With Relatives, Hadith 1935

hadiths.title: Jami` at-Tirmidhi 1936

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ فِي الْحَسَدِ
chapter.englishTitle: What Has Been Related About Envy

hadiths.englishRaw:
Salim narrated  from his father who said that the  Messenger of Allah said:

"There is to be no envy except for two: A man to whom Allah grants wealth and he spends from it during the hours of the night and the hours of the day. And a man to whom Allah grants (memorization of) the Quran so he stands with it (in prayer) during the hours of the night and the hours of the day."
hadiths.narrator: Salim narrated  from his father who said that the  Messenger of Allah said:
hadiths.body: "There is to be no envy except for two: A man to whom Allah grants wealth and he spends from it during the hours of the night and the hours of the day. And a man to whom Allah grants (memorization of) the Quran so he stands with it (in prayer) during the hours of the night and the hours of the day."
hadiths.arabic:
حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي عُمَرَ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، حَدَّثَنَا الزُّهْرِيُّ، عَنْ سَالِمٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ  " لاَ حَسَدَ إِلاَّ فِي اثْنَتَيْنِ رَجُلٌ آتَاهُ اللَّهُ مَالاً فَهُوَ يُنْفِقُ مِنْهُ آنَاءَ اللَّيْلِ وَآنَاءَ النَّهَارِ وَرَجُلٌ آتَاهُ اللَّهُ الْقُرْآنَ فَهُوَ يَقُومُ بِهِ آنَاءَ اللَّيْلِ وَآنَاءَ النَّهَارِ " . 

قَالَ أَبُو عِيسَى هَذَا حَدِيثٌ حَسَنٌ صَحِيحٌ . وَقَدْ رُوِيَ عَنِ ابْنِ مَسْعُودٍ وَأَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ نَحْوُ هَذَا .
references: Vol. 4, Book of Righteousness And Maintaining Good Relations With Relatives, Hadith 1936

hadiths.title: Jami` at-Tirmidhi 1937

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ فِي التَّبَاغُضِ
chapter.englishTitle: What Has Been Related About Hatred

hadiths.englishRaw:
Jabir   narrated that the  Messenger of Allah said:

"Indeed Ash-Shaitan has despaired of getting those who perform Salat to worship him.But he is engaged in sowing hatred among them."
hadiths.narrator: Jabir   narrated that the  Messenger of Allah said:
hadiths.body: "Indeed Ash-Shaitan has despaired of getting those who perform Salat to worship him.But he is engaged in sowing hatred among them."
hadiths.arabic:
حَدَّثَنَا هَنَّادٌ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو مُعَاوِيَةَ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ أَبِي سُفْيَانَ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ، قَالَ قَالَ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ  " إِنَّ الشَّيْطَانَ قَدْ يَئِسَ أَنْ يَعْبُدَهُ الْمُصَلُّونَ وَلَكِنْ فِي التَّحْرِيشِ بَيْنَهُمْ " . قَالَ وَفِي الْبَابِ عَنْ أَنَسٍ وَسُلَيْمَانَ بْنِ عَمْرِو بْنِ الأَحْوَصِ عَنْ أَبِيهِ . 

قَالَ أَبُو عِيسَى هَذَا حَدِيثٌ حَسَنٌ . وَأَبُو سُفْيَانَ اسْمُهُ طَلْحَةُ بْنُ نَافِعٍ .
references: Vol. 4, Book of Righteousness And Maintaining Good Relations With Relatives, Hadith 1937

hadiths.title: Jami` at-Tirmidhi 1938

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ فِي إِصْلاَحِ ذَاتِ الْبَيْنِ
chapter.englishTitle: What Has Been Related About Rectifying  Manners

hadiths.englishRaw:
Umm Kulthum bint 'Uqbah narrated that the  Messenger of Allah said:

"One who brings peace between people is not a liar, he says something good, or reports something good."
hadiths.narrator: Umm Kulthum bint 'Uqbah narrated that the  Messenger of Allah said:
hadiths.body: "One who brings peace between people is not a liar, he says something good, or reports something good."
hadiths.arabic:
حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مَنِيعٍ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ حُمَيْدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، عَنْ أُمِّهِ أُمِّ كُلْثُومٍ بِنْتِ عُقْبَةَ، قَالَتْ سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ يَقُولُ  " لَيْسَ بِالْكَاذِبِ مَنْ أَصْلَحَ بَيْنَ النَّاسِ فَقَالَ خَيْرًا أَوْ نَمَى خَيْرًا " . 

قَالَ أَبُو عِيسَى هَذَا حَدِيثٌ حَسَنٌ صَحِيحٌ .
references: Vol. 4, Book of Righteousness And Maintaining Good Relations With Relatives, Hadith 1938

hadiths.title: Jami` at-Tirmidhi 1939

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ فِي إِصْلاَحِ ذَاتِ الْبَيْنِ
chapter.englishTitle: What Has Been Related About Rectifying  Manners

hadiths.englishRaw:
Asma bint Yazid  narrated that the  Messenger of Allah said:

"it is not lawful to lie except in three cases: Something the man tells his wife to please her, to lie during war, and to lie in order to bring peace between the people."
hadiths.narrator: Asma bint Yazid  narrated that the  Messenger of Allah said:
hadiths.body: "it is not lawful to lie except in three cases: Something the man tells his wife to please her, to lie during war, and to lie in order to bring peace between the people."
hadiths.arabic:
حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أَحْمَدَ الزُّبَيْرِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، ح قَالَ وَحَدَّثَنَا مَحْمُودُ بْنُ غَيْلاَنَ، حَدَّثَنَا بِشْرُ بْنُ السَّرِيِّ، وَأَبُو أَحْمَدَ قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُثْمَانَ بْنِ خُثَيْمٍ، عَنْ شَهْرِ بْنِ حَوْشَبٍ، عَنْ أَسْمَاءَ بِنْتِ يَزِيدَ، قَالَتْ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ " لاَ يَحِلُّ الْكَذِبُ إِلاَّ فِي ثَلاَثٍ يُحَدِّثُ الرَّجُلُ امْرَأَتَهُ لِيُرْضِيَهَا وَالْكَذِبُ فِي الْحَرْبِ وَالْكَذِبُ لِيُصْلِحَ بَيْنَ النَّاسِ " . وَقَالَ مَحْمُودٌ فِي حَدِيثِهِ " لاَ يَصْلُحُ الْكَذِبُ إِلاَّ فِي ثَلاَثٍ " . 

قَالَ أَبُو عِيسَى هَذَا حَدِيثٌ حَسَنٌ لاَ نَعْرِفُهُ مِنْ حَدِيثِ أَسْمَاءَ إِلاَّ مِنْ حَدِيثِ ابْنِ خُثَيْمٍ .  وَرَوَى دَاوُدُ بْنُ أَبِي هِنْدٍ، هَذَا الْحَدِيثَ عَنْ شَهْرِ بْنِ حَوْشَبٍ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ وَلَمْ يَذْكُرْ فِيهِ عَنْ أَسْمَاءَ . حَدَّثَنَا بِذَلِكَ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْعَلاَءِ أَبُو كُرَيْبٍ حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي زَائِدَةَ عَنْ دَاوُدَ بْنِ أَبِي هِنْدٍ . وَفِي الْبَابِ عَنْ أَبِي بَكْرٍ .
references: Vol. 4, Book of Righteousness And Maintaining Good Relations With Relatives, Hadith 1939

hadiths.title: Jami` at-Tirmidhi 1940

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ فِي الْخِيَانَةِ وَالْغِشِّ
chapter.englishTitle: What Has Been Related About Deception And Cheating

hadiths.englishRaw:
Abu Sirmah narrated that the  Messenger of Allah said:

"Whoever causes harm, Allah harms him, and whoever is harsh, Allah will be harsh with him."
hadiths.narrator: Abu Sirmah narrated that the  Messenger of Allah said:
hadiths.body: "Whoever causes harm, Allah harms him, and whoever is harsh, Allah will be harsh with him."
hadiths.arabic:
حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ، حَدَّثَنَا اللَّيْثُ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ يَحْيَى بْنِ حَبَّانَ، عَنْ لُؤْلُؤَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي صِرْمَةَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ قَالَ  " مَنْ ضَارَّ ضَارَّ اللَّهُ بِهِ وَمَنْ شَاقَّ شَاقَّ اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ " . 

قَالَ أَبُو عِيسَى هَذَا حَدِيثٌ حَسَنٌ غَرِيبٌ . وَفِي الْبَابِ عَنْ أَبِي بَكْرٍ .
references: Vol. 4, Book of Righteousness And Maintaining Good Relations With Relatives, Hadith 1940

hadiths.title: Jami` at-Tirmidhi 1941

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ فِي الْخِيَانَةِ وَالْغِشِّ
chapter.englishTitle: What Has Been Related About Deception And Cheating

hadiths.englishRaw:
Abu Bakr As-Siddiq narrated that the  Messenger of Allah said:

"Cursed are those who harm a believer, or plot to do so."
hadiths.narrator: Abu Bakr As-Siddiq narrated that the  Messenger of Allah said:
hadiths.body: "Cursed are those who harm a believer, or plot to do so."
hadiths.arabic:
حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا زَيْدُ بْنُ الْحُبَابِ الْعُكْلِيُّ، حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو سَلَمَةَ الْكِنْدِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا فَرْقَدٌ السَّبَخِيُّ، عَنْ مُرَّةَ بْنِ شَرَاحِيلَ الْهَمْدَانِيِّ، وَهُوَ الطَّيِّبُ - عَنْ أَبِي بَكْرٍ الصِّدِّيقِ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ  " مَلْعُونٌ مَنْ ضَارَّ مُؤْمِنًا أَوْ مَكَرَ بِهِ " . 

قَالَ أَبُو عِيسَى هَذَا حَدِيثٌ غَرِيبٌ .
references: Vol. 4, Book of Righteousness And Maintaining Good Relations With Relatives, Hadith 1941

hadiths.title: Jami` at-Tirmidhi 1942

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ فِي حَقِّ الْجِوَارِ
chapter.englishTitle: What Has Been Related About The Rights Of Neighbors

hadiths.englishRaw:
Aishah narrated that the  Messenger of Allah said:

"Jibril
hadiths.narrator: Aishah narrated that the  Messenger of Allah said:
hadiths.body: "Jibril
hadiths.arabic:
حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ، حَدَّثَنَا اللَّيْثُ بْنُ سَعْدٍ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ أَبِي بَكْرٍ، هُوَ ابْنُ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَمْرِو بْنِ حَزْمٍ - عَنْ عَمْرَةَ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ قَالَ  " مَا زَالَ جِبْرِيلُ يُوصِينِي بِالْجَارِ حَتَّى ظَنَنْتُ أَنَّهُ سَيُوَرِّثُهُ " . 

قَالَ أَبُو عِيسَى هَذَا حَدِيثٌ حَسَنٌ صَحِيحٌ .
references: Vol. 4, Book of Righteousness And Maintaining Good Relations With Relatives, Hadith 1942

hadiths.title: Jami` at-Tirmidhi 1943

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ فِي حَقِّ الْجِوَارِ
chapter.englishTitle: What Has Been Related About The Rights Of Neighbors

hadiths.englishRaw:
Mujahid  narrated:

"Abdullah bin Amr had a sheep slaughtered for his family, so when he came he said: 'Have you given some to our neighbor, the Jew? Have you given some to our neighbor, the Jew? I heard the Messenger of Allah saying: 'Jibril continued to advise me about (treating) the neighbors so (kindly and politely), that I thought he would order me (from Allah) to make them heirs."
hadiths.body: "Abdullah bin Amr had a sheep slaughtered for his family, so when he came he said: 'Have you given some to our neighbor, the Jew? Have you given some to our neighbor, the Jew? I heard the Messenger of Allah saying: 'Jibril continued to advise me about (treating) the neighbors so (kindly and politely), that I thought he would order me (from Allah) to make them heirs."
hadiths.arabic:
حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الأَعْلَى، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، عَنْ دَاوُدَ بْنِ شَابُورَ، وَبَشِيرٍ أَبِي إِسْمَاعِيلَ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، أَنَّ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ عَمْرٍو، ذُبِحَتْ لَهُ شَاةٌ فِي أَهْلِهِ فَلَمَّا جَاءَ قَالَ أَهْدَيْتُمْ لِجَارِنَا الْيَهُودِيِّ أَهْدَيْتُمْ لِجَارِنَا الْيَهُودِيِّ سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ يَقُولُ  " مَا زَالَ جِبْرِيلُ يُوصِينِي بِالْجَارِ حَتَّى ظَنَنْتُ أَنَّهُ سَيُوَرِّثُهُ " . قَالَ وَفِي الْبَابِ عَنْ عَائِشَةَ وَابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ وَأَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ وَأَنَسٍ وَالْمِقْدَادِ بْنِ الأَسْوَدِ وَعُقْبَةَ بْنِ عَامِرٍ وَأَبِي شُرَيْحٍ وَأَبِي أُمَامَةَ . 

قَالَ أَبُو عِيسَى هَذَا حَدِيثٌ حَسَنٌ غَرِيبٌ مِنْ هَذَا الْوَجْهِ . وَقَدْ رُوِيَ هَذَا الْحَدِيثُ عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ عَنْ عَائِشَةَ وَأَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ أَيْضًا .
references: Vol. 4, Book of Righteousness And Maintaining Good Relations With Relatives, Hadith 1943

hadiths.title: Jami` at-Tirmidhi 1944

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ فِي حَقِّ الْجِوَارِ
chapter.englishTitle: What Has Been Related About The Rights Of Neighbors

hadiths.englishRaw:
Abdullah bin Amr  narrated that the Messenger of Allah said :

"The companion who is the best to Allah is the one who is best to his companion. And the neighbor that is the best to Allah is the one that is best to his neighbor."
hadiths.narrator: Abdullah bin Amr  narrated that the Messenger of Allah said :
hadiths.body: "The companion who is the best to Allah is the one who is best to his companion. And the neighbor that is the best to Allah is the one that is best to his neighbor."
hadiths.arabic:
حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ الْمُبَارَكِ، عَنْ حَيْوَةَ بْنِ شُرَيْحٍ، عَنْ شُرَحْبِيلَ بْنِ شَرِيكٍ، عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ الْحُبُلِيِّ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَمْرٍو، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ  " خَيْرُ الأَصْحَابِ عِنْدَ اللَّهِ خَيْرُهُمْ لِصَاحِبِهِ وَخَيْرُ الْجِيرَانِ عِنْدَ اللَّهِ خَيْرُهُمْ لِجَارِهِ " . 

قَالَ أَبُو عِيسَى هَذَا حَدِيثٌ حَسَنٌ غَرِيبٌ . وَأَبُو عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ الْحُبُلِيُّ اسْمُهُ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ يَزِيدَ .
references: Vol. 4, Book of Righteousness And Maintaining Good Relations With Relatives, Hadith 1944

hadiths.title: Jami` at-Tirmidhi 1945

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ فِي الإِحْسَانِ إِلَى الْخَدَمِ
chapter.englishTitle: What Has Been Related About Treating The Servant Well

hadiths.englishRaw:
Abu Dharr  narrated that the Messenger of Allah said :

"Allah has made some of your brothers as slaves under your care. So whoever has his brother under his care, then let him feed him from his food, and let him clothe him from his clothes. And do not give him a duty that he cannot bear, and if you give him a duty he cannot bear, then assist him with it."
hadiths.narrator: Abu Dharr  narrated that the Messenger of Allah said :
hadiths.body: "Allah has made some of your brothers as slaves under your care. So whoever has his brother under his care, then let him feed him from his food, and let him clothe him from his clothes. And do not give him a duty that he cannot bear, and if you give him a duty he cannot bear, then assist him with it."
hadiths.arabic:
حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ مَهْدِيٍّ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ وَاصِلٍ، عَنِ الْمَعْرُورِ بْنِ سُوَيْدٍ، عَنْ أَبِي ذَرٍّ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ  " إِخْوَانُكُمْ جَعَلَهُمُ اللَّهُ فِتْيَةً تَحْتَ أَيْدِيكُمْ فَمَنْ كَانَ أَخُوهُ تَحْتَ يَدِهِ فَلْيُطْعِمْهُ مِنْ طَعَامِهِ وَلْيُلْبِسْهُ مِنْ لِبَاسِهِ وَلاَ يُكَلِّفْهُ مَا يَغْلِبُهُ فَإِنْ كَلَّفَهُ مَا يَغْلِبُهُ فَلْيُعِنْهُ " . قَالَ وَفِي الْبَابِ عَنْ عَلِيٍّ وَأُمِّ سَلَمَةَ وَابْنِ عُمَرَ وَأَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ . 

قَالَ أَبُو عِيسَى هَذَا حَدِيثٌ حَسَنٌ صَحِيحٌ .
references: Vol. 4, Book of Righteousness And Maintaining Good Relations With Relatives, Hadith 1945

hadiths.title: Jami` at-Tirmidhi 1946

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ فِي الإِحْسَانِ إِلَى الْخَدَمِ
chapter.englishTitle: What Has Been Related About Treating The Servant Well

hadiths.englishRaw:
Abu Bakr As-Siddiq  narrated that the Messenger of Allah said :

"The one who treats his slaves badly will not enter paradise."
hadiths.narrator: Abu Bakr As-Siddiq  narrated that the Messenger of Allah said :
hadiths.body: "The one who treats his slaves badly will not enter paradise."
hadiths.arabic:
حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مَنِيعٍ، حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ، عَنْ هَمَّامِ بْنِ يَحْيَى، عَنْ فَرْقَدٍ السَّبَخِيِّ، عَنْ مُرَّةَ الطَّيِّبِ، عَنْ أَبِي بَكْرٍ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ  " لاَ يَدْخُلُ الْجَنَّةَ سَيِّئُ الْمَلَكَةِ " . 

قَالَ أَبُو عِيسَى هَذَا حَدِيثٌ غَرِيبٌ . وَقَدْ تَكَلَّمَ أَيُّوبُ السَّخْتِيَانِيُّ وَغَيْرُ وَاحِدٍ فِي فَرْقَدٍ السَّبَخِيِّ مِنْ قِبَلِ حِفْظِهِ .
references: Vol. 4, Book of Righteousness And Maintaining Good Relations With Relatives, Hadith 1946

hadiths.title: Jami` at-Tirmidhi 1947

chapter.arabicTitle: باب النَّهْىِ عَنْ ضَرْبِ الْخَدَمِ، وَشَتْمِهِمْ
chapter.englishTitle: What Has Been Related About Beating And Abusing The Servant

hadiths.englishRaw:
Abu Hurairah narrated that Abul-Qasim, the Prophet of Repentance, said :

"If somebody slanders his slave (by accusing him of committing illegal sexual intercourse) and the slave is innocent from what he says, Allah will impose the punishment upon him on the Day of Resurrection, unless it is as he said about him."
hadiths.narrator: Abu Hurairah narrated that Abul-Qasim, the Prophet of Repentance, said :
hadiths.body: "If somebody slanders his slave (by accusing him of committing illegal sexual intercourse) and the slave is innocent from what he says, Allah will impose the punishment upon him on the Day of Resurrection, unless it is as he said about him."
hadiths.arabic:
حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ الْمُبَارَكِ، عَنْ فُضَيْلِ بْنِ غَزْوَانَ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نُعْمٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ أَبُو الْقَاسِمِ ﷺ نَبِيُّ التَّوْبَةِ  " مَنْ قَذَفَ مَمْلُوكَهُ بَرِيئًا مِمَّا قَالَ لَهُ أَقَامَ عَلَيْهِ الْحَدَّ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ إِلاَّ أَنْ يَكُونَ كَمَا قَالَ " . 

قَالَ أَبُو عِيسَى هَذَا حَدِيثٌ حَسَنٌ صَحِيحٌ . وَابْنُ أَبِي نُعْمٍ هُوَ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ أَبِي نُعْمٍ الْبَجَلِيُّ يُكْنَى أَبَا الْحَكَمِ . وَفِي الْبَابِ عَنْ سُوَيْدِ بْنِ مُقَرِّنٍ وَعَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ .
references: Vol. 4, Book of Righteousness And Maintaining Good Relations With Relatives, Hadith 1947

hadiths.title: Jami` at-Tirmidhi 1948

chapter.arabicTitle: باب النَّهْىِ عَنْ ضَرْبِ الْخَدَمِ، وَشَتْمِهِمْ
chapter.englishTitle: What Has Been Related About Beating And Abusing The Servant

hadiths.englishRaw:
Abu Mas'ud [Al-Ansari] said:

"I was beating a slave of mine and I heard someone behind me saying: 'Beware O Abu Mas'ud! Beware O Abu Mas'ud!' So I turned around and saw that it was the Messenger of Allah. He said: 'Allah has more power over you than you do over him." Abu Mas'ud said: "I have not beaten any slave of mine since then."
hadiths.body: "I was beating a slave of mine and I heard someone behind me saying: 'Beware O Abu Mas'ud! Beware O Abu Mas'ud!' So I turned around and saw that it was the Messenger of Allah. He said: 'Allah has more power over you than you do over him." Abu Mas'ud said: "I have not beaten any slave of mine since then."
hadiths.arabic:
حَدَّثَنَا مَحْمُودُ بْنُ غَيْلاَنَ، حَدَّثَنَا مُؤَمَّلٌ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ التَّيْمِيِّ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَبِي مَسْعُودٍ الأَنْصَارِيِّ، قَالَ كُنْتُ أَضْرِبُ مَمْلُوكًا لِي فَسَمِعْتُ قَائِلاً مِنْ خَلْفِي يَقُولُ " اعْلَمْ أَبَا مَسْعُودٍ اعْلَمْ أَبَا مَسْعُودٍ " . فَالْتَفَتُّ فَإِذَا أَنَا بِرَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ فَقَالَ " لَلَّهُ أَقْدَرُ عَلَيْكَ مِنْكَ عَلَيْهِ " . قَالَ أَبُو مَسْعُودٍ فَمَا ضَرَبْتُ مَمْلُوكًا لِي بَعْدَ ذَلِكَ . 

قَالَ أَبُو عِيسَى هَذَا حَدِيثٌ حَسَنٌ صَحِيحٌ . وَإِبْرَاهِيمُ التَّيْمِيُّ هُوَ إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ يَزِيدَ بْنِ شَرِيكٍ .
references: Vol. 4, Book of Righteousness And Maintaining Good Relations With Relatives, Hadith 1948

hadiths.title: Jami` at-Tirmidhi 1949

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ فِي الْعَفْوِ عَنِ الْخَادِمِ
chapter.englishTitle: What Has Been Related About Pardoning The Servant

hadiths.englishRaw:
'Abdullah bin 'Umar narrated:

"A man came to the Prophet and said: 'O Messenger of Allah! How many times should the servant be pardoned?' The Prophet was silent. Then he said: 'O Messenger of Allah! How many times should the servant be pardoned?' He said: ' Seventy times each day.'"
hadiths.body: "A man came to the Prophet and said: 'O Messenger of Allah! How many times should the servant be pardoned?' The Prophet was silent. Then he said: 'O Messenger of Allah! How many times should the servant be pardoned?' He said: ' Seventy times each day.'"
hadiths.arabic:
حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ، حَدَّثَنَا رِشْدِينُ بْنُ سَعْدٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هَانِئٍ الْخَوْلاَنِيِّ، عَنْ عَبَّاسٍ الْحَجَرِيِّ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ، قَالَ جَاءَ رَجُلٌ إِلَى النَّبِيِّ ﷺ فَقَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ كَمْ أَعْفُو عَنِ الْخَادِمِ فَصَمَتَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ ثُمَّ قَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ كَمْ أَعْفُو عَنِ الْخَادِمِ فَقَالَ  " كُلَّ يَوْمٍ سَبْعِينَ مَرَّةً " . 

قَالَ أَبُو عِيسَى هَذَا حَدِيثٌ حَسَنٌ غَرِيبٌ . وَرَوَاهُ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ وَهْبٍ عَنْ أَبِي هَانِئٍ الْخَوْلاَنِيِّ نَحْوًا مِنْ هَذَا . وَالْعَبَّاسُ هُوَ ابْنُ جُلَيْدٍ الْحَجَرِيُّ الْمِصْرِيُّ .  حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ وَهْبٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هَانِئٍ الْخَوْلاَنِيِّ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ نَحْوَهُ . وَرَوَى بَعْضُهُمْ، هَذَا الْحَدِيثَ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ وَهْبٍ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ وَقَالَ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَمْرٍو، .
references: Vol. 4, Book of Righteousness And Maintaining Good Relations With Relatives, Hadith 1949

hadiths.title: Jami` at-Tirmidhi 1950

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ فِي أَدَبِ الْخَادِمِ
chapter.englishTitle: What Has Been Related About Disciplining The Servant

hadiths.englishRaw:
Abu Sa'eed Al-Khudri  narrated that the Messenger of Allah said :

"When one of you beats his servant then he (should) remember Allah and, withhold your hands."
hadiths.narrator: Abu Sa'eed Al-Khudri  narrated that the Messenger of Allah said :
hadiths.body: "When one of you beats his servant then he (should) remember Allah and, withhold your hands."
hadiths.arabic:
حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ الْمُبَارَكِ، عَنْ سُفْيَانَ، عَنْ أَبِي هَارُونَ الْعَبْدِيِّ، عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيِّ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ  " إِذَا ضَرَبَ أَحَدُكُمْ خَادِمَهُ فَذَكَرَ اللَّهَ فَارْفَعُوا أَيْدِيَكُمْ " . 

قَالَ أَبُو عِيسَى وَأَبُو هَارُونَ الْعَبْدِيُّ اسْمُهُ عُمَارَةُ بْنُ جُوَيْنٍ . قَالَ قَالَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ الْعَطَّارُ قَالَ عَلِيُّ بْنُ الْمَدِينِيِّ قَالَ يَحْيَى بْنُ سَعِيدٍ ضَعَّفَ شُعْبَةُ أَبَا هَارُونَ الْعَبْدِيَّ . قَالَ يَحْيَى وَمَا زَالَ ابْنُ عَوْنٍ يَرْوِي عَنْ أَبِي هَارُونَ حَتَّى مَاتَ .
references: Vol. 4, Book of Righteousness And Maintaining Good Relations With Relatives, Hadith 1950

hadiths.title: Jami` at-Tirmidhi 1951

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ فِي أَدَبِ الْوَلَدِ
chapter.englishTitle: What Has Been Related About Disciplining The Son

hadiths.englishRaw:
Jabir bin Sumurah narrated that the Messenger of Allah said :

"That a man should discipline his son is better for him than to have given a Sa' in charity."
hadiths.narrator: Jabir bin Sumurah narrated that the Messenger of Allah said :
hadiths.body: "That a man should discipline his son is better for him than to have given a Sa' in charity."
hadiths.arabic:
حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَعْلَى، عَنْ نَاصِحٍ، عَنْ سِمَاكِ بْنِ حَرْبٍ، عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ سَمُرَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ  " لأَنْ يُؤَدِّبَ الرَّجُلُ وَلَدَهُ خَيْرٌ مِنْ أَنْ يَتَصَدَّقَ بِصَاعٍ " . 

قَالَ أَبُو عِيسَى هَذَا حَدِيثٌ غَرِيبٌ . وَنَاصِحٌ هُوَ ابْنُ الْعَلاَءِ كُوفِيٌّ لَيْسَ عِنْدَ أَهْلِ الْحَدِيثِ بِالْقَوِيِّ وَلاَ يُعْرَفُ هَذَا الْحَدِيثُ إِلاَّ مِنْ هَذَا الْوَجْهِ وَنَاصِحٌ شَيْخٌ آخَرُ بَصْرِيٌّ يَرْوِي عَنْ عَمَّارِ بْنِ أَبِي عَمَّارٍ وَغَيْرِهِ هُوَ أَثْبَتُ مِنْ هَذَا .
references: Vol. 4, Book of Righteousness And Maintaining Good Relations With Relatives, Hadith 1951

hadiths.title: Jami` at-Tirmidhi 1952

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ فِي أَدَبِ الْوَلَدِ
chapter.englishTitle: What Has Been Related About Disciplining The Son

hadiths.englishRaw:
Ayyub bin Musa narrated from his father, from his grandfather, that the Messenger of Allah said :

"There is no gift that a father gives his son more virtuous than good manners."
hadiths.narrator: Ayyub bin Musa narrated from his father, from his grandfather, that the Messenger of Allah said :
hadiths.body: "There is no gift that a father gives his son more virtuous than good manners."
hadiths.arabic:
حَدَّثَنَا نَصْرُ بْنُ عَلِيٍّ الْجَهْضَمِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا عَامِرُ بْنُ أَبِي عَامِرٍ الْخَزَّازُ، حَدَّثَنَا أَيُّوبُ بْنُ مُوسَى، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ جَدِّهِ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ قَالَ  " مَا نَحَلَ وَالِدٌ وَلَدًا مِنْ نَحْلٍ أَفْضَلَ مِنْ أَدَبٍ حَسَنٍ " . 

قَالَ أَبُو عِيسَى هَذَا حَدِيثٌ غَرِيبٌ لاَ نَعْرِفُهُ إِلاَّ مِنْ حَدِيثِ عَامِرِ بْنِ أَبِي عَامِرٍ الْخَزَّازِ وَهُوَ عَامِرُ بْنُ صَالِحِ بْنِ رُسْتُمَ الْخَزَّازُ وَأَيُّوبُ بْنُ مُوسَى هُوَ ابْنُ عَمْرِو بْنِ سَعِيدِ بْنِ الْعَاصِي . وَهَذَا عِنْدِي حَدِيثٌ مُرْسَلٌ .
references: Vol. 4, Book of Righteousness And Maintaining Good Relations With Relatives, Hadith 1952

hadiths.title: Jami` at-Tirmidhi 1953

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ فِي قَبُولِ الْهَدِيَّةِ وَالْمُكَافَأَةِ عَلَيْهَا
chapter.englishTitle: What Has Been Related About Accepting Gifts And Reciprocating For Them

hadiths.englishRaw:
Aishah  narrated:

"The prophet wouls accept gifts and he would give something in return."
hadiths.body: "The prophet wouls accept gifts and he would give something in return."
hadiths.arabic:
حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ أَكْثَمَ، وَعَلِيُّ بْنُ خَشْرَمٍ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا عِيسَى بْنُ يُونُسَ، عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ عُرْوَةَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ كَانَ يَقْبَلُ الْهَدِيَّةَ وَيُثِيبُ عَلَيْهَا . وَفِي الْبَابِ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ وَأَنَسٍ وَابْنِ عُمَرَ وَجَابِرٍ . 

قَالَ أَبُو عِيسَى هَذَا حَدِيثٌ حَسَنٌ غَرِيبٌ صَحِيحٌ مِنْ هَذَا الْوَجْهِ لاَ نَعْرِفُهُ مَرْفُوعًا إِلاَّ مِنْ حَدِيثِ عِيسَى بْنِ يُونُسَ عَنْ هِشَامٍ .
references: Vol. 4, Book of Righteousness And Maintaining Good Relations With Relatives, Hadith 1953

hadiths.title: Jami` at-Tirmidhi 1954

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ فِي الشُّكْرِ لِمَنْ أَحْسَنَ إِلَيْكَ
chapter.englishTitle: What Has Been Related About Being Grateful To The One Who Was Kind To You

hadiths.englishRaw:
Abu Hurairah narrated that the Messenger of Allah said :

"Whoever is not grateful to the people, he is not grateful to Allah."
hadiths.narrator: Abu Hurairah narrated that the Messenger of Allah said :
hadiths.body: "Whoever is not grateful to the people, he is not grateful to Allah."
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ الْمُبَارَكِ، حَدَّثَنَا الرَّبِيعُ بْنُ مُسْلِمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ زِيَادٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ  " مَنْ لاَ يَشْكُرِ النَّاسَ لاَ يَشْكُرِ اللَّهَ " . قَالَ هَذَا حَدِيثٌ حَسَنٌ صَحِيحٌ .
references: Vol. 4, Book of Righteousness And Maintaining Good Relations With Relatives, Hadith 1954

hadiths.title: Jami` at-Tirmidhi 1955

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ فِي الشُّكْرِ لِمَنْ أَحْسَنَ إِلَيْكَ
chapter.englishTitle: What Has Been Related About Being Grateful To The One Who Was Kind To You

hadiths.englishRaw:
Abu Sa'eed narrated that the Messenger of Allah said :

"Whoever is not grateful to the people, he is not grateful to Allah."
hadiths.narrator: Abu Sa'eed narrated that the Messenger of Allah said :
hadiths.body: "Whoever is not grateful to the people, he is not grateful to Allah."
hadiths.arabic:
حَدَّثَنَا هَنَّادٌ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو مُعَاوِيَةَ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي لَيْلَى، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ وَكِيعٍ، حَدَّثَنَا حُمَيْدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ الرُّؤَاسِيُّ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي لَيْلَى، عَنْ عَطِيَّةَ، عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ  " مَنْ لَمْ يَشْكُرِ النَّاسَ لَمْ يَشْكُرِ اللَّهَ " . وَفِي الْبَابِ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ وَالأَشْعَثِ بْنِ قَيْسٍ وَالنُّعْمَانِ بْنِ بَشِيرٍ . 

قَالَ أَبُو عِيسَى هَذَا حَدِيثٌ حَسَنٌ صَحِيحٌ .
references: Vol. 4, Book of Righteousness And Maintaining Good Relations With Relatives, Hadith 1955

hadiths.title: Jami` at-Tirmidhi 1956

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ فِي صَنَائِعِ الْمَعْرُوفِ
chapter.englishTitle: What Has Been Related About Various Kinds Of Ma'ruf (Good Deeds)

hadiths.englishRaw:
Abu Dharr narrated that the Messenger of Allah said :

"Your smiling in the face of your brother is charity, commanding good and forbidding evil is charity, your giving directions to a man lost in the land is charity for you. Your seeing for a man with bad sight is a charity for you, your removal of a rock, a thorn  or a bone from the road is charity for you. Your pouring what remains from your bucket into the bucket of your brother is charity for you."
hadiths.narrator: Abu Dharr narrated that the Messenger of Allah said :
hadiths.body: "Your smiling in the face of your brother is charity, commanding good and forbidding evil is charity, your giving directions to a man lost in the land is charity for you. Your seeing for a man with bad sight is a charity for you, your removal of a rock, a thorn  or a bone from the road is charity for you. Your pouring what remains from your bucket into the bucket of your brother is charity for you."
hadiths.arabic:
حَدَّثَنَا عَبَّاسُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْعَظِيمِ الْعَنْبَرِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا النَّضْرُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ الْجُرَشِيُّ الْيَمَامِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا عِكْرِمَةُ بْنُ عَمَّارٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو زُمَيْلٍ، عَنْ مَالِكِ بْنِ مَرْثَدٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَبِي ذَرٍّ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ  " تَبَسُّمُكَ فِي وَجْهِ أَخِيكَ لَكَ صَدَقَةٌ وَأَمْرُكَ بِالْمَعْرُوفِ وَنَهْيُكَ عَنِ الْمُنْكَرِ صَدَقَةٌ وَإِرْشَادُكَ الرَّجُلَ فِي أَرْضِ الضَّلاَلِ لَكَ صَدَقَةٌ وَبَصَرُكَ لِلرَّجُلِ الرَّدِيءِ الْبَصَرِ لَكَ صَدَقَةٌ وَإِمَاطَتُكَ الْحَجَرَ وَالشَّوْكَةَ وَالْعَظْمَ عَنِ الطَّرِيقِ لَكَ صَدَقَةٌ وَإِفْرَاغُكَ مِنْ دَلْوِكَ فِي دَلْوِ أَخِيكَ لَكَ صَدَقَةٌ " . قَالَ وَفِي الْبَابِ عَنِ ابْنِ مَسْعُودٍ وَجَابِرٍ وَحُذَيْفَةَ وَعَائِشَةَ وَأَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ . 

قَالَ أَبُو عِيسَى هَذَا حَدِيثٌ حَسَنٌ غَرِيبٌ . وَأَبُو زُمَيْلٍ اسْمُهُ سِمَاكُ بْنُ الْوَلِيدِ الْحَنَفِيُّ .
references: Vol. 4, Book of Righteousness And Maintaining Good Relations With Relatives, Hadith 1956

hadiths.title: Jami` at-Tirmidhi 1957

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ فِي الْمِنْحَةِ
chapter.englishTitle: What Has Been Related About Minhah (Giving A Gift)

hadiths.englishRaw:
Al-Bara bin Azib narrated that the Messenger of Allah said :

"Whoever gives someone some milk or silver, or guides him through a strait, then he will have the reward similar to freeing a slave."
hadiths.narrator: Al-Bara bin Azib narrated that the Messenger of Allah said :
hadiths.body: "Whoever gives someone some milk or silver, or guides him through a strait, then he will have the reward similar to freeing a slave."
hadiths.arabic:
حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو كُرَيْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ بْنِ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ، عَنْ طَلْحَةَ بْنِ مُصَرِّفٍ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ عَبْدَ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنَ عَوْسَجَةَ، يَقُولُ سَمِعْتُ الْبَرَاءَ بْنَ عَازِبٍ، يَقُولُ سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ يَقُولُ " مَنْ مَنَحَ مَنِيحَةَ لَبَنٍ أَوْ وَرِقٍ أَوْ هَدَى زُقَاقًا كَانَ لَهُ مِثْلُ عِتْقِ رَقَبَةٍ " . 

قَالَ أَبُو عِيسَى هَذَا حَدِيثٌ حَسَنٌ صَحِيحٌ غَرِيبٌ مِنْ حَدِيثِ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ عَنْ طَلْحَةَ بْنِ مُصَرِّفٍ لاَ نَعْرِفُهُ إِلاَّ مِنْ هَذَا الْوَجْهِ . وَقَدْ رَوَى مَنْصُورُ بْنُ الْمُعْتَمِرِ وَشُعْبَةُ عَنْ طَلْحَةَ بْنِ مُصَرِّفٍ هَذَا الْحَدِيثَ . وَفِي الْبَابِ عَنِ النُّعْمَانِ بْنِ بَشِيرٍ . وَمَعْنَى قَوْلِهِ " مَنْ مَنَحَ مَنِيحَةَ وَرِقٍ " . إِنَّمَا يَعْنِي بِهِ قَرْضَ الدَّرَاهِمِ قَوْلُهُ " أَوْ هَدَى زُقَاقًا " . يَعْنِي بِهِ هِدَايَةَ الطَّرِيقِ .
references: Vol. 4, Book of Righteousness And Maintaining Good Relations With Relatives, Hadith 1957

hadiths.title: Jami` at-Tirmidhi 1958

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ فِي إِمَاطَةِ الأَذَى عَنِ الطَّرِيقِ
chapter.englishTitle: What Has Been Related About Removing Harm From The Road

hadiths.englishRaw:
Abu Hurairah narrated that the Messenger of Allah said :

"When a man was walking on the road, he found a thorny branch and removed it. Allah appreciated his action by forgiving him."
hadiths.narrator: Abu Hurairah narrated that the Messenger of Allah said :
hadiths.body: "When a man was walking on the road, he found a thorny branch and removed it. Allah appreciated his action by forgiving him."
hadiths.arabic:
حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ، عَنْ مَالِكِ بْنِ أَنَسٍ، عَنْ سُمَىٍّ، عَنْ أَبِي صَالِحٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ  " بَيْنَمَا رَجُلٌ يَمْشِي فِي طَرِيقٍ إِذْ وَجَدَ غُصْنَ شَوْكٍ فَأَخَّرَهُ فَشَكَرَ اللَّهُ لَهُ فَغَفَرَ لَهُ " . وَفِي الْبَابِ عَنْ أَبِي بَرْزَةَ وَابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ وَأَبِي ذَرٍّ . 

قَالَ أَبُو عِيسَى هَذَا حَدِيثٌ حَسَنٌ صَحِيحٌ .
references: Vol. 4, Book of Righteousness And Maintaining Good Relations With Relatives, Hadith 1958

hadiths.title: Jami` at-Tirmidhi 1959

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ أَنَّ الْمَجَالِسَ أَمَانَةٌ
chapter.englishTitle: What Has Been Related About Sittings Are To Be Held In Trust

hadiths.englishRaw:
Jabir bin Abdullah narrated that the Messenger of Allah said :

"When a man narrates a narration, then he looks around, then it is a trust."
hadiths.narrator: Jabir bin Abdullah narrated that the Messenger of Allah said :
hadiths.body: "When a man narrates a narration, then he looks around, then it is a trust."
hadiths.arabic:
حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ الْمُبَارَكِ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي ذِئْبٍ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ عَطَاءٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الْمَلِكِ بْنِ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَتِيكٍ، عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ  " إِذَا حَدَّثَ الرَّجُلُ الْحَدِيثَ ثُمَّ الْتَفَتَ فَهِيَ أَمَانَةٌ " . 

قَالَ أَبُو عِيسَى هَذَا حَدِيثٌ حَسَنٌ وَإِنَّمَا نَعْرِفُهُ مِنْ حَدِيثِ ابْنِ أَبِي ذِئْبٍ .
references: Vol. 4, Book of Righteousness And Maintaining Good Relations With Relatives, Hadith 1959

hadiths.title: Jami` at-Tirmidhi 1960

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ فِي السَّخَاءِ
chapter.englishTitle: What Has Been Related About Generosity

hadiths.englishRaw:
Asma bint Abi Bakr  said:
