hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مَحْمُودُ بْنُ غَيْلاَنَ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ، أَخْبَرَنَا شُعْبَةُ، أَخْبَرَنِي ابْنُ أَبِي لَيْلَى، عَنْ أَخِيهِ، عِيسَى بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ أَبِي لَيْلَى، عَنْ أَبِي أَيُّوبَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ قَالَ  " إِذَا عَطَسَ أَحَدُكُمْ فَلْيَقُلِ الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ عَلَى كُلِّ حَالٍ وَلْيَقُلِ الَّذِي يَرُدُّ عَلَيْهِ يَرْحَمُكَ اللَّهُ وَلْيَقُلْ هُوَ يَهْدِيكُمُ اللَّهُ وَيُصْلِحُ بَالَكُمْ " .

hadiths.title: Jami` at-Tirmidhi 2742

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ فِي إِيجَابِ التَّشْمِيتِ بِحَمْدِ الْعَاطِسِ
chapter.englishTitle: What Has Been Related About The Obligation Of Responding To The One Who Sneezes And Says "Al-Hamdulillah"

hadiths.englishRaw:
Narrated Anas bin Malik:

that two men sneezed in the presence of the Prophet ﷺ; he responded to one of them and did not respond to the other. The one who was not responded to said: "O Messenger of Allah! You responded to this person and did not respond to me?' So the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "He praised Allah while you did not praise Him."
hadiths.body: that two men sneezed in the presence of the Prophet ﷺ; he responded to one of them and did not respond to the other. The one who was not responded to said: "O Messenger of Allah! You responded to this person and did not respond to me?' So the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "He praised Allah while you did not praise Him."
hadiths.arabic:
حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي عُمَرَ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ التَّيْمِيِّ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، أَنَّ رَجُلَيْنِ، عَطَسَا عِنْدَ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ فَشَمَّتَ أَحَدَهُمَا وَلَمْ يُشَمِّتِ الآخَرَ فَقَالَ الَّذِي لَمْ يُشَمِّتْهُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ شَمَّتَّ هَذَا وَلَمْ تُشَمِّتْنِي . فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ  " إِنَّهُ حَمِدَ اللَّهَ وَإِنَّكَ لَمْ تَحْمَدِ اللَّهَ " . 

قَالَ أَبُو عِيسَى هَذَا حَدِيثٌ حَسَنٌ صَحِيحٌ وَقَدْ رُوِيَ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ .

hadiths.title: Jami` at-Tirmidhi 2743

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ كَمْ يُشَمَّتُ الْعَاطِسُ
chapter.englishTitle: What Has Been Related About How Much Response Is Given To The Sneezing Person

hadiths.englishRaw:
Narrated Iyas bin Salamah:

from his father: "A man sneezed in the presence of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ while I was present, so the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: 'Yarhamukallah (May Allah have mercy upon you).' Then he sneezed a second and third time. So the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "This man is suffering from a cold.'"
hadiths.body: from his father: "A man sneezed in the presence of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ while I was present, so the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: 'Yarhamukallah (May Allah have mercy upon you).' Then he sneezed a second and third time. So the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "This man is suffering from a cold.'"
hadiths.arabic:
حَدَّثَنَا سُوَيْدُ بْنُ نَصْرٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ، أَخْبَرَنَا عِكْرِمَةُ بْنُ عَمَّارٍ، عَنْ إِيَاسِ بْنِ سَلَمَةَ بْنِ الأَكْوَعِ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، قَالَ عَطَسَ رَجُلٌ عِنْدَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ وَأَنَا شَاهِدٌ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ " يَرْحَمُكَ اللَّهُ " . ثُمَّ عَطَسَ الثَّانِيَةَ وَالثَّالِثَةَ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ " هَذَا رَجُلٌ مَزْكُومٌ " . 

قَالَ أَبُو عِيسَى هَذَا حَدِيثٌ حَسَنٌ صَحِيحٌ .

hadiths.title: Jami` at-Tirmidhi 2744

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ كَمْ يُشَمَّتُ الْعَاطِسُ
chapter.englishTitle: What Has Been Related About How Much Response Is Given To The Sneezing Person

hadiths.englishRaw:
Narrated 'Umar bin Ishaq bin Abi Talhah:

from his mother, from her father, who said: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: 'Reply three times to the sneezing person. If he (sneezes) more, then if you wish reply and if you do not then do not.'"
hadiths.narrator: Narrated 'Umar bin Ishaq bin Abi Talhah:
hadiths.body: from his mother, from her father, who said: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: 'Reply three times to the sneezing person. If he (sneezes) more, then if you wish reply and if you do not then do not.'"
hadiths.arabic:
حَدَّثَنَا الْقَاسِمُ بْنُ دِينَارٍ الْكُوفِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ مَنْصُورٍ السَّلُولِيُّ الْكُوفِيُّ، عَنْ عَبْدِ السَّلاَمِ بْنِ حَرْبٍ، عَنْ يَزِيدَ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ أَبِي خَالِدٍ الدَّالاَنِيِّ، عَنْ عُمَرَ بْنِ إِسْحَاقَ بْنِ أَبِي طَلْحَةَ، عَنْ أُمِّهِ، عَنْ أَبِيهَا، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ  " يُشَمَّتُ الْعَاطِسُ ثَلاَثًا فَإِنْ زَادَ فَإِنْ شِئْتَ فَشَمِّتْهُ وَإِنْ شِئْتَ فَلاَ " . 

قَالَ أَبُو عِيسَى هَذَا حَدِيثٌ غَرِيبٌ وَإِسْنَادُهُ مَجْهُولٌ .

hadiths.title: Jami` at-Tirmidhi 2745

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ فِي خَفْضِ الصَّوْتِ وَتَخْمِيرِ الْوَجْهِ عِنْدَ الْعُطَاسِ
chapter.englishTitle: What Has Been Related About Keeping The Sound Low And Covering The Face When Sneezing

hadiths.englishRaw:
Narrated Abu Hurairah:

that when the Prophet ﷺ would sneeze, he would cover his face with his hand or with his garment, and muffle the sound with it.
hadiths.body: that when the Prophet ﷺ would sneeze, he would cover his face with his hand or with his garment, and muffle the sound with it.
hadiths.arabic:
حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ وَزِيرٍ الْوَاسِطِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَجْلاَنَ، عَنْ سُمَىٍّ، عَنْ أَبِي صَالِحٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ كَانَ إِذَا عَطَسَ غَطَّى وَجْهَهُ بِيَدِهِ أَوْ بِثَوْبِهِ وَغَضَّ بِهَا صَوْتَهُ . 

قَالَ أَبُو عِيسَى هَذَا حَدِيثٌ حَسَنٌ صَحِيحٌ .

hadiths.title: Jami` at-Tirmidhi 2746

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ إِنَّ اللَّهَ يُحِبُّ الْعُطَاسَ وَيَكْرَهُ التَّثَاؤُبَ
chapter.englishTitle: What Has Been Related About 'Indeed Allah Loves Sneezing And He Dislikes Yawning'

hadiths.englishRaw:
Narrated Abu Hurairah:

that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "The sneeze is from Allah and the yawn is from Ash-Shaitan. So when one of you yawns let him cover his mouth with his hand. For when he says 'Ah, Ah' Ash-Shaitan laughs from inside his opening." [And indeed Allah loves the sneeze and He dislikes the Yawn, so when a man says Ah, Ah when yawning, indeed Ash-Shaitan laughs from inside his opening."]
hadiths.body: that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "The sneeze is from Allah and the yawn is from Ash-Shaitan. So when one of you yawns let him cover his mouth with his hand. For when he says 'Ah, Ah' Ash-Shaitan laughs from inside his opening." [And indeed Allah loves the sneeze and He dislikes the Yawn, so when a man says Ah, Ah when yawning, indeed Ash-Shaitan laughs from inside his opening."]
hadiths.arabic:
حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي عُمَرَ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَجْلاَنَ، عَنِ الْمَقْبُرِيِّ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ قَالَ  " الْعُطَاسُ مِنَ اللَّهِ وَالتَّثَاؤُبُ مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ فَإِذَا تَثَاءَبَ أَحَدُكُمْ فَلْيَضَعْ يَدَهُ عَلَى فِيهِ وَإِذَا قَالَ آهْ آهْ فَإِنَّ الشَّيْطَانَ يَضْحَكُ مِنْ جَوْفِهِ وَإِنَّ اللَّهَ يُحِبُّ الْعُطَاسَ وَيَكْرَهُ التَّثَاؤُبَ فَإِذَا قَالَ الرَّجُلُ آهْ آهْ إِذَا تَثَاءَبَ فَإِنَّ الشَّيْطَانَ يَضْحَكُ فِي جَوْفِهِ " . 

قَالَ أَبُو عِيسَى هَذَا حَدِيثٌ حَسَنٌ صَحِيحٌ .

hadiths.title: Jami` at-Tirmidhi 2747

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ إِنَّ اللَّهَ يُحِبُّ الْعُطَاسَ وَيَكْرَهُ التَّثَاؤُبَ
chapter.englishTitle: What Has Been Related About 'Indeed Allah Loves Sneezing And He Dislikes Yawning'

hadiths.englishRaw:
Narrated Abu Hurairah:

that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Indeed Allah loves sneezing and He dislikes the yawn. So when one of you sneezes and says 'Al-Hamdulillah (All praise is due to Allah),' then it is a right due from every one who hears him to say: 'Yarhamukallah (May Allah have mercy upon you)' As for yawning then when one of you yawns let him suppress it as much as possible and not say: "Hah Hah' for that is only from Ash-Shaitan laughing at him."
hadiths.body: that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Indeed Allah loves sneezing and He dislikes the yawn. So when one of you sneezes and says 'Al-Hamdulillah (All praise is due to Allah),' then it is a right due from every one who hears him to say: 'Yarhamukallah (May Allah have mercy upon you)' As for yawning then when one of you yawns let him suppress it as much as possible and not say: "Hah Hah' for that is only from Ash-Shaitan laughing at him."
hadiths.arabic:
حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ بْنُ عَلِيٍّ الْخَلاَّلُ، حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي ذِئْبٍ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْمَقْبُرِيِّ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ  " إِنَّ اللَّهَ يُحِبُّ الْعُطَاسَ وَيَكْرَهُ التَّثَاؤُبَ فَإِذَا عَطَسَ أَحَدُكُمْ فَقَالَ الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ فَحَقٌّ عَلَى كُلِّ مَنْ سَمِعَهُ أَنْ يَقُولَ يَرْحَمُكَ اللَّهُ وَأَمَّا التَّثَاؤُبُ فَإِذَا تَثَاءَبَ أَحَدُكُمْ فَلْيَرُدَّهُ مَا اسْتَطَاعَ وَلاَ يَقُولَنَّ هَاهْ هَاهْ فَإِنَّمَا ذَلِكَ مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ يَضْحَكُ مِنْهُ " . 

قَالَ أَبُو عِيسَى هَذَا حَدِيثٌ صَحِيحٌ وَهَذَا أَصَحُّ مِنْ حَدِيثِ ابْنِ عَجْلاَنَ . وَابْنُ أَبِي ذِئْبٍ أَحْفَظُ لِحَدِيثِ سَعِيدٍ الْمَقْبُرِيِّ وَأَثْبَتُ مِنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَجْلاَنَ . قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا بَكْرٍ الْعَطَّارَ الْبَصْرِيَّ يَذْكُرُ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ الْمَدِينِيِّ عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ سَعِيدٍ قَالَ قَالَ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَجْلاَنَ أَحَادِيثُ سَعِيدٍ الْمَقْبُرِيِّ رَوَى بَعْضَهَا سَعِيدٌ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ وَرَوَى بَعْضَهَا سَعِيدٌ عَنْ رَجُلٍ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ فَاخْتَلَطَتْ عَلَىَّ فَجَعَلْتُهَا عَنْ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ .

hadiths.title: Jami` at-Tirmidhi 2748

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ إِنَّ الْعُطَاسَ فِي الصَّلاَةِ مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ
chapter.englishTitle: What Has Been Related About 'Sneezing During Salat Is From Ash-Shaitan'

hadiths.englishRaw:
Narrated Abu Yaqzan:

from 'Adi - and he is Ibn Thabit - from his father, from his grandfather - [from the Prophet ﷺ]: "Sneezing, dozing and yawning during Salat, and menstruation, regurgitation and nosebleeds are from Ash-Shaitan."
hadiths.body: from 'Adi - and he is Ibn Thabit - from his father, from his grandfather - [from the Prophet ﷺ]: "Sneezing, dozing and yawning during Salat, and menstruation, regurgitation and nosebleeds are from Ash-Shaitan."
hadiths.arabic:
حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ حُجْرٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا شَرِيكٌ، عَنْ أَبِي الْيَقْظَانِ، عَنْ عَدِيِّ بْنِ ثَابِتٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ جَدِّهِ، رَفَعَهُ قَالَ  " الْعُطَاسُ وَالنُّعَاسُ وَالتَّثَاؤُبُ فِي الصَّلاَةِ وَالْحَيْضُ وَالْقَىْءُ وَالرُّعَافُ مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ " . 

قَالَ أَبُو عِيسَى هَذَا حَدِيثٌ غَرِيبٌ لاَ نَعْرِفُهُ إِلاَّ مِنْ حَدِيثِ شَرِيكٍ عَنْ أَبِي الْيَقْظَانِ . قَالَ وَسَأَلْتُ مُحَمَّدَ بْنَ إِسْمَاعِيلَ عَنْ عَدِيِّ بْنِ ثَابِتٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ جَدِّهِ قُلْتُ لَهُ مَا اسْمُ جَدِّ عَدِيٍّ قَالَ لاَ أَدْرِي . وَذُكِرَ عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ مَعِينٍ قَالَ اسْمُهُ دِينَارٌ .

hadiths.title: Jami` at-Tirmidhi 2749

chapter.arabicTitle: باب كَرَاهِيَةِ أَنْ يُقَامَ الرَّجُلُ مِنْ مَجْلِسِهِ ثُمَّ يُجْلَسُ فِيهِ
chapter.englishTitle: The Disdain of Making A Man Stand From His Seat Then Sit In It

hadiths.englishRaw:
Narrated Ibn 'Umar:

that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Let one of you not have his brother stand from his seat then sit in it."
hadiths.body: that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Let one of you not have his brother stand from his seat then sit in it."
hadiths.arabic:
حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ، عَنْ أَيُّوبَ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ قَالَ  " لاَ يُقِمْ أَحَدُكُمْ أَخَاهُ مِنْ مَجْلِسِهِ ثُمَّ يَجْلِسُ فِيهِ " . 

قَالَ أَبُو عِيسَى هَذَا حَدِيثٌ حَسَنٌ صَحِيحٌ .

hadiths.title: Jami` at-Tirmidhi 2750

chapter.arabicTitle: باب كَرَاهِيَةِ أَنْ يُقَامَ الرَّجُلُ مِنْ مَجْلِسِهِ ثُمَّ يُجْلَسُ فِيهِ
chapter.englishTitle: The Disdain of Making A Man Stand From His Seat Then Sit In It

hadiths.englishRaw:
Narrated Ibn 'Umar:

that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Let one of you not have his brother stand from his seat then sit in it."
hadiths.body: that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Let one of you not have his brother stand from his seat then sit in it."
hadiths.arabic:
حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ بْنُ عَلِيٍّ الْخَلاَّلُ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ سَالِمٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ  " لاَ يُقِمْ أَحَدُكُمْ أَخَاهُ مِنْ مَجْلِسِهِ ثُمَّ يَجْلِسُ فِيهِ " . قَالَ وَكَانَ الرَّجُلُ يَقُومُ لاِبْنِ عُمَرَ فَلاَ يَجْلِسُ فِيهِ . 

قَالَ أَبُو عِيسَى هَذَا حَدِيثٌ صَحِيحٌ .

hadiths.title: Jami` at-Tirmidhi 2751

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ إِذَا قَامَ الرَّجُلُ مِنْ مَجْلِسِهِ ثُمَّ رَجَعَ إِلَيْهِ فَهُوَ أَحَقُّ بِهِ
chapter.englishTitle: When A Man Stands From His Seat Then Returns [To It] Then He Has More Right To it

hadiths.englishRaw:
Narrated Wahb bin Hudaifah:

that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "A man has more right to his seat. If he leaves for some need of his, then he returns, then he has more right to his seat."
hadiths.body: that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "A man has more right to his seat. If he leaves for some need of his, then he returns, then he has more right to his seat."
hadiths.arabic:
حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ، حَدَّثَنَا خَالِدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ الْوَاسِطِيُّ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ يَحْيَى، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ يَحْيَى بْنِ حَبَّانَ، عَنْ عَمِّهِ، وَاسِعِ بْنِ حَبَّانَ، عَنْ وَهْبِ بْنِ حُذَيْفَةَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ قَالَ  " الرَّجُلُ أَحَقُّ بِمَجْلِسِهِ وَإِنْ خَرَجَ لِحَاجَتِهِ ثُمَّ عَادَ فَهُوَ أَحَقُّ بِمَجْلِسِهِ " . 

قَالَ أَبُو عِيسَى هَذَا حَدِيثٌ حَسَنٌ صَحِيحٌ غَرِيبٌ . وَفِي الْبَابِ عَنْ أَبِي بَكْرَةَ وَأَبِي سَعِيدٍ وَأَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ .

hadiths.title: Jami` at-Tirmidhi 2752

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ فِي كَرَاهِيَةِ الْجُلُوسِ بَيْنَ الرَّجُلَيْنِ بِغَيْرِ إِذْنِهِمَا
chapter.englishTitle: What Has Been Related About It Being Disliked To Sit Between Two Men Without Their Permission

hadiths.englishRaw:
Narrated 'Abdullah bin 'Amr:

that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "It is not lawful for a man to separate two people except with their permission."
hadiths.body: that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "It is not lawful for a man to separate two people except with their permission."
hadiths.arabic:
حَدَّثَنَا سُوَيْدٌ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ، أَخْبَرَنَا أُسَامَةُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ، حَدَّثَنِي عَمْرُو بْنُ شُعَيْبٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَمْرٍو، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ قَالَ  " لاَ يَحِلُّ لِلرَّجُلِ أَنْ يُفَرِّقَ بَيْنَ اثْنَيْنِ إِلاَّ بِإِذْنِهِمَا " . 

قَالَ أَبُو عِيسَى هَذَا حَدِيثٌ حَسَنٌ صَحِيحٌ . وَقَدْ رَوَاهُ عَامِرٌ الأَحْوَلُ عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ شُعَيْبٍ أَيْضًا .

hadiths.title: Jami` at-Tirmidhi 2753

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ فِي كَرَاهِيَةِ الْقُعُودِ وَسْطَ الْحَلْقَةِ
chapter.englishTitle: What Has Been Related About It Being Disliked To Sit In The Middle Of A Circle

hadiths.englishRaw:
Narrated Abu Miljaz:

that a man sat in the middle of a circle so Hudhaifah said: "Cursed upon the tongue of Muhammad - or - Cursed, by Allah upon the tongue of Muhammad ﷺ, is he who sits in the middle of a the circle."
hadiths.body: that a man sat in the middle of a circle so Hudhaifah said: "Cursed upon the tongue of Muhammad - or - Cursed, by Allah upon the tongue of Muhammad ﷺ, is he who sits in the middle of a the circle."
hadiths.arabic:
حَدَّثَنَا سُوَيْدٌ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ، أَخْبَرَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي مِجْلَزٍ، أَنَّ رَجُلاً، قَعَدَ وَسْطَ حَلْقَةٍ فَقَالَ حُذَيْفَةُ مَلْعُونٌ عَلَى لِسَانِ مُحَمَّدٍ أَوْ لَعَنَ اللَّهُ عَلَى لِسَانِ مُحَمَّدٍ ﷺ - مَنْ قَعَدَ وَسْطَ الْحَلْقَةِ . 

قَالَ أَبُو عِيسَى هَذَا حَدِيثٌ حَسَنٌ صَحِيحٌ وَأَبُو مِجْلَزٍ اسْمُهُ لاَحِقُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ .

hadiths.title: Jami` at-Tirmidhi 2754

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ فِي كَرَاهِيَةِ قِيَامِ الرَّجُلِ لِلرَّجُلِ
chapter.englishTitle: What Has Been Related About It Being Disliked For A Man To Stand For Another Man

hadiths.englishRaw:
Narrated Anas:

"There was no person more beloved to them than the Messenger of Allah ﷺ." [He said:] "And they would not stand when they saw him because they knew that he disliked that."
hadiths.body: "There was no person more beloved to them than the Messenger of Allah ﷺ." [He said:] "And they would not stand when they saw him because they knew that he disliked that."
hadiths.arabic:
حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَفَّانُ، أَخْبَرَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ، عَنْ حُمَيْدٍ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ، قَالَ لَمْ يَكُنْ شَخْصٌ أَحَبَّ إِلَيْهِمْ مِنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ قَالَ وَكَانُوا إِذَا رَأَوْهُ لَمْ يَقُومُوا لِمَا يَعْلَمُونَ مِنْ كَرَاهِيَتِهِ لِذَلِكَ . 

قَالَ أَبُو عِيسَى هَذَا حَدِيثٌ حَسَنٌ صَحِيحٌ غَرِيبٌ مِنْ هَذَا الْوَجْهِ .

hadiths.title: Jami` at-Tirmidhi 2755

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ فِي كَرَاهِيَةِ قِيَامِ الرَّجُلِ لِلرَّجُلِ
chapter.englishTitle: What Has Been Related About It Being Disliked For A Man To Stand For Another Man

hadiths.englishRaw:
Narrated Abu Miljaz:

that Mu'awiyah came out and 'Abdullah bin Az-Zubair and Ibn Safwan stood for him when they saw him, so he said: "Sit, I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ saying: 'Whoever wishes that he be received by men standing then, let him take his seat in the Fire.'"
hadiths.body: that Mu'awiyah came out and 'Abdullah bin Az-Zubair and Ibn Safwan stood for him when they saw him, so he said: "Sit, I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ saying: 'Whoever wishes that he be received by men standing then, let him take his seat in the Fire.'"
hadiths.arabic:
حَدَّثَنَا مَحْمُودُ بْنُ غَيْلاَنَ، حَدَّثَنَا قَبِيصَةُ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ حَبِيبِ بْنِ الشَّهِيدِ، عَنْ أَبِي مِجْلَزٍ، قَالَ خَرَجَ مُعَاوِيَةُ فَقَامَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ الزُّبَيْرِ وَابْنُ صَفْوَانَ حِينَ رَأَوْهُ . فَقَالَ اجْلِسَا سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ يَقُولُ  " مَنْ سَرَّهُ أَنْ يَتَمَثَّلَ لَهُ الرِّجَالُ قِيَامًا فَلْيَتَبَوَّأْ مَقْعَدَهُ مِنَ النَّارِ " . وَفِي الْبَابِ عَنْ أَبِي أُمَامَةَ . 

قَالَ أَبُو عِيسَى هَذَا حَدِيثٌ حَسَنٌ .

hadiths.title: Jami` at-Tirmidhi 2756

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ فِي تَقْلِيمِ الأَظْفَارِ
chapter.englishTitle: What Has Been Related About Trimming The Fingernails

hadiths.englishRaw:
Narrated Abu Hurairah:

that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Five are from the Fitrah: Cutting the pubic hair, circumcision, paring the mustache, plucking the under arm hair and trimming the fingernails."
hadiths.body: that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Five are from the Fitrah: Cutting the pubic hair, circumcision, paring the mustache, plucking the under arm hair and trimming the fingernails."
hadiths.arabic:
حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ بْنُ عَلِيٍّ الْحُلْوَانِيُّ الْخَلاَّلُ، وَغَيْرُ، وَاحِدٍ، قَالُوا حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ الْمُسَيَّبِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ  " خَمْسٌ مِنَ الْفِطْرَةِ الاِسْتِحْدَادُ وَالْخِتَانُ وَقَصُّ الشَّارِبِ وَنَتْفُ الإِبْطِ وَتَقْلِيمُ الأَظْفَارِ " . 

قَالَ أَبُو عِيسَى هَذَا حَدِيثٌ حَسَنٌ صَحِيحٌ .

hadiths.title: Jami` at-Tirmidhi 2757

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ فِي تَقْلِيمِ الأَظْفَارِ
chapter.englishTitle: What Has Been Related About Trimming The Fingernails

hadiths.englishRaw:
Narrated 'Aishah:

that the Prophet ﷺ said: "Ten are from the Fitrah: Paring the mustache, leaving the beard to grow, Siwak, cleaning the nose with water, paring the fingernails, washing the knuckles, plucking the underarm hair, shaving the pubic hairs, and Intiqas with water."
hadiths.body: that the Prophet ﷺ said: "Ten are from the Fitrah: Paring the mustache, leaving the beard to grow, Siwak, cleaning the nose with water, paring the fingernails, washing the knuckles, plucking the underarm hair, shaving the pubic hairs, and Intiqas with water."
hadiths.arabic:
حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ، وَهَنَّادٌ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، عَنْ زَكَرِيَّا بْنِ أَبِي زَائِدَةَ، عَنْ مُصْعَبِ بْنِ شَيْبَةَ، عَنْ طَلْقِ بْنِ حَبِيبٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ الزُّبَيْرِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ قَالَ  " عَشْرٌ مِنَ الْفِطْرَةِ قَصُّ الشَّارِبِ وَإِعْفَاءُ اللِّحْيَةِ وَالسِّوَاكُ وَالاِسْتِنْشَاقُ وَقَصُّ الأَظْفَارِ وَغَسْلُ الْبَرَاجِمِ وَنَتْفُ الإِبْطِ وَحَلْقُ الْعَانَةِ وَانْتِقَاصُ الْمَاءِ " . قَالَ زَكَرِيَّا قَالَ مُصْعَبٌ وَنَسِيتُ الْعَاشِرَةَ إِلاَّ أَنْ تَكُونَ الْمَضْمَضَةَ . قَالَ أَبُو عُبَيْدٍ انْتِقَاصُ الْمَاءِ الاِسْتِنْجَاءُ بِالْمَاءِ . وَفِي الْبَابِ عَنْ عَمَّارِ بْنِ يَاسِرٍ وَابْنِ عُمَرَ وَأَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ . 

قَالَ أَبُو عِيسَى هَذَا حَدِيثٌ حَسَنٌ .

hadiths.title: Jami` at-Tirmidhi 2758

chapter.arabicTitle: باب فِي التَّوْقِيتِ فِي تَقْلِيمِ الأَظْفَارِ وَأَخْذِ الشَّارِبِ
chapter.englishTitle: What Has Been Related About The Time Limit For Trimming The Fingernails And Taking From The Mustache

hadiths.englishRaw:
Narrated Anas:

from the Prophet ﷺ, that he ﷺ fixed the time as every forty nights for them to trimming the fingernails, taking from the mustache, and shaving the pubic hairs.
hadiths.body: from the Prophet ﷺ, that he ﷺ fixed the time as every forty nights for them to trimming the fingernails, taking from the mustache, and shaving the pubic hairs.
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ مَنْصُورٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الصَّمَدِ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْوَارِثِ، حَدَّثَنَا صَدَقَةُ بْنُ مُوسَى أَبُو مُحَمَّدٍ، صَاحِبُ الدَّقِيقِ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عِمْرَانَ الْجَوْنِيُّ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ أَنَّهُ وَقَّتَ لَهُمْ فِي كُلِّ أَرْبَعِينَ لَيْلَةً تَقْلِيمَ الأَظْفَارِ وَأَخْذَ الشَّارِبِ وَحَلْقَ الْعَانَةِ .

hadiths.title: Jami` at-Tirmidhi 2759

chapter.arabicTitle: باب فِي التَّوْقِيتِ فِي تَقْلِيمِ الأَظْفَارِ وَأَخْذِ الشَّارِبِ
chapter.englishTitle: What Has Been Related About The Time Limit For Trimming The Fingernails And Taking From The Mustache

hadiths.englishRaw:
Narrated Anas bin Malik:

"[The Messenger of Allah ﷺ] fixed the time for us paring the mustache, trimming the fingernails, shaving the pubic hairs and plucking the underarm hairs - that we not leave it for more than forty days."
hadiths.body: "[The Messenger of Allah ﷺ] fixed the time for us paring the mustache, trimming the fingernails, shaving the pubic hairs and plucking the underarm hairs - that we not leave it for more than forty days."
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ، حَدَّثَنَا جَعْفَرُ بْنُ سُلَيْمَانَ، عَنْ أَبِي عِمْرَانَ الْجَوْنِيِّ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، قَالَ وَقَّتَ لَنَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ فِي قَصِّ الشَّارِبِ وَتَقْلِيمِ الأَظْفَارِ وَحَلْقِ الْعَانَةِ وَنَتْفِ الإِبْطِ أَنْ لاَ نَتْرُكَ أَكْثَرَ مِنْ أَرْبَعِينَ يَوْمًا . قَالَ هَذَا أَصَحُّ مِنْ حَدِيثِ الأَوَّلِ . وَصَدَقَةُ بْنُ مُوسَى لَيْسَ عِنْدَهُمْ بِالْحَافِظِ .

hadiths.title: Jami` at-Tirmidhi 2760

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ فِي قَصِّ الشَّارِبِ
chapter.englishTitle: What Has Been Related About Paring The Moustache

hadiths.englishRaw:
Narrated Ibn 'Abbas:

"The Prophet ﷺ would pare, or take from his mustache, and Ibrahim Khalilur-Rahman would do it (as well)."
hadiths.body: "The Prophet ﷺ would pare, or take from his mustache, and Ibrahim Khalilur-Rahman would do it (as well)."
hadiths.arabic:
حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عُمَرَ بْنِ الْوَلِيدِ الْكِنْدِيُّ الْكُوفِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ آدَمَ، عَنْ إِسْرَائِيلَ، عَنْ سِمَاكٍ، عَنْ عِكْرِمَةَ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، قَالَ كَانَ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ يَقُصُّ أَوْ يَأْخُذُ مِنْ شَارِبِهِ وَكَانَ إِبْرَاهِيمُ خَلِيلُ الرَّحْمَنِ يَفْعَلُهُ . 

قَالَ أَبُو عِيسَى هَذَا حَدِيثٌ حَسَنٌ غَرِيبٌ .

hadiths.title: Jami` at-Tirmidhi 2761

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ فِي قَصِّ الشَّارِبِ
chapter.englishTitle: What Has Been Related About Paring The Moustache

hadiths.englishRaw:
Narrated Zaid bin Arqam:

that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Whoever does not take from his mustache, then he is not from us."
hadiths.body: that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Whoever does not take from his mustache, then he is not from us."
hadiths.arabic:
حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مَنِيعٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبِيدَةُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ، عَنْ يُوسُفَ بْنِ صُهَيْبٍ، عَنْ حَبِيبِ بْنِ يَسَارٍ، عَنْ زَيْدِ بْنِ أَرْقَمَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ قَالَ  " مَنْ لَمْ يَأْخُذْ مِنْ شَارِبِهِ فَلَيْسَ مِنَّا " . وَفِي الْبَابِ عَنِ الْمُغِيرَةِ بْنِ شُعْبَةَ . 

قَالَ أَبُو عِيسَى هَذَا حَدِيثٌ حَسَنٌ صَحِيحٌ .

hadiths.title: Jami` at-Tirmidhi 2762

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ فِي الأَخْذِ مِنَ اللِّحْيَةِ
chapter.englishTitle: What Has Been Related About Taking From The Beard

hadiths.englishRaw:
Narrated 'Amr bin Shu'aib:

from his father, from his grandfather that he Prophet ﷺ would take from his beard; from its breadth and its length.
hadiths.body: from his father, from his grandfather that he Prophet ﷺ would take from his beard; from its breadth and its length.
hadiths.arabic:
حَدَّثَنَا هَنَّادٌ، حَدَّثَنَا عُمَرُ بْنُ هَارُونَ، عَنْ أُسَامَةَ بْنِ زَيْدٍ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ شُعَيْبٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ جَدِّهِ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ كَانَ يَأْخُذُ مِنْ لِحْيَتِهِ مِنْ عَرْضِهَا وَطُولِهَا . 

قَالَ أَبُو عِيسَى هَذَا حَدِيثٌ غَرِيبٌ . وَسَمِعْتُ مُحَمَّدَ بْنَ إِسْمَاعِيلَ يَقُولُ عُمَرُ بْنُ هَارُونَ مُقَارِبُ الْحَدِيثِ لاَ أَعْرِفُ لَهُ حَدِيثًا لَيْسَ إِسْنَادُهُ أَصْلاً أَوْ قَالَ يَنْفَرِدُ بِهِ إِلاَّ هَذَا الْحَدِيثَ كَانَ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ يَأْخُذُ مِنْ لِحْيَتِهِ مِنْ عَرْضِهَا وَطُولِهَا . لاَ نَعْرِفُهُ إِلاَّ مِنْ حَدِيثِ عُمَرَ بْنِ هَارُونَ وَرَأَيْتُهُ حَسَنَ الرَّأْىِ فِي عُمَرَ بْنِ هَارُونَ . 

قَالَ أَبُو عِيسَى وَسَمِعْتُ قُتَيْبَةَ يَقُولُ عُمَرُ بْنُ هَارُونَ كَانَ صَاحِبَ حَدِيثٍ وَكَانَ يَقُولُ الإِيمَانُ قَوْلٌ وَعَمَلٌ .

hadiths.title: Jami` at-Tirmidhi 2763

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ فِي إِعْفَاءِ اللِّحْيَةِ
chapter.englishTitle: What Has Been Related About Leaving The Beard To Grow

hadiths.englishRaw:
Narrated Ibn 'Umar:

that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Trim the mustache and leave the beard to grow."
hadiths.body: that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Trim the mustache and leave the beard to grow."
hadiths.arabic:
حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ بْنُ عَلِيٍّ الْخَلاَّلُ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ نُمَيْرٍ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ  " أَحْفُوا الشَّوَارِبَ وَأَعْفُوا اللِّحَى " . 

قَالَ أَبُو عِيسَى هَذَا حَدِيثٌ صَحِيحٌ .

hadiths.title: Jami` at-Tirmidhi 2764

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ فِي إِعْفَاءِ اللِّحْيَةِ
chapter.englishTitle: What Has Been Related About Leaving The Beard To Grow

hadiths.englishRaw:
Narrated Ibn 'Umar:

that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ ordered trimming the mustache and leaving the beard to grow.
hadiths.body: that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ ordered trimming the mustache and leaving the beard to grow.
hadiths.arabic:
حَدَّثَنَا الأَنْصَارِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا مَعْنٌ، حَدَّثَنَا مَالِكٌ، عَنْ أَبِي بَكْرِ بْنِ نَافِعٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ أَمَرَنَا بِإِحْفَاءِ الشَّوَارِبِ وَإِعْفَاءِ اللِّحَى . 

قَالَ أَبُو عِيسَى هَذَا حَدِيثٌ حَسَنٌ صَحِيحٌ . وَأَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ نَافِعٍ هُوَ مَوْلَى ابْنِ عُمَرَ ثِقَةٌ وَعُمَرُ بْنُ نَافِعٍ ثِقَةٌ وَعَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ نَافِعٍ مَوْلَى ابْنِ عُمَرَ يُضَعَّفُ .

hadiths.title: Jami` at-Tirmidhi 2765

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ فِي وَضْعِ إِحْدَى الرِّجْلَيْنِ عَلَى الأُخْرَى مُسْتَلْقِيًا
chapter.englishTitle: What Has Been Related About Placing One Leg Over the Other While Laying on One's Back

hadiths.englishRaw:
Narrated 'Abbad bin Tamim:

from his paternal uncle, that he saw the Prophet ﷺ reclining in the Masjid, and placing one of his feet atop another.
hadiths.body: from his paternal uncle, that he saw the Prophet ﷺ reclining in the Masjid, and placing one of his feet atop another.
hadiths.arabic:
حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ الْمَخْزُومِيُّ، وَغَيْرُ، وَاحِدٍ، قَالُوا حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عن عَبَّادِ بْنِ تَمِيمٍ، عَنْ عَمِّهِ، أَنَّهُ رَأَى النَّبِيَّ ﷺ مُسْتَلْقِيًا فِي الْمَسْجِدِ وَاضِعًا إِحْدَى رِجْلَيْهِ عَلَى الأُخْرَى . 

قَالَ أَبُو عِيسَى هَذَا حَدِيثٌ حَسَنٌ صَحِيحٌ . وَعَمُّ عَبَّادِ بْنِ تَمِيمٍ هُوَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ زَيْدِ بْنِ عَاصِمٍ الْمَازِنِيُّ .

hadiths.title: Jami` at-Tirmidhi 2766

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ فِي الْكَرَاهِيَةِ فِي ذَلِكَ
chapter.englishTitle: What Has Been Related About It Being Disliked To Do That

hadiths.englishRaw:
Narrated Jabir:

"The Messenger of Allah ﷺ prohibited Ishtimal As-Samma, Al-Ihtiba in one garment, and that a man raise one of his feet atop the other while he is reclining on his back."
hadiths.body: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ prohibited Ishtimal As-Samma, Al-Ihtiba in one garment, and that a man raise one of his feet atop the other while he is reclining on his back."
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ بْنُ أَسْبَاطِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ الْقُرَشِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ التَّيْمِيُّ، عَنْ خِدَاشٍ، عَنْ أَبِي الزُّبَيْرِ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ  " إِذَا اسْتَلْقَى أَحَدُكُمْ عَلَى ظَهْرِهِ فَلاَ يَضَعْ إِحْدَى رِجْلَيْهِ عَلَى الأُخْرَى " . هَذَا حَدِيثٌ رَوَاهُ غَيْرُ وَاحِدٍ عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ التَّيْمِيِّ . وَلاَ يُعْرَفُ خِدَاشٌ هَذَا مَنْ هُوَ وَقَدْ رَوَى لَهُ سُلَيْمَانُ التَّيْمِيُّ غَيْرَ حَدِيثٍ .

hadiths.title: Jami` at-Tirmidhi 2767

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ فِي الْكَرَاهِيَةِ فِي ذَلِكَ
chapter.englishTitle: What Has Been Related About It Being Disliked To Do That

hadiths.englishRaw:
Narrated Jabir:

"The Messenger of Allah ﷺ prohibited Ishtimal As-Samma, Al-Ihtiba in one garment, and that a man raise one of his feet atop the other while he is reclining on his back."
hadiths.body: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ prohibited Ishtimal As-Samma, Al-Ihtiba in one garment, and that a man raise one of his feet atop the other while he is reclining on his back."
hadiths.arabic:
حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ، حَدَّثَنَا اللَّيْثُ، عَنْ أَبِي الزُّبَيْرِ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ نَهَى عَنِ اشْتِمَالِ الصَّمَّاءِ وَالاِحْتِبَاءِ فِي ثَوْبٍ وَاحِدٍ وَأَنْ يَرْفَعَ الرَّجُلُ إِحْدَى رِجْلَيْهِ عَلَى الأُخْرَى وَهُوَ مُسْتَلْقٍ عَلَى ظَهْرِهِ . 

قَالَ أَبُو عِيسَى هَذَا حَدِيثٌ حَسَنٌ صَحِيحٌ .

hadiths.title: Jami` at-Tirmidhi 2768

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ فِي كَرَاهِيَةِ الاِضْطِجَاعِ عَلَى الْبَطْنِ
chapter.englishTitle: What Has Been Related About It Being Disliked To Lie Down On The Stomach

hadiths.englishRaw:
Narrated Abu Hurairah:

that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ saw a man laying on his stomach so he said: "Indeed such laying is not loved by Allah."
hadiths.body: that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ saw a man laying on his stomach so he said: "Indeed such laying is not loved by Allah."
hadiths.arabic:
حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو كُرَيْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدَةُ بْنُ سُلَيْمَانَ، وَعَبْدُ الرَّحِيمِ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَمْرٍو، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو سَلَمَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ رَأَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ رَجُلاً مُضْطَجِعًا عَلَى بَطْنِهِ فَقَالَ  " إِنَّ هَذِهِ ضَجْعَةٌ لاَ يُحِبُّهَا اللَّهُ " . وَفِي الْبَابِ عَنْ طِهْفَةَ وَابْنِ عُمَرَ . 

قَالَ أَبُو عِيسَى وَرَوَى يَحْيَى بْنُ أَبِي كَثِيرٍ هَذَا الْحَدِيثَ عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ عَنْ يَعِيشَ بْنِ طِهْفَةَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ وَيُقَالُ طِخْفَةُ وَالصَّحِيحُ طِهْفَةُ . وَقَالَ بَعْضُ الْحُفَّاظِ الصَّحِيحُ طِخْفَةُ وَيُقَالُ طِغْفَةُ . يَعِيشُ هُوَ مِنَ الصَّحَابَةِ .

hadiths.title: Jami` at-Tirmidhi 2769

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ فِي حِفْظِ الْعَوْرَةِ
chapter.englishTitle: What Has Been Related About Protecting The 'Awrah

hadiths.englishRaw:
Narrated Bahz bin Hakim:

"My father narrated to me from my grandfather, who said: 'I said: "O Messenger of Allah! Regarding our 'Awrah, what of it must we cover and what of it may we leave?" He said: "Protect your 'Awrah except from your wife or what your right hand possesses."' He said: "What about a man with another man?" He said: "If you are able to not let anyone see it, then do so." I said: "What about a man when he is alone?" He said: "Allah is most deserving of being shy from Him."
hadiths.body: "My father narrated to me from my grandfather, who said: 'I said: "O Messenger of Allah! Regarding our 'Awrah, what of it must we cover and what of it may we leave?" He said: "Protect your 'Awrah except from your wife or what your right hand possesses."' He said: "What about a man with another man?" He said: "If you are able to not let anyone see it, then do so." I said: "What about a man when he is alone?" He said: "Allah is most deserving of being shy from Him."
hadiths.arabic:
حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا بَهْزُ بْنُ حَكِيمٍ، حَدَّثَنِي أَبِي، عَنْ جَدِّي، قَالَ قُلْتُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ عَوْرَاتُنَا مَا نَأْتِي مِنْهَا وَمَا نَذَرُ قَالَ " احْفَظْ عَوْرَتَكَ إِلاَّ مِنْ زَوْجَتِكَ أَوْ مِمَّا مَلَكَتْ يَمِينُكَ " . فَقَالَ الرَّجُلُ يَكُونُ مَعَ الرَّجُلِ قَالَ " إِنِ اسْتَطَعْتَ أَنْ لاَ يَرَاهَا أَحَدٌ فَافْعَلْ " . قُلْتُ وَالرَّجُلُ يَكُونُ خَالِيًا . قَالَ " فَاللَّهُ أَحَقُّ أَنْ يُسْتَحْيَا مِنْهُ " . 

قَالَ أَبُو عِيسَى هَذَا حَدِيثٌ حَسَنٌ . وَجَدُّ بَهْزٍ اسْمُهُ مُعَاوِيَةُ بْنُ حَيْدَةَ الْقُشَيْرِيُّ وَقَدْ رَوَى الْجُرَيْرِيُّ عَنْ حَكِيمِ بْنِ مُعَاوِيَةَ وَهُوَ وَالِدُ بَهْزٍ .

hadiths.title: Jami` at-Tirmidhi 2770

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ فِي الاِتِّكَاءِ
chapter.englishTitle: What Has Been Related About Reclining

hadiths.englishRaw:
Narrated Jabir bin Samurah:

"I saw the Messenger of Allah ﷺ reclining upon as pillow, on his left side."
hadiths.body: "I saw the Messenger of Allah ﷺ reclining upon as pillow, on his left side."
hadiths.arabic:
حَدَّثَنَا عَبَّاسُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ الدُّورِيُّ الْبَغْدَادِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ مَنْصُورٍ الْكُوفِيُّ، أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْرَائِيلُ، عَنْ سِمَاكِ بْنِ حَرْبٍ، عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ سَمُرَةَ، قَالَ رَأَيْتُ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ مُتَّكِئًا عَلَى وِسَادَةٍ عَلَى يَسَارِهِ . 

قَالَ أَبُو عِيسَى هَذَا حَدِيثٌ حَسَنٌ غَرِيبٌ وَرَوَى غَيْرُ وَاحِدٍ هَذَا الْحَدِيثَ عَنْ إِسْرَائِيلَ عَنْ سِمَاكٍ عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ سَمُرَةَ قَالَ رَأَيْتُ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ مُتَّكِئًا عَلَى وِسَادَةٍ . وَلَمْ يَذْكُرْ عَلَى يَسَارِهِ .

hadiths.title: Jami` at-Tirmidhi 2771

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ فِي الاِتِّكَاءِ
chapter.englishTitle: What Has Been Related About Reclining

hadiths.englishRaw:
Narrated Jabir bin Samurah:

"I saw the Prophet ﷺ reclining upon a pillow."
hadiths.body: "I saw the Prophet ﷺ reclining upon a pillow."
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ بْنُ عِيسَى، حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، عَنْ إِسْرَائِيلَ، عَنْ سِمَاكِ بْنِ حَرْبٍ، عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ سَمُرَةَ، قَالَ رَأَيْتُ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ مُتَّكِئًا عَلَى وِسَادَةٍ . هَذَا حَدِيثٌ صَحِيحٌ .

hadiths.title: Jami` at-Tirmidhi 2772

chapter.arabicTitle: باب ))
chapter.englishTitle: 'A Man Is Not To Be Lead In His Dominion']

hadiths.englishRaw:
Narrated Abu Mas'ud:

that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "A man is not lead in his Sultanah, and his seat of honor in his house is not sat in without his permission."
hadiths.body: that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "A man is not lead in his Sultanah, and his seat of honor in his house is not sat in without his permission."
hadiths.arabic:
حَدَّثَنَا هَنَّادٌ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو مُعَاوِيَةَ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ إِسْمَاعِيلَ بْنِ رَجَاءٍ، عَنْ أَوْسِ بْنِ ضَمْعَجٍ، عَنْ أَبِي مَسْعُودٍ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ قَالَ  " لاَ يُؤَمُّ الرَّجُلُ فِي سُلْطَانِهِ وَلاَ يُجْلَسُ عَلَى تَكْرِمَتِهِ فِي بَيْتِهِ إِلاَّ بِإِذْنِهِ " . 

قَالَ أَبُو عِيسَى هَذَا حَدِيثٌ حَسَنٌ صَحِيحٌ .

hadiths.title: Jami` at-Tirmidhi 2773

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ أَنَّ الرَّجُلَ أَحَقُّ بِصَدْرِ دَابَّتِهِ
chapter.englishTitle: What Has Been Related About 'A Man Has More Right To The Front Of His Beast.'

hadiths.englishRaw:
Narrated 'Abdullah bin Buraidah:

"I heard my father Buraidah saying: 'I was walking with the Prophet ﷺ when a man came to him with a donkey, so he said: "O Messenger of Allah! Ride" and the man moved toward the back. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "No, you have more right to the front of your beast, unless you allot it for me." He said: "I have allotted it for you.'" He said: 'So he rode.'"
hadiths.body: "I heard my father Buraidah saying: 'I was walking with the Prophet ﷺ when a man came to him with a donkey, so he said: "O Messenger of Allah! Ride" and the man moved toward the back. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "No, you have more right to the front of your beast, unless you allot it for me." He said: "I have allotted it for you.'" He said: 'So he rode.'"
hadiths.arabic:
حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَمَّارٍ الْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ حُرَيْثٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ الْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ وَاقِدٍ، حَدَّثَنِي أَبِي، حَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ بُرَيْدَةَ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبِي بُرَيْدَةَ، يَقُولُ بَيْنَمَا النَّبِيُّ ﷺ يَمْشِي إِذْ جَاءَهُ رَجُلٌ وَمَعَهُ حِمَارٌ فَقَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ارْكَبْ . وَتَأَخَّرَ الرَّجُلُ . فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ  " لأَنْتَ أَحَقُّ بِصَدْرِ دَابَّتِكَ إِلاَّ أَنْ تَجْعَلَهُ لِي " . قَالَ قَدْ جَعَلْتُهُ لَكَ . قَالَ فَرَكِبَ . 

قَالَ أَبُو عِيسَى هَذَا حَدِيثٌ حَسَنٌ غَرِيبٌ مِنْ هَذَا الْوَجْهِ . وَفِي الْبَابِ عَنْ قَيْسِ بْنِ سَعْدِ بْنِ عُبَادَةَ .

hadiths.title: Jami` at-Tirmidhi 2774

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ فِي الرُّخْصَةِ فِي اتِّخَاذِ الأَنْمَاطِ
chapter.englishTitle: What Has Been Related About The Permission Regarding Using Anmat (Curtains, drapes, sheets, etc.)

hadiths.englishRaw:
Narrated Jabir:

that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Do you have Anmat?" I said: "Where would we get Anmat from?" He said: "Soon you will have Anmat" He said: "I would say to my wife: 'Remove your Anmat from my sight.' But she would say: 'Did not the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say: "Indeed you shall soon have Anmat?" He said: "So I left it."
hadiths.body: that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Do you have Anmat?" I said: "Where would we get Anmat from?" He said: "Soon you will have Anmat" He said: "I would say to my wife: 'Remove your Anmat from my sight.' But she would say: 'Did not the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say: "Indeed you shall soon have Anmat?" He said: "So I left it."
hadiths.arabic:
حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ مَهْدِيٍّ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ الْمُنْكَدِرِ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ " هَلْ لَكُمْ أَنْمَاطٌ " . قُلْتُ وَأَنَّى تَكُونُ لَنَا أَنْمَاطٌ قَالَ " أَمَا إِنَّهَا سَتَكُونُ لَكُمْ أَنْمَاطٌ " . قَالَ فَأَنَا أَقُولُ لاِمْرَأَتِي أَخِّرِي عَنِّي أَنْمَاطَكِ فَتَقُولُ أَلَمْ يَقُلِ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ " إِنَّهَا سَتَكُونُ لَكُمْ أَنْمَاطٌ " . قَالَ فَأَدَعُهَا . 

قَالَ أَبُو عِيسَى هَذَا حَدِيثٌ حَسَنٌ صَحِيحٌ .

hadiths.title: Jami` at-Tirmidhi 2775

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ فِي رُكُوبِ ثَلاَثَةٍ عَلَى دَابَّةٍ
chapter.englishTitle: What Has Been Related About Three Riding On A Beast

hadiths.englishRaw:
Narrated Iyas bin Salamah:

from his father who said: "I guided Allah's Prophet ﷺ and Al-Hasan and Al-Husain, on his gray mule until I brought him to the apartment of the Prophet ﷺ, this one was in front of him, and this one behind him."
hadiths.body: from his father who said: "I guided Allah's Prophet ﷺ and Al-Hasan and Al-Husain, on his gray mule until I brought him to the apartment of the Prophet ﷺ, this one was in front of him, and this one behind him."
hadiths.arabic:
حَدَّثَنَا عَبَّاسٌ الْعَنْبَرِيُّ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْعَظِيمِ، حَدَّثَنَا النَّضْرُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، هُوَ الْجُرَشِيُّ الْيَمَامِيُّ حَدَّثَنَا عِكْرِمَةُ بْنُ عَمَّارٍ، عَنْ إِيَاسِ بْنِ سَلَمَةَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، قَالَ لَقَدْ قُدْتُ نَبِيَّ اللَّهِ ﷺ وَالْحَسَنَ وَالْحُسَيْنَ عَلَى بَغْلَتِهِ الشَّهْبَاءِ حَتَّى أَدْخَلْتُهُ حُجْرَةَ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ هَذَا قُدَّامُهُ وَهَذَا خَلْفُهُ . وَفِي الْبَابِ عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ وَعَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ جَعْفَرٍ . 

قَالَ أَبُو عِيسَى هَذَا حَدِيثٌ حَسَنٌ صَحِيحٌ غَرِيبٌ مِنْ هَذَا الْوَجْهِ .

hadiths.title: Jami` at-Tirmidhi 2776

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ فِي نَظْرَةِ الْمُفَاجَأَةِ
chapter.englishTitle: What Has Been Related About The Unexpected Glance

hadiths.englishRaw:
Narrated Jabir bin 'Abdullah:

"I asked the Messenger Of Allah ﷺ about the unintentional glance, so he ordered me that I divert my sight."
hadiths.body: "I asked the Messenger Of Allah ﷺ about the unintentional glance, so he ordered me that I divert my sight."
hadiths.arabic:
حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مَنِيعٍ، حَدَّثَنَا هُشَيْمٌ، أَخْبَرَنَا يُونُسُ بْنُ عُبَيْدٍ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ أَبِي زُرْعَةَ بْنِ عَمْرِو بْنِ جَرِيرٍ، عَنْ جَرِيرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ سَأَلْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ عَنْ نَظْرَةِ الْفَجْأَةِ فَأَمَرَنِي أَنْ أَصْرِفَ بَصَرِي . 

قَالَ أَبُو عِيسَى هَذَا حَدِيثٌ حَسَنٌ صَحِيحٌ . وَأَبُو زُرْعَةَ بْنُ عَمْرٍو اسْمُهُ هَرِمٌ .

hadiths.title: Jami` at-Tirmidhi 2777

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ فِي نَظْرَةِ الْمُفَاجَأَةِ
chapter.englishTitle: What Has Been Related About The Unexpected Glance

hadiths.englishRaw:
Narrated Ibn Buraidah:

from his father (from the Prophet ﷺ) who said: "O 'Ali! Do not follow a look with a look, the first is for you, but the next is not for you."
hadiths.body: from his father (from the Prophet ﷺ) who said: "O 'Ali! Do not follow a look with a look, the first is for you, but the next is not for you."
hadiths.arabic:
حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ حُجْرٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا شَرِيكٌ، عَنْ أَبِي رَبِيعَةَ، عَنِ ابْنِ بُرَيْدَةَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، رَفَعَهُ قَالَ  " يَا عَلِيُّ لاَ تُتْبِعِ النَّظْرَةَ النَّظْرَةَ فَإِنَّ لَكَ الأُولَى وَلَيْسَتْ لَكَ الآخِرَةُ " . 

قَالَ أَبُو عِيسَى هَذَا حَدِيثٌ حَسَنٌ غَرِيبٌ لاَ نَعْرِفُهُ إِلاَّ مِنْ حَدِيثِ شَرِيكٍ .

hadiths.title: Jami` at-Tirmidhi 2778

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ فِي احْتِجَابِ النِّسَاءِ مِنَ الرِّجَالِ
chapter.englishTitle: What Has Been Related About Women Veiling From Men

hadiths.englishRaw:
Narrated Nabhan the freed slave of Umm Salamah:

to Ibn Shihab, that Umm Salamah narrated to him, that she and Maimunah were with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, she said: "So when we were with him, Ibn Umm Maktum came, and he entered upon him, and that was after veiling had been ordered for us. So the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: 'Veil yourselves from him.' So I said: 'O Messenger of Allah! Is he not blind such that he can not see us or recognize us?' So the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: 'Are you two blind such that you can not see him?'"
hadiths.narrator: Narrated Nabhan the freed slave of Umm Salamah:
hadiths.body: to Ibn Shihab, that Umm Salamah narrated to him, that she and Maimunah were with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, she said: "So when we were with him, Ibn Umm Maktum came, and he entered upon him, and that was after veiling had been ordered for us. So the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: 'Veil yourselves from him.' So I said: 'O Messenger of Allah! Is he not blind such that he can not see us or recognize us?' So the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: 'Are you two blind such that you can not see him?'"
hadiths.arabic:
حَدَّثَنَا سُوَيْدٌ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ، أَخْبَرَنَا يُونُسُ بْنُ يَزِيدَ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ نَبْهَانَ، مَوْلَى أُمِّ سَلَمَةَ أَنَّهُ حَدَّثَهُ أَنَّ أُمَّ سَلَمَةَ حَدَّثَتْهُ أَنَّهَا، كَانَتْ عِنْدَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ وَمَيْمُونَةُ قَالَتْ فَبَيْنَا نَحْنُ عِنْدَهُ أَقْبَلَ ابْنُ أُمِّ مَكْتُومٍ فَدَخَلَ عَلَيْهِ وَذَلِكَ بَعْدَ مَا أُمِرْنَا بِالْحِجَابِ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ " احْتَجِبَا مِنْهُ " . فَقُلْتُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ أَلَيْسَ هُوَ أَعْمَى لاَ يُبْصِرُنَا وَلاَ يَعْرِفُنَا فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ " أَفَعَمْيَاوَانِ أَنْتُمَا أَلَسْتُمَا تُبْصِرَانِهِ " . 

قَالَ أَبُو عِيسَى هَذَا حَدِيثٌ حَسَنٌ صَحِيحٌ .

hadiths.title: Jami` at-Tirmidhi 2779

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ فِي النَّهْىِ عَنِ الدُّخُولِ، عَلَى النِّسَاءِ إِلاَّ بِإِذْنِ الأَزْوَاجِ
chapter.englishTitle: What Has Been Related About The Prohibition Of Entering Upon Women Except with The Permission of the Husbands

hadiths.englishRaw:
Narrated Dhakwan:

from the freed slave of 'Amr bin Al-'As that 'Amr bin Al-'As sent him to 'Ali seeking his permission to enter upon Asma bint Umais, so he permitted him. When he was finished from what he needed, the freed slave of 'Amr bin Al-'As asked about that, so he said: "Indeed the Prophet ﷺ prohibited us - or - prohibited that we enter upon women, without the permission of their husbands."
hadiths.body: from the freed slave of 'Amr bin Al-'As that 'Amr bin Al-'As sent him to 'Ali seeking his permission to enter upon Asma bint Umais, so he permitted him. When he was finished from what he needed, the freed slave of 'Amr bin Al-'As asked about that, so he said: "Indeed the Prophet ﷺ prohibited us - or - prohibited that we enter upon women, without the permission of their husbands."
hadiths.arabic:
حَدَّثَنَا سُوَيْدُ بْنُ نَصْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ، أَخْبَرَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنِ الْحَكَمِ، عَنْ ذَكْوَانَ، عَنْ مَوْلَى، عَمْرِو بْنِ الْعَاصِي أَنَّ عَمْرَو بْنَ الْعَاصِي، أَرْسَلَهُ إِلَى عَلِيٍّ يَسْتَأْذِنُهُ عَلَى أَسْمَاءَ بِنْتِ عُمَيْسٍ فَأَذِنَ لَهُ حَتَّى إِذَا فَرَغَ مِنْ حَاجَتِهِ سَأَلَ الْمَوْلَى عَمْرَو بْنَ الْعَاصِي عَنْ ذَلِكَ فَقَالَ إِنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ نَهَانَا أَنْ نَدْخُلَ عَلَى النِّسَاءِ بِغَيْرِ إِذْنِ أَزْوَاجِهِنَّ . وَفِي الْبَابِ عَنْ عُقْبَةَ بْنِ عَامِرٍ وَعَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَمْرٍو وَجَابِرٍ . 

قَالَ أَبُو عِيسَى هَذَا حَدِيثٌ حَسَنٌ صَحِيحٌ .

hadiths.title: Jami` at-Tirmidhi 2780

chapter.arabicTitle: باب فِي تَحْذِيرِ فِتْنَةِ النِّسَاءِ
chapter.englishTitle: What Has Been Related About The Danger Of The Fitnah Of Women

hadiths.englishRaw:
Narrated Usamah bin Zaid, and Sa'eed bin Zaid bin 'Amr bin Nufail:

that the Prophet ﷺ said: "I have not left among the people after me, a Fitnah more harmful upon men than women."
hadiths.narrator: Narrated Usamah bin Zaid, and Sa'eed bin Zaid bin 'Amr bin Nufail:
hadiths.body: that the Prophet ﷺ said: "I have not left among the people after me, a Fitnah more harmful upon men than women."
hadiths.arabic:
حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الأَعْلَى الصَّنْعَانِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا الْمُعْتَمِرُ بْنُ سُلَيْمَانَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَبِي عُثْمَانَ، عَنْ أُسَامَةَ بْنِ زَيْدٍ، وَسَعِيدِ بْنِ زَيْدِ بْنِ عَمْرِو بْنِ نُفَيْلٍ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ  " مَا تَرَكْتُ بَعْدِي فِي النَّاسِ فِتْنَةً أَضَرَّ عَلَى الرِّجَالِ مِنَ النِّسَاءِ " . 

قَالَ أَبُو عِيسَى هَذَا حَدِيثٌ حَسَنٌ صَحِيحٌ . وَقَدْ رَوَى هَذَا الْحَدِيثَ غَيْرُ وَاحِدٍ مِنَ الثِّقَاتِ عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ التَّيْمِيِّ عَنْ أَبِي عُثْمَانَ عَنْ أُسَامَةَ بْنِ زَيْدٍ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ وَلَمْ يَذْكُرُوا فِيهِ عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ زَيْدِ بْنِ عَمْرِو بْنِ نُفَيْلٍ وَلاَ نَعْلَمُ أَحَدًا قَالَ عَنْ أُسَامَةَ بْنِ زَيْدٍ وَسَعِيدِ بْنِ زَيْدٍ غَيْرَ الْمُعْتَمِرِ . وَفِي الْبَابِ عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ .

hadiths.title: Jami` at-Tirmidhi 2781

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ فِي كَرَاهِيَةِ اتِّخَاذِ الْقُصَّةِ
chapter.englishTitle: What Has Been Related About Using Lock Of Hair

hadiths.englishRaw:
Narrated Humaid bin 'Abdur-Rahman:

that he heard Mu'awiyah giving a Khutbah in Al-Madinah, and saying: "Where are your scholars, O people of Al-Madinah? [Indeed] I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbidding from these locks (of hair), and saying: 'The Children of Isra'il were only ruined when their women used them.'"
hadiths.body: that he heard Mu'awiyah giving a Khutbah in Al-Madinah, and saying: "Where are your scholars, O people of Al-Madinah? [Indeed] I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbidding from these locks (of hair), and saying: 'The Children of Isra'il were only ruined when their women used them.'"
hadiths.arabic:
حَدَّثَنَا سُوَيْدٌ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ، أَخْبَرَنَا يُونُسُ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، أَخْبَرَنَا حُمَيْدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ مُعَاوِيَةَ، بِالْمَدِينَةِ يَخْطُبُ يَقُولُ أَيْنَ عُلَمَاؤُكُمْ يَا أَهْلَ الْمَدِينَةِ إِنِّي سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ يَنْهَى عَنْ هَذِهِ الْقُصَّةِ وَيَقُولُ  " إِنَّمَا هَلَكَتْ بَنُو إِسْرَائِيلَ حِينَ اتَّخَذَهَا نِسَاؤُهُمْ " . 

قَالَ أَبُو عِيسَى هَذَا حَدِيثٌ حَسَنٌ صَحِيحٌ . وَقَدْ رُوِيَ مِنْ غَيْرِ وَجْهٍ عَنْ مُعَاوِيَةَ .

hadiths.title: Jami` at-Tirmidhi 2782

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ فِي الْوَاصِلَةِ وَالْمُسْتَوْصِلَةِ وَالْوَاشِمَةِ وَالْمُسْتَوْشِمَةِ
chapter.englishTitle: What Has Been Related About Lengthening One's Hair, Seeking To Have Ones Hair Lengthened, Tattooing, And Seeking To Be Tattooed

hadiths.englishRaw:
Narrated 'Abdullah:

that the Prophet ﷺ cursed the women who practice tattooing and those who seek to be tattooed, the women who remove hair from their faces seeking beautification by changing the creation of Allah.
hadiths.body: that the Prophet ﷺ cursed the women who practice tattooing and those who seek to be tattooed, the women who remove hair from their faces seeking beautification by changing the creation of Allah.
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مَنِيعٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبِيدَةُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ، عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنْ عَلْقَمَةَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ لَعَنَ الْوَاشِمَاتِ وَالْمُسْتَوْشِمَاتِ وَالْمُتَنَمِّصَاتِ مُبْتَغِيَاتٍ لِلْحُسْنِ مُغَيِّرَاتٍ خَلْقَ اللَّهِ . قَالَ هَذَا حَدِيثٌ حَسَنٌ صَحِيحٌ . وَقَدْ رَوَاهُ شُعْبَةُ وَغَيْرُ وَاحِدٍ مِنَ الأَئِمَّةِ عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ .

hadiths.title: Jami` at-Tirmidhi 2783

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ فِي الْوَاصِلَةِ وَالْمُسْتَوْصِلَةِ وَالْوَاشِمَةِ وَالْمُسْتَوْشِمَةِ
chapter.englishTitle: What Has Been Related About Lengthening One's Hair, Seeking To Have Ones Hair Lengthened, Tattooing, And Seeking To Be Tattooed

hadiths.englishRaw:
Narrated Ibn 'Umar:

that the Prophet ﷺ said: "Allah's curse is upon the woman who lengthens hair and the women who seeks to have her hair lengthened, and the woman who tattoos and the woman who seeks to have her herself tattooed."
hadiths.body: that the Prophet ﷺ said: "Allah's curse is upon the woman who lengthens hair and the women who seeks to have her hair lengthened, and the woman who tattoos and the woman who seeks to have her herself tattooed."
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا سُوَيْدٌ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ الْمُبَارَكِ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ  " لَعَنَ اللَّهُ الْوَاصِلَةَ وَالْمُسْتَوْصِلَةَ وَالْوَاشِمَةَ وَالْمُسْتَوْشِمَةَ " . قَالَ نَافِعٌ الْوَشْمُ فِي اللِّثَةِ . قَالَ هَذَا حَدِيثٌ حَسَنٌ صَحِيحٌ . وَفِي الْبَابِ عَنْ عَائِشَةَ وَمَعْقِلِ بْنِ يَسَارٍ وَأَسْمَاءَ بِنْتِ أَبِي بَكْرٍ وَابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ .

hadiths.title: Jami` at-Tirmidhi 2784

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ فِي الْمُتَشَبِّهَاتِ بِالرِّجَالِ مِنَ النِّسَاءِ
chapter.englishTitle: What Has Been Related About Women Who Imitate Men

hadiths.englishRaw:
Narrated Ibn 'Abbas:

"The Messenger of Allah ﷺ cursed the women who imitate men and the men who imitate women."
hadiths.body: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ cursed the women who imitate men and the men who imitate women."
hadiths.arabic:
حَدَّثَنَا مَحْمُودُ بْنُ غَيْلاَنَ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ الطَّيَالِسِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، وَهَمَّامٌ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، عَنْ عِكْرِمَةَ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، قَالَ لَعَنَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ الْمُتَشَبِّهَاتِ بِالرِّجَالِ مِنَ النِّسَاءِ وَالْمُتَشَبِّهِينَ بِالنِّسَاءِ مِنَ الرِّجَالِ . 

قَالَ أَبُو عِيسَى هَذَا حَدِيثٌ حَسَنٌ صَحِيحٌ .

hadiths.title: Jami` at-Tirmidhi 2785

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ فِي الْمُتَشَبِّهَاتِ بِالرِّجَالِ مِنَ النِّسَاءِ
chapter.englishTitle: What Has Been Related About Women Who Imitate Men

hadiths.englishRaw:
Narrated Ibn 'Abbas:

"The Messenger of Allah ﷺ cursed those men who behave effeminately and those women whose behavior is masculine."
hadiths.body: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ cursed those men who behave effeminately and those women whose behavior is masculine."
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ بْنُ عَلِيٍّ الْخَلاَّلُ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ أَبِي كَثِيرٍ، وَأَيُّوبَ، عَنْ عِكْرِمَةَ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، قَالَ لَعَنَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ الْمُخَنَّثِينَ مِنَ الرِّجَالِ وَالْمُتَرَجِّلاَتِ مِنَ النِّسَاءِ . قَالَ هَذَا حَدِيثٌ حَسَنٌ صَحِيحٌ . وَفِي الْبَابِ عَنْ عَائِشَةَ .

hadiths.title: Jami` at-Tirmidhi 2786

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ فِي كَرَاهِيَةِ خُرُوجِ الْمَرْأَةِ مُتَعَطِّرَةً
chapter.englishTitle: What Has Been Related About the Disdain of Women Going Out Perfumed

hadiths.englishRaw:
Narrated Abu Musa:

that the Prophet ﷺ said: "Every eye commits adultery, and when the woman uses perfume and she passes by a gathering, then she is like this and that.'" Meaning an adulteress.
hadiths.body: that the Prophet ﷺ said: "Every eye commits adultery, and when the woman uses perfume and she passes by a gathering, then she is like this and that.'" Meaning an adulteress.
hadiths.arabic:
حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ سَعِيدٍ الْقَطَّانُ، عَنْ ثَابِتِ بْنِ عِمَارَةَ الْحَنَفِيِّ، عَنْ غُنَيْمِ بْنِ قَيْسٍ، عَنْ أَبِي مُوسَى، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ  " كُلُّ عَيْنٍ زَانِيَةٌ وَالْمَرْأَةُ إِذَا اسْتَعْطَرَتْ فَمَرَّتْ بِالْمَجْلِسِ فَهِيَ كَذَا وَكَذَا يَعْنِي زَانِيَةً " . وَفِي الْبَابِ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ . 

قَالَ أَبُو عِيسَى هَذَا حَدِيثٌ حَسَنٌ صَحِيحٌ .

hadiths.title: Jami` at-Tirmidhi 2787

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ فِي طِيبِ الرِّجَالِ وَالنِّسَاءِ
chapter.englishTitle: What Has Been Related About Fragrance For Men And Women

hadiths.englishRaw:
Narrated Abu Hurairah:

that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Fragrance for men is that which its scent is apparent and its color is hidden, and fragrance for women is that which its color is visible and its scent is hidden." (Meaning when leaving the home as indicated by the previous chapter. As far as in the presence of the husband, then the woman may wear fragrant perfume.)
hadiths.body: that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Fragrance for men is that which its scent is apparent and its color is hidden, and fragrance for women is that which its color is visible and its scent is hidden." (Meaning when leaving the home as indicated by the previous chapter. As far as in the presence of the husband, then the woman may wear fragrant perfume.)
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مَحْمُودُ بْنُ غَيْلاَنَ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ الْحَفَرِيُّ، عَنْ سُفْيَانَ، عَنِ الْجُرَيْرِيِّ، عَنْ أَبِي نَضْرَةَ، عَنْ رَجُلٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ  " طِيبُ الرِّجَالِ مَا ظَهَرَ رِيحُهُ وَخَفِيَ لَوْنُهُ وَطِيبُ النِّسَاءِ مَا ظَهَرَ لَوْنُهُ وَخَفِيَ رِيحُهُ " .

hadiths.title: Jami` at-Tirmidhi 2788

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ فِي طِيبِ الرِّجَالِ وَالنِّسَاءِ
chapter.englishTitle: What Has Been Related About Fragrance For Men And Women

hadiths.englishRaw:
Narrated 'Imran bin Husain:

"The Prophet ﷺ said [to me]: 'Indeed the best fragrance for men is what's scent is apparent and its color is hidden, and the best fragrance for women is what's color is visible and its scent is hidden.' And he prohibited Mitharatil-Urjawan (Mitharah was some type of saddle cloth. Some of the people of knowledge say it was a certain kind of cloth made of silk, and it preceded earlier under no. 1760. They disagree over Al-Urjawan, and perhaps it means whatever is red, meaning the Red Mitahrah, see Tuhfat Al-Ahwadhi)."
hadiths.body: "The Prophet ﷺ said [to me]: 'Indeed the best fragrance for men is what's scent is apparent and its color is hidden, and the best fragrance for women is what's color is visible and its scent is hidden.' And he prohibited Mitharatil-Urjawan (Mitharah was some type of saddle cloth. Some of the people of knowledge say it was a certain kind of cloth made of silk, and it preceded earlier under no. 1760. They disagree over Al-Urjawan, and perhaps it means whatever is red, meaning the Red Mitahrah, see Tuhfat Al-Ahwadhi)."
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرٍ الْحَنَفِيُّ، عَنْ سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، عَنِ الْحَسَنِ، عَنْ عِمْرَانَ بْنِ حُصَيْنٍ، قَالَ قَالَ لِي النَّبِيُّ ﷺ  " إِنَّ خَيْرَ طِيبِ الرَّجُلِ مَا ظَهَرَ رِيحُهُ وَخَفِيَ لَوْنُهُ وَخَيْرَ طِيبِ النِّسَاءِ مَا ظَهَرَ لَوْنُهُ وَخَفِيَ رِيحُهُ " . وَنَهَى عَنْ مِيثَرَةِ الأُرْجُوَانِ . هَذَا حَدِيثٌ حَسَنٌ غَرِيبٌ مِنْ هَذَا الْوَجْهِ .

hadiths.title: Jami` at-Tirmidhi 2789

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ فِي كَرَاهِيَةِ رَدِّ الطِّيبِ
chapter.englishTitle: What Has Been Related About the Disdain of Refusing Perfume

hadiths.englishRaw:
Narrated Thumamah bin 'Abdullah:

"Anas would not refuse perfume, and Anas said: 'Indeed the Prophet ﷺ would not refuse perfume."
hadiths.body: "Anas would not refuse perfume, and Anas said: 'Indeed the Prophet ﷺ would not refuse perfume."
hadiths.arabic:
حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ مَهْدِيٍّ، حَدَّثَنَا عَزْرَةُ بْنُ ثَابِتٍ، عَنْ ثُمَامَةَ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ كَانَ أَنَسٌ لاَ يَرُدُّ الطِّيبَ . وَقَالَ أَنَسٌ إِنَّ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ كَانَ لاَ يَرُدُّ الطِّيبَ . وَفِي الْبَابِ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ . 

قَالَ أَبُو عِيسَى هَذَا حَدِيثٌ حَسَنٌ صَحِيحٌ .

hadiths.title: Jami` at-Tirmidhi 2790

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ فِي كَرَاهِيَةِ رَدِّ الطِّيبِ
chapter.englishTitle: What Has Been Related About the Disdain of Refusing Perfume

hadiths.englishRaw:
Narrated Ibn 'Umar:

that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "There are three that are not refused: Cushions, oils [Duhn (fragrance)], and milk."
hadiths.body: that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "There are three that are not refused: Cushions, oils [Duhn (fragrance)], and milk."
hadiths.arabic:
حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي فُدَيْكٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ مُسْلِمٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ  " ثَلاَثٌ لاَ تُرَدُّ الْوَسَائِدُ وَالدُّهْنُ وَاللَّبَنُ " . الدُّهْنُ يَعْنِي بِهِ الطِّيبَ . 

قَالَ أَبُو عِيسَى هَذَا حَدِيثٌ غَرِيبٌ وَعَبْدُ اللَّهِ هُوَ ابْنُ مُسْلِمِ بْنِ جُنْدَبٍ وَهُوَ مَدَنِيٌّ .

hadiths.title: Jami` at-Tirmidhi 2791

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ فِي كَرَاهِيَةِ رَدِّ الطِّيبِ
chapter.englishTitle: What Has Been Related About the Disdain of Refusing Perfume

hadiths.englishRaw:
Narrated Abu 'Uthman An-Nahdi:

"The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: 'When one of you is given some fragrance then do not refuse it, for indeed it comes from Paradise."
hadiths.body: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: 'When one of you is given some fragrance then do not refuse it, for indeed it comes from Paradise."
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ خَلِيفَةَ أَبُو عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، - بَصْرِيٌّ - وَعَمْرُو بْنُ عَلِيٍّ قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ زُرَيْعٍ، عَنْ حَجَّاجٍ الصَّوَّافِ، عَنْ حَنَانٍ، عَنْ أَبِي عُثْمَانَ النَّهْدِيِّ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ  " إِذَا أُعْطِيَ أَحَدُكُمُ الرَّيْحَانَ فَلاَ يَرُدَّهُ فَإِنَّهُ خَرَجَ مِنَ الْجَنَّةِ " . قَالَ هَذَا حَدِيثٌ غَرِيبٌ لاَ نَعْرِفُهُ إِلاَّ مِنْ هَذَا الْوَجْهِ . وَلاَ نَعْرِفُ حَنَانًا إِلاَّ فِي هَذَا الْحَدِيثِ وَأَبُو عُثْمَانَ النَّهْدِيُّ اسْمُهُ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ مُلٍّ وَقَدْ أَدْرَكَ زَمَنَ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ وَلَمْ يَرَهُ وَلَمْ يَسْمَعْ مِنْهُ .

hadiths.title: Jami` at-Tirmidhi 2792

chapter.arabicTitle: باب فِي كَرَاهِيَةِ مُبَاشَرَةِ الرَّجُلِ الرَّجُلَ وَالْمَرْأَةِ الْمَرْأَةَ
chapter.englishTitle: What Has Been Related About It Being Disliked For Man's Skin To Touch A Man's Skin And A Woman's Skin To Touch A Woman's Skin

hadiths.englishRaw:
Narrated 'Abdullah:

that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "A woman is not to touch a woman such that she can describe her to her husband as if he is looking at her."
hadiths.body: that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "A woman is not to touch a woman such that she can describe her to her husband as if he is looking at her."
hadiths.arabic:
حَدَّثَنَا هَنَّادٌ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو مُعَاوِيَةَ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ شَقِيقِ بْنِ سَلَمَةَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ  " لاَ تُبَاشِرُ الْمَرْأَةُ الْمَرْأَةَ حَتَّى تَصِفَهَا لِزَوْجِهَا كَأَنَّمَا يَنْظُرُ إِلَيْهَا " . 

قَالَ أَبُو عِيسَى هَذَا حَدِيثٌ حَسَنٌ صَحِيحٌ .

hadiths.title: Jami` at-Tirmidhi 2793

chapter.arabicTitle: باب فِي كَرَاهِيَةِ مُبَاشَرَةِ الرَّجُلِ الرَّجُلَ وَالْمَرْأَةِ الْمَرْأَةَ
chapter.englishTitle: What Has Been Related About It Being Disliked For Man's Skin To Touch A Man's Skin And A Woman's Skin To Touch A Woman's Skin

hadiths.englishRaw:
Narrated 'Abdur-Rahman bin Abi Sa'eed [Al-Khudri]:

from his father who said: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: 'A man is not to look at the 'Awrah of a man, and a woman is not to look at the 'Awrah of a woman. A man is not to be alone with a man under one garment, and a woman is not to be alone with a women under one garment.'"
hadiths.body: from his father who said: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: 'A man is not to look at the 'Awrah of a man, and a woman is not to look at the 'Awrah of a woman. A man is not to be alone with a man under one garment, and a woman is not to be alone with a women under one garment.'"
hadiths.arabic:
حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ أَبِي زِيَادٍ، حَدَّثَنَا زَيْدُ بْنُ حُبَابٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي الضَّحَّاكُ بْنُ عُثْمَانَ، أَخْبَرَنِي زَيْدُ بْنُ أَسْلَمَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيِّ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ  " لاَ يَنْظُرُ الرَّجُلُ إِلَى عَوْرَةِ الرَّجُلِ وَلاَ تَنْظُرُ الْمَرْأَةُ إِلَى عَوْرَةِ الْمَرْأَةِ وَلاَ يُفْضِي الرَّجُلُ إِلَى الرَّجُلِ فِي الثَّوْبِ الْوَاحِدِ وَلاَ تُفْضِي الْمَرْأَةُ إِلَى الْمَرْأَةِ فِي الثَّوْبِ الْوَاحِدِ " . 

قَالَ أَبُو عِيسَى هَذَا حَدِيثٌ حَسَنٌ غَرِيبٌ .

hadiths.title: Jami` at-Tirmidhi 2794

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ فِي حِفْظِ الْعَوْرَةِ
chapter.englishTitle: What Has Been Related About Protecting The 'Awrah

hadiths.englishRaw:
Narrated Bahz bin Hakim:

from his father, from his grandfather, who said: "I said: 'O Prophet of Allah! Regarding our 'Awrah, what of it must we cover and what of it may we leave?' He said: 'Protect your 'Awrah except from your wife or what your right hand possesses.' He said: "I said: 'O Messenger of Allah! What about when some people are with others?' He said: 'If you are able to not let anyone see it then do not let them see it.'" He said: "I said: 'O Prophet of Allah! What about when one of us is alone?' He said: 'Allah is more deserving of being shy from Him than the people.'"
hadiths.body: from his father, from his grandfather, who said: "I said: 'O Prophet of Allah! Regarding our 'Awrah, what of it must we cover and what of it may we leave?' He said: 'Protect your 'Awrah except from your wife or what your right hand possesses.' He said: "I said: 'O Messenger of Allah! What about when some people are with others?' He said: 'If you are able to not let anyone see it then do not let them see it.'" He said: "I said: 'O Prophet of Allah! What about when one of us is alone?' He said: 'Allah is more deserving of being shy from Him than the people.'"
hadiths.arabic:
حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مَنِيعٍ، حَدَّثَنَا مُعَاذُ بْنُ مُعَاذٍ، وَيَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا بَهْزُ بْنُ حَكِيمٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ جَدِّهِ، قَالَ قُلْتُ يَا نَبِيَّ اللَّهِ عَوْرَاتُنَا مَا نَأْتِي مِنْهَا وَمَا نَذَرُ قَالَ " احْفَظْ عَوْرَتَكَ إِلاَّ مِنْ زَوْجَتِكَ أَوْ مَا مَلَكَتْ يَمِينُكَ " . قُلْتُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِذَا كَانَ الْقَوْمُ بَعْضُهُمْ فِي بَعْضٍ قَالَ " إِنِ اسْتَطَعْتَ أَنْ لاَ يَرَاهَا أَحَدٌ فَلاَ يَرَيَنَّهَا " . قَالَ قُلْتُ يَا نَبِيَّ اللَّهِ إِذَا كَانَ أَحَدُنَا خَالِيًا قَالَ " فَاللَّهُ أَحَقُّ أَنْ يَسْتَحْيِيَ مِنْهُ النَّاسُ " . 

قَالَ أَبُو عِيسَى هَذَا حَدِيثٌ حَسَنٌ .

hadiths.title: Jami` at-Tirmidhi 2795

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ أَنَّ الْفَخِذَ عَوْرَةٌ
chapter.englishTitle: What Has Been Related About The Thigh Being Part Of The 'Awrah

hadiths.englishRaw:
Narrated Zur'ah bin Muslim bin Jardah Al-Aslami:

about his grandfather Jarhad, he said: "The Prophet ﷺ passed by Jarhad in the Masjid and his thigh was exposed, so he said: 'Indeed the thigh is 'Awrah.'"
hadiths.narrator: Narrated Zur'ah bin Muslim bin Jardah Al-Aslami:
hadiths.body: about his grandfather Jarhad, he said: "The Prophet ﷺ passed by Jarhad in the Masjid and his thigh was exposed, so he said: 'Indeed the thigh is 'Awrah.'"
hadiths.arabic:
حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي عُمَرَ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ أَبِي النَّضْرِ، مَوْلَى عُمَرَ بْنِ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ عَنْ زُرْعَةَ بْنِ مُسْلِمِ بْنِ جَرْهَدٍ الأَسْلَمِيِّ، عَنْ جَدِّهِ، جَرْهَدٍ قَالَ مَرَّ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ بِجَرْهَدٍ فِي الْمَسْجِدِ وَقَدِ انْكَشَفَ فَخِذُهُ فَقَالَ  " إِنَّ الْفَخِذَ عَوْرَةٌ " . 

قَالَ أَبُو عِيسَى هَذَا حَدِيثٌ حَسَنٌ مَا أَرَى إِسْنَادَهُ بِمُتَّصِلٍ .

hadiths.title: Jami` at-Tirmidhi 2796

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ أَنَّ الْفَخِذَ عَوْرَةٌ
chapter.englishTitle: What Has Been Related About The Thigh Being Part Of The 'Awrah

hadiths.englishRaw:
Narrated 'Abdullah bin Jardah Al-Aslami:

from his father, from the Prophet ﷺ who said: "The thigh is 'Awrah."
hadiths.body: from his father, from the Prophet ﷺ who said: "The thigh is 'Awrah."
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا وَاصِلُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الأَعْلَى الْكُوفِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ آدَمَ، عَنْ إِسْرَائِيلَ، عَنْ أَبِي يَحْيَى، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ  " الْفَخِذُ عَوْرَةٌ " .

hadiths.title: Jami` at-Tirmidhi 2797

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ أَنَّ الْفَخِذَ عَوْرَةٌ
chapter.englishTitle: What Has Been Related About The Thigh Being Part Of The 'Awrah

hadiths.englishRaw:
Narrated Ibn 'Abbas:

that the Prophet ﷺ said: "The thigh is 'Awrah."
hadiths.body: that the Prophet ﷺ said: "The thigh is 'Awrah."
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا وَاصِلُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الأَعْلَى، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ آدَمَ، عَنِ الْحَسَنِ بْنِ صَالِحٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَقِيلٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ جَرْهَدٍ الأَسْلَمِيِّ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ  " الْفَخِذُ عَوْرَةٌ " قَالَ هَذَا حَدِيثٌ حَسَنٌ غَرِيبٌ مِنْ هَذَا الْوَجْهِ . وَفِي الْبَابِ عَنْ عَلِيٍّ وَمُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ جَحْشٍ وَلِعَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ جَحْشٍ صُحْبَةٌ وَلاِبْنِهِ مُحَمَّدٍ صُحْبَةٌ .

hadiths.title: Jami` at-Tirmidhi 2798

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ أَنَّ الْفَخِذَ عَوْرَةٌ
chapter.englishTitle: What Has Been Related About The Thigh Being Part Of The 'Awrah

hadiths.englishRaw:
Narrated Abu Az-Zinad:

"Ibn Jarhad informed me from his father, that the Prophet ﷺ passed by him while his thigh was exposed, so the Prophet ﷺ said: 'Cover your thigh, for indeed it is 'Awrah.'"
hadiths.body: "Ibn Jarhad informed me from his father, that the Prophet ﷺ passed by him while his thigh was exposed, so the Prophet ﷺ said: 'Cover your thigh, for indeed it is 'Awrah.'"
hadiths.arabic:
حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ بْنُ عَلِيٍّ الْخَلاَّلُ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنْ أَبِي الزِّنَادِ، أَخْبَرَنِي ابْنُ جَرْهَدٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ مَرَّ بِهِ وَهُوَ كَاشِفٌ عَنْ فَخِذِهِ فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ  " غَطِّ فَخِذَكَ فَإِنَّهَا مِنَ الْعَوْرَةِ " . 

قَالَ أَبُو عِيسَى هَذَا حَدِيثٌ حَسَنٌ .

hadiths.title: Jami` at-Tirmidhi 2799

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ فِي النَّظَافَةِ
chapter.englishTitle: What Has Been Related About Cleanliness

hadiths.englishRaw:
Narrated Salih bin Abi Hassan:

"I heard Sa'eed bin Musayyab saying: 'Indeed Allah is Tayyib (good) and he loves Tayyib (what is good), and He is Nazif (clean) and He loves cleanliness, He is Karim (kind) and He loves kindness, He is Jawad (generous) and He loves generosity. So clean' - I think he said - 'your courtyards, and do not resemble the Jews.'" He said: "I mentioned that to Muhajir bin Mismar, and he said: "Amir bin Sa'd [bin Abi Waqqas] narrated it to me from his father from the Prophet ﷺ, similarly, except that he did not say: "Clean your courtyards."
hadiths.body: "I heard Sa'eed bin Musayyab saying: 'Indeed Allah is Tayyib (good) and he loves Tayyib (what is good), and He is Nazif (clean) and He loves cleanliness, He is Karim (kind) and He loves kindness, He is Jawad (generous) and He loves generosity. So clean' - I think he said - 'your courtyards, and do not resemble the Jews.'" He said: "I mentioned that to Muhajir bin Mismar, and he said: "Amir bin Sa'd [bin Abi Waqqas] narrated it to me from his father from the Prophet ﷺ, similarly, except that he did not say: "Clean your courtyards."
hadiths.arabic:
حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَامِرٍ الْعَقَدِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا خَالِدُ بْنُ إِلْيَاسَ، وَيُقَالُ ابْنُ إِيَاسٍ، عَنْ صَالِحِ بْنِ أَبِي حَسَّانَ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ سَعِيدَ بْنَ الْمُسَيَّبِ، يَقُولُ إِنَّ اللَّهَ طَيِّبٌ يُحِبُّ الطَّيِّبَ نَظِيفٌ يُحِبُّ النَّظَافَةَ كَرِيمٌ يُحِبُّ الْكَرَمَ جَوَادٌ يُحِبُّ الْجُودَ فَنَظِّفُوا أُرَاهُ قَالَ أَفْنِيَتَكُمْ وَلاَ تَشَبَّهُوا بِالْيَهُودِ . قَالَ فَذَكَرْتُ ذَلِكَ لِمُهَاجِرِ بْنِ مِسْمَارٍ فَقَالَ حَدَّثَنِيهِ عَامِرُ بْنُ سَعْدِ بْنِ أَبِي وَقَّاصٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ مِثْلَهُ إِلاَّ أَنَّهُ قَالَ نَظِّفُوا أَفْنِيَتَكُمْ . 

قَالَ أَبُو عِيسَى هَذَا حَدِيثٌ غَرِيبٌ . وَخَالِدُ بْنُ إِلْيَاسَ يُضَعَّفُ .

hadiths.title: Jami` at-Tirmidhi 2800

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ فِي الاِسْتِتَارِ عِنْدَ الْجِمَاعِ
chapter.englishTitle: What Has Been Related About Screening Oneself During Sexual Intercourse

hadiths.englishRaw:
Narrated Abu Muhayyah:

from Laith, from Nafi, from Ibn 'Umar that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Beware of nakedness! For indeed there are with you, those who do not part from you except at the place of defecation, and when a man goes into his wife. So be shy of them and honor them."
hadiths.body: from Laith, from Nafi, from Ibn 'Umar that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Beware of nakedness! For indeed there are with you, those who do not part from you except at the place of defecation, and when a man goes into his wife. So be shy of them and honor them."
hadiths.arabic:
حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ نِيْزَكَ الْبَغْدَادِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا الأَسْوَدُ بْنُ عَامِرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو مُحَيَّاةَ، عَنْ لَيْثٍ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ قَالَ  " إِيَّاكُمْ وَالتَّعَرِّي فَإِنَّ مَعَكُمْ مَنْ لاَ يُفَارِقُكُمْ إِلاَّ عِنْدَ الْغَائِطِ وَحِينَ يُفْضِي الرَّجُلُ إِلَى أَهْلِهِ فَاسْتَحْيُوهُمْ وَأَكْرِمُوهُمْ " . 

قَالَ أَبُو عِيسَى هَذَا حَدِيثٌ غَرِيبٌ لاَ نَعْرِفُهُ إِلاَّ مِنْ هَذَا الْوَجْهِ وَأَبُو مُحَيَّاةَ اسْمُهُ يَحْيَى بْنُ يَعْلَى .

hadiths.title: Jami` at-Tirmidhi 2801

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ فِي دُخُولِ الْحَمَّامِ
chapter.englishTitle: What Has Been Related About Entering The Hammam (Public Bath)

hadiths.englishRaw:
Narrated Jabir:

that the Prophet ﷺ said: "Whoever believes in Allah and the Last Day, then he is not to let his wife enter the Hammam, and whoever believes in Allah and the Last Day, then he is not to enter the Hammam without an Izar. And whoever believes in Allah and the Last Day, then he is not to sit at a spread in which Khamr is circulated."
hadiths.body: that the Prophet ﷺ said: "Whoever believes in Allah and the Last Day, then he is not to let his wife enter the Hammam, and whoever believes in Allah and the Last Day, then he is not to enter the Hammam without an Izar. And whoever believes in Allah and the Last Day, then he is not to sit at a spread in which Khamr is circulated."
hadiths.arabic:
حَدَّثَنَا الْقَاسِمُ بْنُ دِينَارٍ الْكُوفِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا مُصْعَبُ بْنُ الْمِقْدَامِ، عَنِ الْحَسَنِ بْنِ صَالِحٍ، عَنْ لَيْثِ بْنِ أَبِي سُلَيْمٍ، عَنْ طَاوُسٍ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ قَالَ  " مَنْ كَانَ يُؤْمِنُ بِاللَّهِ وَالْيَوْمِ الآخِرِ فَلاَ يَدْخُلِ الْحَمَّامَ بِغَيْرِ إِزَارٍ وَمَنْ كَانَ يُؤْمِنُ بِاللَّهِ وَالْيَوْمِ الآخِرِ فَلاَ يُدْخِلْ حَلِيلَتَهُ الْحَمَّامَ وَمَنْ كَانَ يُؤْمِنُ بِاللَّهِ وَالْيَوْمِ الآخِرِ فَلاَ يَجْلِسْ عَلَى مَائِدَةٍ يُدَارُ عَلَيْهَا بِالْخَمْرِ " . 

قَالَ أَبُو عِيسَى هَذَا حَدِيثٌ حَسَنٌ غَرِيبٌ لاَ نَعْرِفُهُ مِنْ حَدِيثِ طَاوُسٍ عَنْ جَابِرٍ إِلاَّ مِنْ هَذَا الْوَجْهِ . قَالَ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ إِسْمَاعِيلَ لَيْثُ بْنُ أَبِي سُلَيْمٍ صَدُوقٌ وَرُبَّمَا يَهِمُ فِي الشَّىْءِ . قَالَ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ إِسْمَاعِيلَ وَقَالَ أَحْمَدُ بْنُ حَنْبَلٍ لَيْثٌ لاَ يُفْرَحُ بِحَدِيثِهِ كَانَ لَيْثٌ يَرْفَعُ أَشْيَاءَ لاَ يَرْفَعُهَا غَيْرُهُ فَلِذَلِكَ ضَعَّفُوهُ .

hadiths.title: Jami` at-Tirmidhi 2802

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ فِي دُخُولِ الْحَمَّامِ
chapter.englishTitle: What Has Been Related About Entering The Hammam (Public Bath)

hadiths.englishRaw:
Narrated Abu 'Udhrah [and he lived during the time of the Prophet ﷺ]:

from 'Aishah, that the Prophet ﷺ prohibitied the men and women from the Hammamat (plural of Hammam), then he permitted it for the men in Izar."
hadiths.narrator: Narrated Abu 'Udhrah [and he lived during the time of the Prophet ﷺ]:
hadiths.body: from 'Aishah, that the Prophet ﷺ prohibitied the men and women from the Hammamat (plural of Hammam), then he permitted it for the men in Izar."
hadiths.arabic:
حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ مَهْدِيٍّ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ شَدَّادٍ الأَعْرَجِ، عَنْ أَبِي عُذْرَةَ، وَكَانَ، قَدْ أَدْرَكَ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ عَنْ عَائِشَةَ أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ نَهَى الرِّجَالَ وَالنِّسَاءَ عَنِ الْحَمَّامَاتِ ثُمَّ رَخَّصَ لِلرِّجَالِ فِي الْمَيَازِرِ . 

قَالَ أَبُو عِيسَى هَذَا حَدِيثٌ لاَ نَعْرِفُهُ إِلاَّ مِنْ حَدِيثِ حَمَّادِ بْنِ سَلَمَةَ وَإِسْنَادُهُ لَيْسَ بِذَاكَ الْقَائِمِ .

hadiths.title: Jami` at-Tirmidhi 2803

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ فِي دُخُولِ الْحَمَّامِ
chapter.englishTitle: What Has Been Related About Entering The Hammam (Public Bath)

hadiths.englishRaw:
Narrated Abu Al-Malih Al-Hudhali:

that some women from the inhabitants of Hims, or from the inhabitants of Ash-Sham entered upon 'Aishah, so she said: "Are you those whose women enter the Hammamat? I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ saying: 'No woman removes her garments in other than the house of her husband except that she has torn the screen between herself and her Lord.'"
hadiths.body: that some women from the inhabitants of Hims, or from the inhabitants of Ash-Sham entered upon 'Aishah, so she said: "Are you those whose women enter the Hammamat? I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ saying: 'No woman removes her garments in other than the house of her husband except that she has torn the screen between herself and her Lord.'"
hadiths.arabic:
حَدَّثَنَا مَحْمُودُ بْنُ غَيْلاَنَ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ، أَنْبَأَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ سَالِمَ بْنَ أَبِي الْجَعْدِ، يُحَدِّثُ عَنْ أَبِي الْمَلِيحِ الْهُذَلِيِّ، أَنَّ نِسَاءً، مِنْ أَهْلِ حِمْصَ أَوْ مِنْ أَهْلِ الشَّامِ دَخَلْنَ عَلَى عَائِشَةَ فَقَالَتْ أَنْتُنَّ اللاَّتِي يَدْخُلْنَ نِسَاؤُكُنَّ الْحَمَّامَاتِ سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ يَقُولُ  " مَا مِنِ امْرَأَةٍ تَضَعُ ثِيَابَهَا فِي غَيْرِ بَيْتِ زَوْجِهَا إِلاَّ هَتَكَتِ السِّتْرَ بَيْنَهَا وَبَيْنَ رَبِّهَا " . 

قَالَ أَبُو عِيسَى هَذَا حَدِيثٌ حَسَنٌ .

hadiths.title: Jami` at-Tirmidhi 2804

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ أَنَّ الْمَلاَئِكَةَ لاَ تَدْخُلُ بَيْتًا فِيهِ صُورَةٌ وَلاَ كَلْبٌ
chapter.englishTitle: What Has Been Related About Angels Do Not Enter The House That Contains An Image Or A Dog

hadiths.englishRaw:
Narrated Ibn 'Abbas:

"I heard Abu Talhah saying: 'I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ saying: "The angels do not enter a house in which there is a dog or an object of images."
hadiths.body: "I heard Abu Talhah saying: 'I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ saying: "The angels do not enter a house in which there is a dog or an object of images."
hadiths.arabic:
حَدَّثَنَا سَلَمَةُ بْنُ شَبِيبٍ، وَالْحَسَنُ بْنُ عَلِيٍّ الْخَلاَّلُ، وَعَبْدُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ، وَغَيْرُ، وَاحِدٍ، وَاللَّفْظُ، لِلْحَسَنِ بْنِ عَلِيٍّ قَالُوا حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُتْبَةَ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ ابْنَ عَبَّاسٍ، يَقُولُ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا طَلْحَةَ، يَقُولُ سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ يَقُولُ  " لاَ تَدْخُلُ الْمَلاَئِكَةُ بَيْتًا فِيهِ كَلْبٌ وَلاَ صُورَةُ تَمَاثِيلَ " . 

قَالَ أَبُو عِيسَى هَذَا حَدِيثٌ حَسَنٌ صَحِيحٌ .

hadiths.title: Jami` at-Tirmidhi 2805

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ أَنَّ الْمَلاَئِكَةَ لاَ تَدْخُلُ بَيْتًا فِيهِ صُورَةٌ وَلاَ كَلْبٌ
chapter.englishTitle: What Has Been Related About Angels Do Not Enter The House That Contains An Image Or A Dog

hadiths.englishRaw:
Narrated Ishaq bin 'Abdullah bin Abi Talhah:

that Rafi' bin Ishaq informed him, saying: "I and 'Abdullah bin Abi Talhah entered upon Abu Sa'eed Al-Khudri to visit him. So Abu Sa'eed said: 'The Messenger of Allah ﷺ informed us: "The angels do not enter a house in which there is an image or a picture."
hadiths.narrator: Narrated Ishaq bin 'Abdullah bin Abi Talhah:
hadiths.body: that Rafi' bin Ishaq informed him, saying: "I and 'Abdullah bin Abi Talhah entered upon Abu Sa'eed Al-Khudri to visit him. So Abu Sa'eed said: 'The Messenger of Allah ﷺ informed us: "The angels do not enter a house in which there is an image or a picture."
hadiths.arabic:
حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مَنِيعٍ، حَدَّثَنَا رَوْحُ بْنُ عُبَادَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا مَالِكُ بْنُ أَنَسٍ، عَنْ إِسْحَاقَ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي طَلْحَةَ، أَنَّ رَافِعَ بْنَ إِسْحَاقَ، أَخْبَرَهُ قَالَ دَخَلْتُ أَنَا وَعَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ أَبِي طَلْحَةَ، عَلَى أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيِّ نَعُودُهُ فَقَالَ أَبُو سَعِيدٍ أَخْبَرَنَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ أَنَّ الْمَلاَئِكَةَ لاَ تَدْخُلُ بَيْتًا فِيهِ تَمَاثِيلُ أَوْ صُورَةٌ . شَكَّ إِسْحَاقُ لاَ يَدْرِي أَيُّهُمَا قَالَ . 

قَالَ أَبُو عِيسَى هَذَا حَدِيثٌ حَسَنٌ صَحِيحٌ .

hadiths.title: Jami` at-Tirmidhi 2806

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ أَنَّ الْمَلاَئِكَةَ لاَ تَدْخُلُ بَيْتًا فِيهِ صُورَةٌ وَلاَ كَلْبٌ
chapter.englishTitle: What Has Been Related About Angels Do Not Enter The House That Contains An Image Or A Dog

hadiths.englishRaw:
Narrated Abu Hurairah:

that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Jibra'il came to me and said: "Indeed I had come to you last night, and nothing prevented me from entering upon you at the house you were in, except that there were images of men at the door of the house, and there was a curtain screen with imagines on it, and there was a dog in the house. So go and sever the head of the image that is at the door so that it will become like a tree stump, and go and cut the screen and make two throw-cushions to be sat upon, and go and expel the dog." So the Messenger of Allah ﷺ did so, and the dog was a puppy belonging to Al-Husain or Al-Hasan which was under his belongings, so he ordered him to expel it.
hadiths.body: that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Jibra'il came to me and said: "Indeed I had come to you last night, and nothing prevented me from entering upon you at the house you were in, except that there were images of men at the door of the house, and there was a curtain screen with imagines on it, and there was a dog in the house. So go and sever the head of the image that is at the door so that it will become like a tree stump, and go and cut the screen and make two throw-cushions to be sat upon, and go and expel the dog." So the Messenger of Allah ﷺ did so, and the dog was a puppy belonging to Al-Husain or Al-Hasan which was under his belongings, so he ordered him to expel it.
hadiths.arabic:
حَدَّثَنَا سُوَيْدٌ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ الْمُبَارَكِ، أَخْبَرَنَا يُونُسُ بْنُ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ، حَدَّثَنَا مُجَاهِدٌ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ  " أَتَانِي جِبْرِيلُ فَقَالَ إِنِّي كُنْتُ أَتَيْتُكَ الْبَارِحَةَ فَلَمْ يَمْنَعْنِي أَنْ أَكُونَ دَخَلْتُ عَلَيْكَ الْبَيْتَ الَّذِي كُنْتَ فِيهِ إِلاَّ أَنَّهُ كَانَ فِي بَابِ الْبَيْتِ تِمْثَالُ الرِّجَالِ وَكَانَ فِي الْبَيْتِ قِرَامُ سِتْرٍ فِيهِ تَمَاثِيلُ وَكَانَ فِي الْبَيْتِ كَلْبٌ فَمُرْ بِرَأْسِ التِّمْثَالِ الَّذِي بِالْبَابِ فَلْيُقْطَعْ فَيَصِيرَ كَهَيْئَةِ الشَّجَرَةِ وَمُرْ بِالسِّتْرِ فَلْيُقْطَعْ وَيُجْعَلْ مِنْهُ وِسَادَتَيْنِ مُنْتَبَذَتَيْنِ يُوَطَآنِ وَمُرْ بِالْكَلْبِ فَيُخْرَجْ " . فَفَعَلَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ وَكَانَ ذَلِكَ الْكَلْبُ جَرْوًا لِلْحَسَنِ أَوِ الْحُسَيْنِ تَحْتَ نَضَدٍ لَهُ فَأَمَرَ بِهِ فَأُخْرِجَ . 

قَالَ أَبُو عِيسَى هَذَا حَدِيثٌ حَسَنٌ صَحِيحٌ . وَفِي الْبَابِ عَنْ عَائِشَةَ وَأَبِي طَلْحَةَ .

hadiths.title: Jami` at-Tirmidhi 2807

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ فِي كَرَاهِيَةِ لُبْسِ الْمُعَصْفَرِ لِلرَّجُلِ وَالْقَسِّيِّ
chapter.englishTitle: What Has Been Related About the Disdain of Wearing Garments Dyed With Safflower For Men And Al-Qassi

hadiths.englishRaw:
Narrated 'Abdullah bin 'Amr:

"A man passed by while wearing two red garments. He gave Salam to the Prophet ﷺ but he did not return the Salam."
hadiths.body: "A man passed by while wearing two red garments. He gave Salam to the Prophet ﷺ but he did not return the Salam."
hadiths.arabic:
